每个程序员都应该了解的内存知识

What Every Programmer Should Know About Memory

Ulrich Drepper
Red Hat, Inc.
drepper@redhat.com
2007年11月21日

Ulrich Drepper
Red Hat, Inc.
drepper@redhat.com
November 21, 2007

摘要

Abstract

随着CPU内核变得越来越快、数量越来越多，对大多数程序而言，限制性因素现在是、并且在今后一段时间内仍将是内存访问。硬件设计者们提出了越来越复杂的内存处理和加速技术——例如CPU缓存——但如果没有程序员的一些帮助，这些技术就无法以最佳方式工作。遗憾的是，大多数程序员既不太了解计算机内存子系统或CPU缓存的结构，也不太了解使用它们的代价。本文解释了现代通用硬件上所使用的内存子系统的结构，说明了CPU缓存为何被开发出来、它们如何工作，以及程序应当怎样做才能通过利用它们来获得最佳性能。

As CPU cores become both faster and more numerous, the limiting factor for most programs is now, and will be for some time, memory access. Hardware designers have come up with ever more sophisticated memory handling and acceleration techniques–such as CPU caches–but these cannot work optimally without some help from the programmer. Unfortunately, neither the structure nor the cost of using the memory subsystem of a computer or the caches on CPUs is well understood by most programmers. This paper explains the structure of memory subsystems in use on modern commodity hardware, illustrating why CPU caches were developed, how they work, and what programs should do to achieve optimal performance by utilizing them.

1 引言

1 Introduction

早期的计算机要简单得多。系统的各个组件，例如CPU、内存、大容量存储器和网络接口，是共同开发的，因此它们的性能相当均衡。例如，内存和网络接口提供数据的速度并不比CPU（快多少）。

In the early days computers were much simpler. The various components of a system, such as the CPU, memory, mass storage, and network interfaces, were developed together and, as a result, were quite balanced in their performance. For example, the memory and network interfaces were not (much) faster than the CPU at providing data.

一旦计算机的基本结构稳定下来，硬件开发者开始专注于优化各个子系统，这种情况就改变了。突然之间，计算机某些组件的性能大幅落后，瓶颈随之出现。大容量存储器和内存子系统尤其如此，出于成本原因，它们相对于其他组件改进得更慢。

This situation changed once the basic structure of computers stabilized and hardware developers concentrated on optimizing individual subsystems. Suddenly the performance of some components of the computer fell significantly behind and bottlenecks developed. This was especially true for mass storage and memory subsystems which, for cost reasons, improved more slowly relative to other components.

大容量存储器的缓慢主要是通过软件技术来应对的：操作系统将最常用（以及最可能被使用）的数据保存在主存中，而主存的访问速度比硬盘快几个数量级。缓存存储也被加入到存储设备本身之中，这不需要对操作系统作任何改动就能提高性能。1就本文而言，我们不会深入讨论针对大容量存储访问的软件优化细节。

The slowness of mass storage has mostly been dealt with using software techniques: operating systems keep most often used (and most likely to be used) data in main memory, which can be accessed at a rate orders of magnitude faster than the hard disk. Cache storage was added to the storage devices themselves, which requires no changes in the operating system to increase performance.1 For the purposes of this paper, we will not go into more details of software optimizations for the mass storage access.

与存储子系统不同，消除主存这一瓶颈被证明要困难得多，几乎所有的解决方案都需要对硬件进行改动。如今这些改动主要有以下几种形式：

Unlike storage subsystems, removing the main memory as a bottleneck has proven much more difficult and almost all solutions require changes to the hardware. Today these changes mainly come in the following forms:

  • RAM硬件设计（速度与并行性）。

    RAM hardware design (speed and parallelism).

  • 内存控制器设计。

    Memory controller designs.

  • CPU缓存。

    CPU caches.

  • 设备的直接内存访问（DMA）。

    Direct memory access (DMA) for devices.

本文在很大程度上将讨论CPU缓存以及内存控制器设计的一些影响。在探讨这些主题的过程中，我们也会考察DMA，并把它放到更大的图景中。不过，我们将从概述当今通用硬件的设计开始。这是理解高效使用内存子系统的问题与局限的前提。我们还将较为详细地了解不同类型的RAM，并说明这些差异为何至今仍然存在。

For the most part, this document will deal with CPU caches and some effects of memory controller design. In the process of exploring these topics, we will explore DMA and bring it into the larger picture. However, we will start with an overview of the design for today’s commodity hardware. This is a prerequisite to understanding the problems and the limitations of efficiently using memory subsystems. We will also learn about, in some detail, the different types of RAM and illustrate why these differences still exist.

本文档绝不是包罗万象、一成不变的。它仅限于通用硬件，并且进一步仅限于这类硬件的一个子集。此外，许多主题只会讨论到足以满足本文目标的程度。对于这些主题，建议读者去查找更详细的文档。

This document is in no way all inclusive and final. It is limited to commodity hardware and further limited to a subset of that hardware. Also, many topics will be discussed in just enough detail for the goals of this paper. For such topics, readers are recommended to find more detailed documentation.

涉及特定于操作系统的细节和解决方案时，本文只描述Linux。它在任何时候都不会包含关于其他操作系统的任何信息。作者没有兴趣讨论其对其他操作系统的意义。如果读者认为自己必须使用其他操作系统，那就得去找他们的供应商，要求供应商写出与本文类似的文档。

When it comes to operating-system-specific details and solutions, the text exclusively describes Linux. At no time will it contain any information about other OSes. The author has no interest in discussing the implications for other OSes. If the reader thinks s/he has to use a different OS they have to go to their vendors and demand they write documents similar to this one.

开始之前的最后一点说明。本文中多次出现“通常”（usually）一词以及其他类似的限定词。这里讨论的技术在现实世界中存在着非常非常多的变体，本文只涉及最常见的主流版本。对于这项技术，很少能作出绝对的断言，因此才有这些限定词。

One last comment before the start. The text contains a number of occurrences of the term “usually” and other, similar qualifiers. The technology discussed here exists in many, many variations in the real world and this paper only addresses the most common, mainstream versions. It is rare that absolute statements can be made about this technology, thus the qualifiers.

文档结构

Document Structure

本文档主要面向软件开发者。它对硬件技术细节的介绍不够深入，对面向硬件的读者用处不大。但在我们进入面向开发者的实用信息之前，必须先打下大量基础。

This document is mostly for software developers. It does not go into enough technical details of the hardware to be useful for hardware-oriented readers. But before we can go into the practical information for developers a lot of groundwork must be laid.

为此，第二节从技术细节上描述随机存取存储器（RAM）。了解这一节的内容是好的，但对于理解后面各节并非绝对关键。在需要用到该节内容的地方都加入了相应的回指，因此心急的读者起初可以跳过这一节的大部分内容。

To that end, the second section describes random-access memory (RAM) in technical detail. This section’s content is nice to know but not absolutely critical to be able to understand the later sections. Appropriate back references to the section are added in places where the content is required so that the anxious reader could skip most of this section at first.

第三节详细讨论CPU缓存的行为。为了不让文字过于枯燥，这里使用了图表。这部分内容对于理解文档的其余部分至关重要。第4节简要描述虚拟内存是如何实现的。这同样是理解其余部分所需的基础。第5节详细讨论非一致内存访问（NUMA）系统。

The third section goes into a lot of details of CPU cache behavior. Graphs have been used to keep the text from being as dry as it would otherwise be. This content is essential for an understanding of the rest of the document. Section 4 describes briefly how virtual memory is implemented. This is also required groundwork for the rest. Section 5 goes into a lot of detail about Non Uniform Memory Access (NUMA) systems.

第6节是本文的核心部分。它汇集了前面各节的所有信息，并就如何编写在各种情况下都表现良好的代码向程序员提出建议。非常没有耐心的读者可以从这一节开始读，必要时再回到前面各节，温习底层技术的知识。

Section 6 is the central section of this paper. It brings together all the previous sections’ information and gives programmers advice on how to write code which performs well in the various situations. The very impatient reader could start with this section and, if necessary, go back to the earlier sections to freshen up the knowledge of the underlying technology.

第7节介绍能帮助程序员把工作做得更好的工具。即使完全理解了这些技术，在一个非平凡的软件项目中，问题出在哪里也远非显而易见。一些工具是必不可少的。

Section 7 introduces tools which can help the programmer do a better job. Even with a complete understanding of the technology it is far from obvious where in a non-trivial software project the problems are. Some tools are necessary.

最后，在第8节中，我们对近期可以期待的、或者只是有了会很好的技术作一展望。

In section 8 we finally give an outlook of technology which can be expected in the near future or which might just simply be good to have.

关于本文档

About this Document

本文的标题是向David Goldberg的经典论文《每个计算机科学家都应该了解的浮点运算知识》[12]致敬。这篇论文至今仍不广为人知，尽管对于任何敢于为严肃编程而碰键盘的人来说，它都应该是必读的。

The title of this paper is an homage to David Goldberg’s classic paper “What Every Computer Scientist Should Know About Floating-Point Arithmetic” [12]. This paper is still not widely known, although it should be a prerequisite for anybody daring to touch a keyboard for serious programming.

2 当今的通用硬件

2 Commodity Hardware Today

理解通用硬件很重要，因为专用硬件正在退潮。如今的扩展大多是横向而非纵向实现的，也就是说，如今使用许多较小的、相互连接的通用计算机，比使用少数几台非常大、速度极快（而且昂贵）的系统更具成本效益。之所以如此，是因为快速而廉价的网络硬件已广泛可得。在某些情况下，大型专用系统仍有其用武之地，这些系统也仍然提供着商机，但其整体市场与通用硬件市场相比相形见绌。截至2007年，Red Hat预计，对于未来的产品，大多数数据中心的“标准构建模块”将是一台最多有四个插槽的计算机，每个插槽装有一颗四核CPU，对于Intel CPU而言还将启用超线程。2这意味着数据中心的标准系统将拥有最多64个虚拟处理器。更大的机器也会得到支持，但四插槽、四核的配置目前被认为是最佳平衡点，大多数优化都针对这类机器。

It is important to understand commodity hardware because specialized hardware is in retreat. Scaling these days is most often achieved horizontally instead of vertically, meaning today it is more cost-effective to use many smaller, connected commodity computers instead of a few really large and exceptionally fast (and expensive) systems. This is the case because fast and inexpensive network hardware is widely available. There are still situations where the large specialized systems have their place and these systems still provide a business opportunity, but the overall market is dwarfed by the commodity hardware market. Red Hat, as of 2007, expects that for future products, the “standard building blocks” for most data centers will be a computer with up to four sockets, each filled with a quad core CPU that, in the case of Intel CPUs, will be hyper-threaded.2 This means the standard system in the data center will have up to 64 virtual processors. Bigger machines will be supported, but the quad socket, quad CPU core case is currently thought to be the sweet spot and most optimizations are targeted for such machines.

由通用部件构建的计算机在结构上存在很大差异。话虽如此，只要关注最重要的差异，我们就能覆盖这类硬件的90%以上。请注意，这些技术细节往往变化很快，因此建议读者考虑到本文的写作日期。

Large differences exist in the structure of computers built of commodity parts. That said, we will cover more than 90% of such hardware by concentrating on the most important differences. Note that these technical details tend to change rapidly, so the reader is advised to take the date of this writing into account.

多年来，个人计算机和较小的服务器在芯片组上逐渐标准化为两部分：北桥和南桥。图2.1展示了这种结构。

Over the years personal computers and smaller servers standardized on a chipset with two parts: the Northbridge and Southbridge. Figure 2.1 shows this structure.

所有CPU（在上例中是两个，但也可以更多）都通过一条公共总线（前端总线，FSB）连接到北桥。北桥中除其他部件外还包含内存控制器，其实现决定了计算机所使用的RAM芯片类型。不同类型的RAM，例如DRAM、Rambus和SDRAM，需要不同的内存控制器。

All CPUs (two in the previous example, but there can be more) are connected via a common bus (the Front Side Bus, FSB) to the Northbridge. The Northbridge contains, among other things, the memory controller, and its implementation determines the type of RAM chips used for the computer. Different types of RAM, such as DRAM, Rambus, and SDRAM, require different memory controllers.

为了到达所有其他系统设备，北桥必须与南桥通信。南桥常被称为I/O桥，它通过各种不同的总线处理与设备的通信。如今最重要的是PCI、PCI Express、SATA和USB总线，但南桥也支持PATA、IEEE 1394、串口和并口。较老的系统有连接到北桥的AGP插槽。这样做是出于性能方面的原因，因为北桥与南桥之间的连接速度不够快。不过，如今PCI-E插槽都连接到南桥。

To reach all other system devices, the Northbridge must communicate with the Southbridge. The Southbridge, often referred to as the I/O bridge, handles communication with devices through a variety of different buses. Today the PCI, PCI Express, SATA, and USB buses are of most importance, but PATA, IEEE 1394, serial, and parallel ports are also supported by the Southbridge. Older systems had AGP slots which were attached to the Northbridge. This was done for performance reasons related to insufficiently fast connections between the Northbridge and Southbridge. However, today the PCI-E slots are all connected to the Southbridge.

这样的系统结构有若干值得注意的后果：

Such a system structure has a number of noteworthy consequences:

  • 从一个CPU到另一个CPU的所有数据通信，都必须经过与北桥通信所用的同一条总线。

    All data communication from one CPU to another must travel over the same bus used to communicate with the Northbridge.

  • 与RAM的所有通信都必须经过北桥。

    All communication with RAM must pass through the Northbridge.

  • RAM只有一个端口。3

    The RAM has only a single port.3

  • CPU与连接到南桥的设备之间的通信要经由北桥路由。

    Communication between a CPU and a device attached to the Southbridge is routed through the Northbridge.

这种设计中的几个瓶颈一目了然。其中一个瓶颈涉及设备对RAM的访问。在PC的最早期，与任一桥上设备的所有通信都必须经过CPU，这对整体系统性能产生了负面影响。为了解决这个问题，一些设备具备了直接内存访问（DMA）的能力。DMA使设备能够在北桥的帮助下，直接在RAM中存储和接收数据，而无需CPU的介入（以及随之而来的性能代价）。如今，连接到任何总线上的所有高性能设备都可以使用DMA。虽然这大大减轻了CPU的工作负担，但它也造成了对北桥带宽的争用，因为DMA请求要与来自CPU的RAM访问相互竞争。因此，这个问题必须加以考虑。

A couple of bottlenecks are immediately apparent in this design. One such bottleneck involves access to RAM for devices. In the earliest days of the PC, all communication with devices on either bridge had to pass through the CPU, negatively impacting overall system performance. To work around this problem some devices became capable of direct memory access (DMA). DMA allows devices, with the help of the Northbridge, to store and receive data in RAM directly without the intervention of the CPU (and its inherent performance cost). Today all high-performance devices attached to any of the buses can utilize DMA. While this greatly reduces the workload on the CPU, it also creates contention for the bandwidth of the Northbridge as DMA requests compete with RAM access from the CPUs. This problem, therefore, must be taken into account.

第二个瓶颈涉及从北桥到RAM的总线。该总线的确切细节取决于所部署的内存类型。在较老的系统上，只有一条总线通往所有RAM芯片，因此不可能并行访问。较新的RAM类型需要两条独立的总线（对于DDR2，它们被称为通道，见第8页），从而使可用带宽加倍。北桥在各通道之间交错进行内存访问。更新的内存技术（例如FB-DRAM）则增加了更多通道。

A second bottleneck involves the bus from the Northbridge to the RAM. The exact details of the bus depend on the memory types deployed. On older systems there is only one bus to all the RAM chips, so parallel access is not possible. Recent RAM types require two separate buses (or channels as they are called for DDR2, see page 8) which doubles the available bandwidth. The Northbridge interleaves memory access across the channels. More recent memory technologies (FB-DRAM, for instance) add more channels.

在可用带宽有限的情况下，以尽量减少延迟的方式调度内存访问，对性能而言非常重要。正如我们将看到的，处理器要快得多，即便使用了CPU缓存，它们也必须等待内存访问。如果多个超线程、内核或处理器同时访问内存，内存访问的等待时间就更长了。DMA操作也是如此。

With limited bandwidth available, it is important for performance to schedule memory access in ways that minimize delays. As we will see, processors are much faster and must wait to access memory, despite the use of CPU caches. If multiple hyper-threads, cores, or processors access memory at the same time, the wait times for memory access are even longer. This is also true for DMA operations.

不过，内存访问不仅仅关乎并发。访问模式本身也会极大地影响内存子系统的性能，尤其是在有多个内存通道的情况下。在2.2节中，我们将更详细地讨论RAM的访问模式。

There is more to accessing memory than concurrency, however. Access patterns themselves also greatly influence the performance of the memory subsystem, especially with multiple memory channels. In section 2.2 we will cover more details of RAM access patterns.

在一些更昂贵的系统上，北桥实际上并不包含内存控制器。相反，北桥可以连接到若干外部内存控制器（在下面的例子中是四个）。

On some more expensive systems, the Northbridge does not actually contain the memory controller. Instead the Northbridge can be connected to a number of external memory controllers (in the following example, four of them).

这种架构的优点是存在不止一条内存总线，因此总可用带宽增加了。这种设计还支持更多的内存。并发的内存访问模式通过同时访问不同的内存条来减少延迟。当多个处理器直接连接到北桥时尤其如此，如图2.2所示。对于这样的设计，主要的限制是北桥的内部带宽，而对于这种（Intel的）架构，这一带宽是惊人的。4

The advantage of this architecture is that more than one memory bus exists and therefore total available bandwidth increases. This design also supports more memory. Concurrent memory access patterns reduce delays by simultaneously accessing different memory banks. This is especially true when multiple processors are directly connected to the Northbridge, as in Figure 2.2. For such a design, the primary limitation is the internal bandwidth of the Northbridge, which is phenomenal for this architecture (from Intel).4

使用多个外部内存控制器并不是增加内存带宽的唯一方法。另一种日益流行的方法是将内存控制器集成到CPU中，并为每个CPU连接内存。这种架构因基于AMD Opteron处理器的SMP系统而流行起来。图2.3展示了这样一个系统。Intel将从Nehalem处理器开始支持公共系统接口（CSI）；这基本上是同样的方法：一个集成的内存控制器，每个处理器都可以拥有本地内存。

Using multiple external memory controllers is not the only way to increase memory bandwidth. One other increasingly popular way is to integrate memory controllers into the CPUs and attach memory to each CPU. This architecture is made popular by SMP systems based on AMD’s Opteron processor. Figure 2.3 shows such a system. Intel will have support for the Common System Interface (CSI) starting with the Nehalem processors; this is basically the same approach: an integrated memory controller with the possibility of local memory for each processor.

在这样的架构下，可用的内存条数量与处理器数量一样多。在一台四CPU的机器上，内存带宽变为四倍，而无需一个带宽巨大的复杂北桥。将内存控制器集成到CPU中还有一些其他优点；我们在此不深入探讨这项技术。

With an architecture like this there are as many memory banks available as there are processors. On a quad-CPU machine the memory bandwidth is quadrupled without the need for a complicated Northbridge with enormous bandwidth. Having a memory controller integrated into the CPU has some additional advantages; we will not dig deeper into this technology here.

这种架构也有缺点。首先，由于机器仍然必须使系统的所有内存对所有处理器都可访问，内存就不再是一致的了（因此这种架构被称为NUMA——非一致内存架构）。本地内存（连接到某个处理器的内存）可以以通常的速度访问。访问连接到另一个处理器的内存时，情况就不同了。在这种情况下，必须使用处理器之间的互连。从CPU1访问连接到CPU2的内存，需要经过一个互连进行通信。同一个CPU访问连接到CPU4的内存时，则必须跨越两个互连。

There are disadvantages to this architecture, too. First of all, because the machine still has to make all the memory of the system accessible to all processors, the memory is not uniform anymore (hence the name NUMA - Non-Uniform Memory Architecture - for such an architecture). Local memory (memory attached to a processor) can be accessed with the usual speed. The situation is different when memory attached to another processor is accessed. In this case the interconnects between the processors have to be used. To access memory attached to CPU2 from CPU1 requires communication across one interconnect. When the same CPU accesses memory attached to CPU4 two interconnects have to be crossed.

每次这样的通信都有相应的代价。当我们描述访问远程内存所需的额外时间时，我们称之为“NUMA因子”。图2.3中的示例架构对每个CPU有两个级别：紧邻的CPU，以及相隔两个互连的一个CPU。在更复杂的机器上，级别的数量可能显著增加。还有一些机器架构（例如IBM的x445和SGI的Altix系列）具有不止一种连接类型。CPU被组织成节点；在一个节点内部，访问内存的时间可能是一致的，或者只有很小的NUMA因子。不过，节点之间的连接可能非常昂贵，NUMA因子也可能相当高。

Each such communication has an associated cost. We talk about “NUMA factors” when we describe the extra time needed to access remote memory. The example architecture in Figure 2.3 has two levels for each CPU: immediately adjacent CPUs and one CPU which is two interconnects away. With more complicated machines the number of levels can grow significantly. There are also machine architectures (for instance IBM’s x445 and SGI’s Altix series) where there is more than one type of connection. CPUs are organized into nodes; within a node the time to access the memory might be uniform or have only small NUMA factors. The connection between nodes can be very expensive, though, and the NUMA factor can be quite high.

通用NUMA机器如今已经存在，并且在未来很可能发挥更大的作用。预计从2008年末起，每台SMP机器都将使用NUMA。与NUMA相关的代价使得识别程序何时运行在NUMA机器上变得很重要。在第5节中，我们将讨论更多的机器架构，以及Linux内核为这些程序提供的一些技术。

Commodity NUMA machines exist today and will likely play an even greater role in the future. It is expected that, from late 2008 on, every SMP machine will use NUMA. The costs associated with NUMA make it important to recognize when a program is running on a NUMA machine. In section 5 we will discuss more machine architectures and some technologies the Linux kernel provides for these programs.

除了本节其余部分所描述的技术细节之外，还有几个额外的因素会影响RAM的性能。它们不受软件控制，这就是本节没有涉及它们的原因。感兴趣的读者可以在2.1节中了解其中一些因素。只有在想更完整地了解RAM技术、或者在购买计算机时作出更好的决定时，才真正需要它们。

Beyond the technical details described in the remainder of this section, there are several additional factors which influence the performance of RAM. They are not controllable by software, which is why they are not covered in this section. The interested reader can learn about some of these factors in section 2.1. They are really only needed to get a more complete picture of RAM technology and possibly to make better decisions when purchasing computers.

接下来的两节讨论门级的硬件细节，以及内存控制器与DRAM芯片之间的访问协议。程序员很可能会觉得这些信息颇具启发性，因为这些细节解释了RAM访问为何以这种方式工作。不过，这是选读的知识，急于进入与日常工作更直接相关主题的读者可以直接跳到2.2.5节。

The following two sections discuss hardware details at the gate level and the access protocol between the memory controller and the DRAM chips. Programmers will likely find this information enlightening since these details explain why RAM access works the way it does. It is optional knowledge, though, and the reader anxious to get to topics with more immediate relevance for everyday life can jump ahead to section 2.2.5.

2.1 RAM的类型

2.1 RAM Types

多年来出现过许多类型的RAM，每种类型彼此之间都有差异，有时差异还很大。较老的类型如今实际上只有历史学家才会感兴趣。我们不会探讨它们的细节。相反，我们将专注于现代RAM类型；我们只会触及表面，探讨一些内核或应用程序开发者能通过其性能特征看到的细节。

There have been many types of RAM over the years and each type varies, sometimes significantly, from the other. The older types are today really only interesting to the historians. We will not explore the details of those. Instead we will concentrate on modern RAM types; we will only scrape the surface, exploring some details which are visible to the kernel or application developer through their performance characteristics.

第一批有趣的细节围绕这样一个问题：为什么同一台机器中会有不同类型的RAM？更具体地说，为什么既有静态RAM（SRAM5）又有动态RAM（DRAM）？前者要快得多，并且提供同样的功能。为什么机器中的RAM不全是SRAM？答案正如人们所料，是成本。SRAM的生产和使用成本都比DRAM高得多。这两个成本因素都很重要，而后者的重要性正日益增加。为了理解这些差异，我们来看看SRAM和DRAM中一个比特存储单元的实现。

The first interesting details are centered around the question why there are different types of RAM in the same machine. More specifically, why are there both static RAM (SRAM5) and dynamic RAM (DRAM). The former is much faster and provides the same functionality. Why is not all RAM in a machine SRAM? The answer is, as one might expect, cost. SRAM is much more expensive to produce and to use than DRAM. Both these cost factors are important, the second one increasing in importance more and more. To understand these differences we look at the implementation of a bit of storage for both SRAM and DRAM.

在本节的其余部分，我们将讨论RAM实现的一些底层细节。我们会尽量把细节层次保持在最低。为此，我们将在“逻辑层面”上讨论信号，而不是在硬件设计者必须使用的层面上。那种细节层次对于我们这里的目的来说是不必要的。

In the remainder of this section we will discuss some low-level details of the implementation of RAM. We will keep the level of detail as low as possible. To that end, we will discuss the signals at a “logic level” and not at a level a hardware designer would have to use. That level of detail is unnecessary for our purpose here.

2.1.1 静态RAM

2.1.1 Static RAM

图2.4展示了一个6晶体管SRAM单元的结构。该单元的核心由四个晶体管M1到M4构成，它们组成两个交叉耦合的反相器。它们有两个稳定状态，分别表示0和1。只要Vdd上有电源，该状态就是稳定的。

Figure 2.4 shows the structure of a 6 transistor SRAM cell. The core of this cell is formed by the four transistors M1 to M4 which form two cross-coupled inverters. They have two stable states, representing 0 and 1 respectively. The state is stable as long as power on Vdd is available.

如果需要访问该单元的状态，就把字访问线WL拉高。这使得单元的状态立即可在BL和BL上读取。如果必须改写单元的状态，就先把BL和BL线设置为所需的值，然后拉高WL。由于外部驱动器比四个晶体管（M1到M4）更强，这就能使旧状态被覆盖。

If access to the state of the cell is needed the word access line WL is raised. This makes the state of the cell immediately available for reading on BL and BL. If the cell state must be overwritten the BL and BL lines are first set to the desired values and then WL is raised. Since the outside drivers are stronger than the four transistors (M1 through M4) this allows the old state to be overwritten.

关于该单元工作方式的更详细描述，见[20]。对于下面的讨论，需要注意的重要几点是：

See [20] for a more detailed description of the way the cell works. For the following discussion it is important to note that

  • 一个单元需要六个晶体管。也有四晶体管的变体，但它们有缺点。

    one cell requires six transistors. There are variants with four transistors but they have disadvantages.

  • 维持单元的状态需要持续供电。

    maintaining the state of the cell requires constant power.

  • 一旦字访问线WL被拉高，单元状态几乎立即就可以读取。该信号与其他由晶体管控制的信号一样是矩形的（在两个二进制状态之间快速切换）。

    the cell state is available for reading almost immediately once the word access line WL is raised. The signal is as rectangular (changing quickly between the two binary states) as other transistor-controlled signals.

  • 单元状态是稳定的，不需要刷新周期。

    the cell state is stable, no refresh cycles are needed.

还有其他更慢、更省电的SRAM形式，但由于我们关注的是快速RAM，它们在这里不是我们关心的对象。这些慢速变体之所以令人感兴趣，主要是因为它们的接口更简单，比动态RAM更容易在系统中使用。

There are other, slower and less power-hungry, SRAM forms available, but those are not of interest here since we are looking at fast RAM. These slow variants are mainly interesting because they can be more easily used in a system than dynamic RAM because of their simpler interface.

2.1.2 动态RAM

2.1.2 Dynamic RAM

动态RAM在结构上比静态RAM简单得多。图2.5展示了一种常见DRAM单元设计的结构。它仅由一个晶体管和一个电容器组成。复杂度上的这一巨大差异当然意味着它的工作方式与静态RAM截然不同。

Dynamic RAM is, in its structure, much simpler than static RAM. Figure 2.5 shows the structure of a usual DRAM cell design. All it consists of is one transistor and one capacitor. This huge difference in complexity of course means that it functions very differently than static RAM.

动态RAM单元将其状态保存在电容器C中。晶体管M用于把守对该状态的访问。要读取单元的状态，就把访问线AL拉高；根据电容器中的电荷，这要么会使电流在数据线DL上流动，要么不会。要写入该单元，就适当地设置数据线DL，然后把AL拉高足够长的时间，以便给电容器充电或放电。

A dynamic RAM cell keeps its state in the capacitor C. The transistor M is used to guard the access to the state. To read the state of the cell the access line AL is raised; this either causes a current to flow on the data line DL or not, depending on the charge in the capacitor. To write to the cell the data line DL is appropriately set and then AL is raised for a time long enough to charge or drain the capacitor.

动态RAM的设计有许多复杂之处。使用电容器意味着读取单元会使电容器放电。这个过程不能无限重复，电容器必须在某个时刻重新充电。更糟糕的是，为了容纳海量的单元（拥有109个或更多单元的芯片如今很常见），电容器的容量必须很低（在飞法范围或更低）。一个充满电的电容器只能容纳几万个电子。尽管电容器的电阻很高（几太欧），电荷耗散所需的时间仍然很短。这个问题称为“漏电”。

There are a number of complications with the design of dynamic RAM. The use of a capacitor means that reading the cell discharges the capacitor. The procedure cannot be repeated indefinitely, the capacitor must be recharged at some point. Even worse, to accommodate the huge number of cells (chips with 109 or more cells are now common) the capacity to the capacitor must be low (in the femto-farad range or lower). A fully charged capacitor holds a few 10’s of thousands of electrons. Even though the resistance of the capacitor is high (a couple of tera-ohms) it only takes a short time for the capacity to dissipate. This problem is called “leakage”.

漏电正是DRAM单元必须不断刷新的原因。对于如今的大多数DRAM芯片，每64ms就必须刷新一次。在刷新周期内无法访问内存，因为刷新本质上就是一次结果被丢弃的内存读操作。对于某些工作负载，这项开销可能会使多达50%的内存访问停顿（见[3]）。

This leakage is why a DRAM cell must be constantly refreshed. For most DRAM chips these days this refresh must happen every 64ms. During the refresh cycle no access to the memory is possible since a refresh is simply a memory read operation where the result is discarded. For some workloads this overhead might stall up to 50% of the memory accesses (see [3]).

电荷极小所导致的第二个问题是，从单元中读出的信息不能直接使用。数据线必须连接到一个读出放大器，它能够在仍必须算作1的整个电荷范围内区分存储的是0还是1。

A second problem resulting from the tiny charge is that the information read from the cell is not directly usable. The data line must be connected to a sense amplifier which can distinguish between a stored 0 or 1 over the whole range of charges which still have to count as 1.

第三个问题是，读取一个单元会使电容器的电荷耗尽。这意味着每次读操作之后都必须跟随一次给电容器重新充电的操作。这是通过把读出放大器的输出反馈回电容器而自动完成的。不过，这确实意味着读取内存内容需要额外的能量，更重要的是需要额外的时间。

A third problem is that reading a cell causes the charge of the capacitor to be depleted. This means every read operation must be followed by an operation to recharge the capacitor. This is done automatically by feeding the output of the sense amplifier back into the capacitor. It does mean, though, the reading memory content requires additional energy and, more importantly, time.

第四个问题是，给电容器充电和放电并不是瞬间完成的。读出放大器接收到的信号不是矩形的，因此必须对单元输出何时可用采用保守的估计。电容器充电和放电的公式为

A fourth problem is that charging and draining a capacitor is not instantaneous. The signals received by the sense amplifier are not rectangular, so a conservative estimate as to when the output of the cell is usable has to be used. The formulas for charging and discharging a capacitor are

QCharge(t)=Q0(1−e−tRC)QDischarge(t)=Q0e−tRC

这意味着电容器的充电和放电需要一些时间（由电容C和电阻R决定）。这也意味着读出放大器能够检测到的电流并不能立即获得。图2.6展示了充电和放电曲线。X轴以RC（电阻乘以电容）为单位度量，RC是一个时间单位。

This means it takes some time (determined by the capacity C and resistance R) for the capacitor to be charged and discharged. It also means that the current which can be detected by the sense amplifiers is not immediately available. Figure 2.6 shows the charge and discharge curves. The X–axis is measured in units of RC (resistance multiplied by capacitance) which is a unit of time.

与静态RAM在字访问线被拉高时输出立即可用的情况不同，DRAM总是需要一点时间，直到电容器充分放电。这一延迟严重限制了DRAM所能达到的速度。

Unlike the static RAM case where the output is immediately available when the word access line is raised, it will always take a bit of time until the capacitor discharges sufficiently. This delay severely limits how fast DRAM can be.

这种简单的方法也有其优点。主要优点是尺寸。一个DRAM单元所需的芯片面积比一个SRAM单元小许多倍。SRAM单元还需要为维持状态的晶体管单独供电。DRAM单元的结构也更简单、更规整，这意味着在一块晶片上把许多单元紧密排列在一起更容易。

The simple approach has its advantages, too. The main advantage is size. The chip real estate needed for one DRAM cell is many times smaller than that of an SRAM cell. The SRAM cells also need individual power for the transistors maintaining the state. The structure of the DRAM cell is also simpler and more regular which means packing many of them close together on a die is simpler.

总的来说，（相当悬殊的）成本差异胜出。除了专用硬件——例如网络路由器——之外，我们不得不接受基于DRAM的主存。这对程序员有着巨大的影响，我们将在本文的其余部分讨论。但首先，我们需要再了解DRAM单元实际使用中的一些细节。

Overall, the (quite dramatic) difference in cost wins. Except in specialized hardware – network routers, for example – we have to live with main memory which is based on DRAM. This has huge implications on the programmer which we will discuss in the remainder of this paper. But first we need to look into a few more details of the actual use of DRAM cells.

2.1.3 DRAM访问

2.1.3 DRAM Access

程序使用虚拟地址来选择一个内存位置。处理器把它转换为物理地址，最后由内存控制器选择与该地址对应的RAM芯片。为了在RAM芯片上选中单个存储单元，物理地址的各部分以若干地址线的形式传递下去。

A program selects a memory location using a virtual address. The processor translates this into a physical address and finally the memory controller selects the RAM chip corresponding to that address. To select the individual memory cell on the RAM chip, parts of the physical address are passed on in the form of a number of address lines.

由内存控制器单独寻址各个内存位置是完全不切实际的：4GB的RAM将需要232条地址线。取而代之的是，地址以二进制数的形式编码，通过一组较少的地址线传递。以这种方式传给DRAM芯片的地址必须先进行解复用。一个有N条地址线的解复用器会有2N条输出线。这些输出线可以用来选择存储单元。对于小容量芯片，使用这种直接方法问题不大。

It would be completely impractical to address memory locations individually from the memory controller: 4GB of RAM would require 232 address lines. Instead the address is passed encoded as a binary number using a smaller set of address lines. The address passed to the DRAM chip this way must be demultiplexed first. A demultiplexer with N address lines will have 2N output lines. These output lines can be used to select the memory cell. Using this direct approach is no big problem for chips with small capacities.

但是，如果单元数量增长，这种方法就不再适用了。一个1Gbit6容量的芯片将需要30条地址线和230条选择线。在不牺牲速度的前提下，解复用器的大小随输入线数量呈指数增长。用于30条地址线的解复用器，除了解复用器本身的复杂度（尺寸和时间）之外，还需要大量的芯片面积。更重要的是，在地址线上同步传输30个脉冲，比“只”传输15个脉冲要困难得多。需要以完全相同的长度布设或进行适当定时的线路也更少。7

But if the number of cells grows this approach is not suitable anymore. A chip with 1Gbit6 capacity would need 30 address lines and 230 select lines. The size of a demultiplexer increases exponentially with the number of input lines when speed is not to be sacrificed. A demultiplexer for 30 address lines needs a whole lot of chip real estate in addition to the complexity (size and time) of the demultiplexer. Even more importantly, transmitting 30 impulses on the address lines synchronously is much harder than transmitting “only” 15 impulses. Fewer lines have to be laid out at exactly the same length or timed appropriately.7

图2.7从非常高的层面展示了一块DRAM芯片。DRAM单元按行和列组织。它们本可以全部排成一行，但那样的话DRAM芯片就需要一个巨大的解复用器。采用阵列方式，设计只需一个解复用器和一个复用器，各为原来规模的一半即可。8这在各方面都是巨大的节省。在本例中，地址线a0和a1通过行地址选择（RAS）9解复用器选中一整行单元的地址线。读取时，所有单元的内容由此可供列地址选择（CAS）9复用器使用。根据地址线a2和a3，随后某一列的内容被提供给DRAM芯片的数据引脚。这一过程在多块DRAM芯片上并行进行多次，从而产生与数据总线宽度相对应的总位数。

Figure 2.7 shows a DRAM chip at a very high level. The DRAM cells are organized in rows and columns. They could all be aligned in one row but then the DRAM chip would need a huge demultiplexer. With the array approach the design can get by with one demultiplexer and one multiplexer of half the size.8 This is a huge saving on all fronts. In the example the address lines a0 and a1 through the row address selection (RAS)9 demultiplexer select the address lines of a whole row of cells. When reading, the content of all cells is thusly made available to the column address selection (CAS)9 multiplexer. Based on the address lines a2 and a3 the content of one column is then made available to the data pin of the DRAM chip. This happens many times in parallel on a number of DRAM chips to produce a total number of bits corresponding to the width of the data bus.

写入时，新的单元值被放到数据总线上，当使用RAS和CAS选中该单元时，它就被存储到单元中。这是一个相当直截了当的设计。现实中——显然——还有许多复杂之处。需要规定信号发出后要延迟多久，数据才会出现在数据总线上供读取。正如上一节所述，电容器不会瞬间放电。来自单元的信号非常微弱，需要放大。对于写入，必须规定在RAS和CAS完成之后数据必须在总线上保持多久，才能成功地把新值存入单元（同样，电容器不会瞬间充满或放空）。这些时序常数对DRAM芯片的性能至关重要。我们将在下一节讨论这一点。

For writing, the new cell value is put on the data bus and, when the cell is selected using the RAS and CAS, it is stored in the cell. A pretty straightforward design. There are in reality – obviously – many more complications. There need to be specifications for how much delay there is after the signal before the data will be available on the data bus for reading. The capacitors do not unload instantaneously, as described in the previous section. The signal from the cells is so weak that it needs to be amplified. For writing it must be specified how long the data must be available on the bus after the RAS and CAS is done to successfully store the new value in the cell (again, capacitors do not fill or drain instantaneously). These timing constants are crucial for the performance of the DRAM chip. We will talk about this in the next section.

第二个可扩展性问题是，让每块RAM芯片都连接30条地址线也是不可行的。芯片的引脚是宝贵的资源。数据必须尽可能并行传输（例如以64位为一批）就已经够“糟”了。内存控制器必须能够寻址每个RAM模块（RAM芯片的集合）。如果出于性能原因需要并行访问多个RAM模块，而每个RAM模块都需要自己的一组30条或更多的地址线，那么对于8个RAM模块，内存控制器仅用于地址处理就需要多达240多个引脚。

A secondary scalability problem is that having 30 address lines connected to every RAM chip is not feasible either. Pins of a chip are precious resources. It is “bad” enough that the data must be transferred as much as possible in parallel (e.g., in 64 bit batches). The memory controller must be able to address each RAM module (collection of RAM chips). If parallel access to multiple RAM modules is required for performance reasons and each RAM module requires its own set of 30 or more address lines, then the memory controller needs to have, for 8 RAM modules, a whopping 240+ pins only for the address handling.

为了应对这些次要的可扩展性问题，DRAM芯片长期以来都对地址本身进行复用。这意味着地址分两部分传输。第一部分由地址位（图2.7例子中的a0和a1）组成，用于选择行。这一选择在被撤销之前一直有效。然后第二部分，即地址位a2和a3，选择列。关键的区别在于只需要两条外部地址线。还需要另外几条线来指示RAS和CAS信号何时可用，但与把地址线数量减半相比，这只是很小的代价。不过，这种地址复用也带来了它自己的一系列问题。我们将在2.2节中讨论它们。

To counter these secondary scalability problems DRAM chips have, for a long time, multiplexed the address itself. That means the address is transferred in two parts. The first part consisting of address bits (a0 and a1 in the example in Figure 2.7) select the row. This selection remains active until revoked. Then the second part, address bits a2 and a3, select the column. The crucial difference is that only two external address lines are needed. A few more lines are needed to indicate when the RAS and CAS signals are available but this is a small price to pay for cutting the number of address lines in half. This address multiplexing brings its own set of problems, though. We will discuss them in section 2.2.

2.1.4 结论

2.1.4 Conclusions

如果本节中的细节有点让人应接不暇，请不必担心。本节需要记住的重要几点是：

Do not worry if the details in this section are a bit overwhelming. The important things to take away from this section are:

  • 并非所有内存都是SRAM是有原因的

    there are reasons why not all memory is SRAM

  • 存储单元需要被单独选中才能使用

    memory cells need to be individually selected to be used

  • 地址线的数量直接决定了内存控制器、主板、DRAM模块和DRAM芯片的成本

    the number of address lines is directly responsible for the cost of the memory controller, motherboards, DRAM module, and DRAM chip

  • 读或写操作的结果需要一段时间才能获得

    it takes a while before the results of the read or write operation are available

下一节将更详细地讨论访问DRAM内存的实际过程。我们不会深入讨论访问SRAM的更多细节，SRAM通常是直接寻址的。这样做是为了速度，也因为SRAM内存的容量有限。SRAM目前用于CPU缓存和片上存储，在那里连接很短，并且完全在CPU设计者的掌控之下。CPU缓存是我们稍后会讨论的话题，但我们现在需要知道的只是：SRAM单元有一定的最高速度，这取决于在SRAM上所投入的努力。其速度可以从仅比CPU内核略慢，到慢一两个数量级不等。

The following section will go into more details about the actual process of accessing DRAM memory. We are not going into more details of accessing SRAM, which is usually directly addressed. This happens for speed and because the SRAM memory is limited in size. SRAM is currently used in CPU caches and on-die where the connections are small and fully under control of the CPU designer. CPU caches are a topic which we discuss later but all we need to know is that SRAM cells have a certain maximum speed which depends on the effort spent on the SRAM. The speed can vary from only slightly slower than the CPU core to one or two orders of magnitude slower.

2.2 DRAM访问的技术细节

2.2 DRAM Access Technical Details

在介绍DRAM的那一节中我们看到，DRAM芯片对地址进行复用，以节省地址引脚形式的资源。我们还看到，访问DRAM单元需要时间，因为这些单元中的电容器不会瞬间放电从而产生稳定的信号；我们也看到DRAM单元必须刷新。现在是时候把这些都放在一起，看看所有这些因素如何决定DRAM访问必须以何种方式进行。

In the section introducing DRAM we saw that DRAM chips multiplex the addresses in order to save resources in the form of address pins. We also saw that accessing DRAM cells takes time since the capacitors in those cells do not discharge instantaneously to produce a stable signal; we also saw that DRAM cells must be refreshed. Now it is time to put this all together and see how all these factors determine how the DRAM access has to happen.

我们将专注于当前的技术；我们不讨论异步DRAM及其变体，因为它们已经根本不再相关了。对这一话题感兴趣的读者可参阅[3]和[19]。我们也不讨论Rambus DRAM（RDRAM），尽管这项技术并未过时。它只是没有被广泛用于系统内存。我们将只专注于同步DRAM（SDRAM）及其后继者双倍数据速率DRAM（DDR）。

We will concentrate on current technology; we will not discuss asynchronous DRAM and its variants as they are simply not relevant anymore. Readers interested in this topic are referred to [3] and [19]. We will also not talk about Rambus DRAM (RDRAM) even though the technology is not obsolete. It is just not widely used for system memory. We will concentrate exclusively on Synchronous DRAM (SDRAM) and its successors Double Data Rate DRAM (DDR).

同步DRAM，顾名思义，是相对于一个时间源工作的。内存控制器提供一个时钟，其频率决定了前端总线（FSB）——DRAM芯片所使用的内存控制器接口——的速度。在撰写本文时，800MHz、1,066MHz甚至1,333MHz的频率均已可用，更高的频率（1,600MHz）已宣布将用于下一代产品。这并不意味着总线上实际使用的频率有这么高。相反，如今的总线是双泵或四泵的，即每个周期传输两次或四次数据。数字越大越好卖，因此制造商喜欢把一条四泵200MHz总线宣传为“有效”800MHz总线。

Synchronous DRAM, as the name suggests, works relative to a time source. The memory controller provides a clock, the frequency of which determines the speed of the Front Side Bus (FSB) – the memory controller interface used by the DRAM chips. As of this writing, frequencies of 800MHz, 1,066MHz, or even 1,333MHz are available with higher frequencies (1,600MHz) being announced for the next generation. This does not mean the frequency used on the bus is actually this high. Instead, today’s buses are double- or quad-pumped, meaning that data is transported two or four times per cycle. Higher numbers sell so the manufacturers like to advertise a quad-pumped 200MHz bus as an “effective” 800MHz bus.

对于如今的SDRAM，每次数据传输包含64位——8字节。因此FSB的传输速率是8字节乘以有效总线频率（对于四泵200MHz总线为6.4GB/s）。这听起来很多，但它是突发速度，即永远不会被超越的最高速度。正如我们现在将看到的，与RAM模块通信的协议有大量无法传输数据的停顿时间。为了获得最佳性能，我们必须理解并尽量减少的正是这些停顿时间。

For SDRAM today each data transfer consists of 64 bits – 8 bytes. The transfer rate of the FSB is therefore 8 bytes multiplied by the effective bus frequency (6.4GB/s for the quad-pumped 200MHz bus). That sounds a lot but it is the burst speed, the maximum speed which will never be surpassed. As we will see now the protocol for talking to the RAM modules has a lot of downtime when no data can be transmitted. It is exactly this downtime which we must understand and minimize to achieve the best performance.

2.2.1 读访问协议

2.2.1 Read Access Protocol

图2.8展示了DRAM模块某些连接器上的活动，这些活动分为三个颜色不同的阶段。照例，时间从左向右流动。许多细节被省略了。这里我们只讨论总线时钟、RAS和CAS信号，以及地址总线和数据总线。一个读周期开始于内存控制器把行地址放到地址总线上并拉低RAS信号。所有信号都在时钟（CLK）的上升沿被读取，因此只要信号在被读取时是稳定的，它不完全是方波也没有关系。设置行地址会使RAM芯片开始锁存被寻址的行。

Figure 2.8 shows the activity on some of the connectors of a DRAM module which happens in three differently colored phases. As usual, time flows from left to right. A lot of details are left out. Here we only talk about the bus clock, RAS and CAS signals, and the address and data buses. A read cycle begins with the memory controller making the row address available on the address bus and lowering the RAS signal. All signals are read on the rising edge of the clock (CLK) so it does not matter if the signal is not completely square as long as it is stable at the time it is read. Setting the row address causes the RAM chip to start latching the addressed row.

CAS信号可以在tRCD（RAS到CAS延迟）个时钟周期之后发出。然后，通过把列地址放到地址总线上并拉低CAS线来传输列地址。在这里我们可以看到，地址的两部分（大致各为一半，别的划分都没有意义）是如何通过同一条地址总线传输的。

The CAS signal can be sent after tRCD (RAS-to-CAS Delay) clock cycles. The column address is then transmitted by making it available on the address bus and lowering the CAS line. Here we can see how the two parts of the address (more or less halves, nothing else makes sense) can be transmitted over the same address bus.

现在寻址完成，数据可以传输了。RAM芯片需要一些时间为此做准备。这一延迟通常称为CAS延迟（CL）。在图2.8中，CAS延迟为2。根据内存控制器、主板和DRAM模块的质量，它可以更高或更低。延迟也可以取半值。若CL=2.5，第一个数据将在蓝色区域的第一个下降沿可用。

Now the addressing is complete and the data can be transmitted. The RAM chip needs some time to prepare for this. The delay is usually called CAS Latency (CL). In Figure 2.8 the CAS latency is 2. It can be higher or lower, depending on the quality of the memory controller, motherboard, and DRAM module. The latency can also have half values. With CL=2.5 the first data would be available at the first falling flank in the blue area.

为了获取数据做了这么多准备，如果只传输一个数据字就太浪费了。这就是为什么DRAM模块允许内存控制器指定要传输多少数据。通常可选的是2、4或8个字。这使得无需新的RAS/CAS序列就能填满缓存中的整行。内存控制器也可以在不重置行选择的情况下发送新的CAS信号。这样，连续的内存地址可以被显著更快地读取或写入，因为不必发送RAS信号，行也不必被停用（见下文）。是否让行保持“打开”，是内存控制器必须作出的决定。对于现实中的应用程序，投机性地一直让它保持打开是有缺点的（见[3]）。发送新的CAS信号只受RAM模块的命令速率约束（通常规定为Tx，其中x是像1或2这样的值；对于每个周期都接受新命令的高性能DRAM模块，它将是1）。

With all this preparation to get to the data it would be wasteful to only transfer one data word. This is why DRAM modules allow the memory controller to specify how much data is to be transmitted. Often the choice is between 2, 4, or 8 words. This allows filling entire lines in the caches without a new RAS/CAS sequence. It is also possible for the memory controller to send a new CAS signal without resetting the row selection. In this way, consecutive memory addresses can be read from or written to significantly faster because the RAS signal does not have to be sent and the row does not have to be deactivated (see below). Keeping the row “open” is something the memory controller has to decide. Speculatively leaving it open all the time has disadvantages with real-world applications (see [3]). Sending new CAS signals is only subject to the Command Rate of the RAM module (usually specified as Tx, where x is a value like 1 or 2; it will be 1 for high-performance DRAM modules which accept new commands every cycle).

在这个例子中，SDRAM每个周期输出一个字。第一代就是这样做的。DDR每个周期能够传输两个字。这缩短了传输时间，但并不改变延迟。原则上，DDR2的工作方式相同，尽管在实践中它看起来不一样。这里没有必要深入细节。只需指出DDR2可以做得更快、更便宜、更可靠，并且更节能就够了（更多信息见[6]）。

In this example the SDRAM spits out one word per cycle. This is what the first generation does. DDR is able to transmit two words per cycle. This cuts down on the transfer time but does not change the latency. In principle, DDR2 works the same although in practice it looks different. There is no need to go into the details here. It is sufficient to note that DDR2 can be made faster, cheaper, more reliable, and is more energy efficient (see [6] for more information).

2.2.2 预充电与激活

2.2.2 Precharge and Activation

图2.8并没有涵盖整个周期。它只展示了访问DRAM的完整周期的一部分。在可以发送新的RAS信号之前，当前被锁存的行必须被停用，新行必须被预充电。这里我们可以专注于通过显式命令完成这一操作的情况。协议有一些改进，在某些情况下可以避免这一额外步骤。不过，预充电所引入的延迟仍然会影响操作。

Figure 2.8 does not cover the whole cycle. It only shows parts of the full cycle of accessing DRAM. Before a new RAS signal can be sent the currently latched row must be deactivated and the new row must be precharged. We can concentrate here on the case where this is done with an explicit command. There are improvements to the protocol which, in some situations, allows this extra step to be avoided. The delays introduced by precharging still affect the operation, though.

图2.9展示了从一个CAS信号到另一行的CAS信号之间的活动。用第一个CAS信号请求的数据与前面一样，在CL个周期之后可用。在这个例子中请求了两个字，在简单的SDRAM上传输它们需要两个周期。或者，可以想象在DDR芯片上传输四个字。

Figure 2.9 shows the activity starting from one CAS signal to the CAS signal for another row. The data requested with the first CAS signal is available as before, after CL cycles. In the example two words are requested which, on a simple SDRAM, takes two cycles to transmit. Alternatively, imagine four words on a DDR chip.

即便是在命令速率为1的DRAM模块上，预充电命令也不能立即发出。必须等待传输数据所需的时间。在这个例子中需要两个周期。这恰好与CL相同，但那只是巧合。预充电信号没有专用的线路；相反，一些实现通过同时拉低写使能（WE）线和RAS线来发出它。这种组合本身没有任何有用的含义（编码细节见[18]）。

Even on DRAM modules with a command rate of one the precharge command cannot be issued right away. It is necessary to wait as long as it takes to transmit the data. In this case it takes two cycles. This happens to be the same as CL but that is just a coincidence. The precharge signal has no dedicated line; instead, some implementations issue it by lowering the Write Enable (WE) and RAS line simultaneously. This combination has no useful meaning by itself (see [18] for encoding details).

一旦发出预充电命令，需要经过tRP（行预充电时间）个周期才能选择该行。在图2.9中，大部分时间（用紫色表示）与内存传输（浅蓝色）重叠。这很好！但tRP比传输时间长，因此下一个RAS信号被推迟了一个周期。

Once the precharge command is issued it takes tRP (Row Precharge time) cycles until the row can be selected. In Figure 2.9 much of the time (indicated by the purplish color) overlaps with the memory transfer (light blue). This is good! But tRP is larger than the transfer time and so the next RAS signal is stalled for one cycle.

如果我们把图中的时间线继续画下去，就会发现下一次数据传输发生在上一次传输停止5个周期之后。这意味着数据总线在七个周期中只有两个周期在使用。把这一点乘以FSB速度，800MHz总线理论上的6.4GB/s就变成了1.8GB/s。这很糟糕，必须避免。第6节中描述的技术有助于提高这个数字。但程序员通常也必须尽自己的一份力。

If we were to continue the timeline in the diagram we would find that the next data transfer happens 5 cycles after the previous one stops. This means the data bus is only in use two cycles out of seven. Multiply this with the FSB speed and the theoretical 6.4GB/s for a 800MHz bus become 1.8GB/s. That is bad and must be avoided. The techniques described in section 6 help to raise this number. But the programmer usually has to do her share.

SDRAM模块还有一个我们尚未讨论的时序值。在图2.9中，预充电命令只受数据传输时间的限制。另一个约束是，SDRAM模块在发出RAS信号之后，需要一段时间才能对另一行进行预充电（记为tRAS）。这个数值通常相当大，大约是tRP值的两到三倍。如果在一个RAS信号之后只跟着一个CAS信号，并且数据传输在几个周期内就完成了，这就成了问题。假设在图2.9中，最初的CAS信号之前直接是一个RAS信号，并且tRAS为8个周期。那么预充电命令就必须再推迟一个周期，因为tRCD、CL和tRP（因为它大于数据传输时间）之和只有7个周期。

There is one more timing value for a SDRAM module which we have not discussed. In Figure 2.9 the precharge command was only limited by the data transfer time. Another constraint is that an SDRAM module needs time after a RAS signal before it can precharge another row (denoted as tRAS). This number is usually pretty high, in the order of two or three times the tRP value. This is a problem if, after a RAS signal, only one CAS signal follows and the data transfer is finished in a few cycles. Assume that in Figure 2.9 the initial CAS signal was preceded directly by a RAS signal and that tRAS is 8 cycles. Then the precharge command would have to be delayed by one additional cycle since the sum of tRCD, CL, and tRP (since it is larger than the data transfer time) is only 7 cycles.

DDR模块常用一种特殊记法来描述：w-x-y-z-T。例如：2-3-2-8-T1。其含义是：

DDR modules are often described using a special notation: w-x-y-z-T. For instance: 2-3-2-8-T1. This means:

w2CAS延迟（CL）
CAS Latency (CL)
x3RAS到CAS延迟（tRCD）
RAS-to-CAS delay (tRCD)
y2RAS预充电（tRP）
RAS Precharge (tRP)
z8激活到预充电延迟（tRAS）
Active to Precharge delay (tRAS)
TT1命令速率
Command Rate

还有许多其他时序常数会影响命令的发出和处理方式。不过，在实践中这五个常数足以确定模块的性能。

There are numerous other timing constants which affect the way commands can be issued and are handled. Those five constants are in practice sufficient to determine the performance of the module, though.

为了能够解释某些测量结果，了解所用计算机的这些信息有时是有用的。在购买计算机时了解这些细节则绝对是有用的，因为它们与FSB和SDRAM模块速度一起，是决定计算机速度的最重要因素之一。

It is sometimes useful to know this information for the computers in use to be able to interpret certain measurements. It is definitely useful to know these details when buying computers since they, along with the FSB and SDRAM module speed, are among the most important factors determining a computer’s speed.

非常喜欢冒险的读者还可以尝试调校系统。有时BIOS允许修改其中部分或全部数值。SDRAM模块具有可编程寄存器，可以在其中设置这些值。通常BIOS会选择最佳默认值。如果RAM模块质量很高，也许可以在不影响计算机稳定性的情况下降低某一项或另一项延迟。互联网上众多的超频网站提供了大量相关文档。不过，这样做风险自负，别说没有警告过你。

The very adventurous reader could also try to tweak a system. Sometimes the BIOS allows changing some or all these values. SDRAM modules have programmable registers where these values can be set. Usually the BIOS picks the best default value. If the quality of the RAM module is high it might be possible to reduce the one or the other latency without affecting the stability of the computer. Numerous overclocking websites all around the Internet provide ample of documentation for doing this. Do it at your own risk, though and do not say you have not been warned.

2.2.3 重新充电

2.2.3 Recharging

谈到DRAM访问，一个经常被忽视的话题是重新充电。正如2.1.2节所解释的，DRAM单元必须不断刷新。这对系统的其余部分来说并不是完全透明的。当某一行10正在重新充电时，无法进行任何访问。[3]中的研究发现，“出人意料的是，DRAM的刷新组织方式会极大地影响性能”。

A mostly-overlooked topic when it comes to DRAM access is recharging. As explained in section 2.1.2, DRAM cells must constantly be refreshed. This does not happen completely transparently for the rest of the system. At times when a row10 is recharged no access is possible. The study in [3] found that “[s]urprisingly, DRAM refresh organization can affect performance dramatically”.

根据JEDEC（联合电子器件工程委员会）规范，每个DRAM单元必须每64ms刷新一次。如果一个DRAM阵列有8,192行，这意味着内存控制器平均每7.8125µs就必须发出一次刷新命令（刷新命令可以排队，因此在实践中两次请求之间的最大间隔可以更长）。调度刷新命令是内存控制器的责任。DRAM模块会记录最后一个被刷新行的地址，并为每个新请求自动递增地址计数器。

Each DRAM cell must be refreshed every 64ms according to the JEDEC (Joint Electron Device Engineering Council) specification. If a DRAM array has 8,192 rows this means the memory controller has to issue a refresh command on average every 7.8125µs (refresh commands can be queued so in practice the maximum interval between two requests can be higher). It is the memory controller’s responsibility to schedule the refresh commands. The DRAM module keeps track of the address of the last refreshed row and automatically increases the address counter for each new request.

对于刷新以及发出命令的时间点，程序员实在做不了什么。但在解释测量结果时，记住DRAM生命周期中的这一部分很重要。如果必须从一个正在刷新的行中取出一个关键字，处理器可能会停顿相当长的时间。每次刷新需要多长时间取决于DRAM模块。

There is really not much the programmer can do about the refresh and the points in time when the commands are issued. But it is important to keep this part of the DRAM life cycle in mind when interpreting measurements. If a critical word has to be retrieved from a row which currently is being refreshed the processor could be stalled for quite a long time. How long each refresh takes depends on the DRAM module.

2.2.4 内存类型

2.2.4 Memory Types

值得花些时间了解一下当前正在使用以及即将使用的内存类型。我们将从SDR（单倍数据速率）SDRAM开始，因为它们是DDR（双倍数据速率）SDRAM的基础。SDR相当简单。存储单元的速率与数据传输速率是相同的。

It is worth spending some time on the current and soon-to-be current memory types in use. We will start with SDR (Single Data Rate) SDRAMs since they are the basis of the DDR (Double Data Rate) SDRAMs. SDRs were pretty simple. The memory cells and the data transfer rate were identical.

在图2.10中，DRAM单元阵列能以内存总线所能传输的相同速率输出内存内容。如果DRAM单元阵列能以100MHz工作，那么单个单元的总线数据传输速率就是100Mb/s。所有组件的频率f都相同。提高DRAM芯片的吞吐量代价高昂，因为能耗随频率上升。对于海量的阵列单元而言，这代价高得令人望而却步。11实际上，问题还要更严重，因为提高频率通常还需要提高电压以维持系统的稳定性。DDR SDRAM（后来被称为DDR1）设法在不提高任何相关频率的情况下提高了吞吐量。

In Figure 2.10 the DRAM cell array can output the memory content at the same rate it can be transported over the memory bus. If the DRAM cell array can operate at 100MHz, the data transfer rate of the bus of a single cell is thus 100Mb/s. The frequency f for all components is the same. Increasing the throughput of the DRAM chip is expensive since the energy consumption rises with the frequency. With a huge number of array cells this is prohibitively expensive.11 In reality it is even more of a problem since increasing the frequency usually also requires increasing the voltage to maintain stability of the system. DDR SDRAM (called DDR1 retroactively) manages to improve the throughput without increasing any of the involved frequencies.

SDR与DDR1的区别，正如在图2.11中可以看到、也可以从名称中猜到的那样，在于每个周期传输的数据量是原来的两倍。也就是说，DDR1芯片在上升沿和下降沿都传输数据。这有时被称为“双泵”总线。为了在不提高单元阵列频率的情况下实现这一点，必须引入一个缓冲区。这个缓冲区为每条数据线保存两位。这反过来又要求图2.7的单元阵列中数据总线由两条线组成。实现这一点很简单：只需对两个DRAM单元使用相同的列地址，并并行访问它们即可。为实现这一点对单元阵列所作的改动也很小。

The difference between SDR and DDR1 is, as can be seen in Figure 2.11 and guessed from the name, that twice the amount of data is transported per cycle. I.e., the DDR1 chip transports data on the rising and falling edge. This is sometimes called a “double-pumped” bus. To make this possible without increasing the frequency of the cell array a buffer has to be introduced. This buffer holds two bits per data line. This in turn requires that, in the cell array in Figure 2.7, the data bus consists of two lines. Implementing this is trivial: one only has to use the same column address for two DRAM cells and access them in parallel. The changes to the cell array to implement this are also minimal.

SDR DRAM仅以其频率来称呼（例如，100MHz SDR称为PC100）。为了让DDR1 DRAM听起来更好，由于频率没有变化，市场营销人员不得不想出一套新的命名方案。他们想出的名称包含DDR模块（它们有64位总线）所能维持的以字节计的传输速率：

The SDR DRAMs were known simply by their frequency (e.g., PC100 for 100MHz SDR). To make DDR1 DRAM sound better the marketers had to come up with a new scheme since the frequency did not change. They came with a name which contains the transfer rate in bytes a DDR module (they have 64-bit busses) can sustain:

100MHz×64bit×2=1,600MB/s

因此，频率为100MHz的DDR模块被称为PC1600。由于1600 > 100，所有营销需求都得到了满足；它听起来好得多，尽管改进实际上只是两倍而已。12

Hence a DDR module with 100MHz frequency is called PC1600. With 1600 > 100 all marketing requirements are fulfilled; it sounds much better although the improvement is really only a factor of two.12

为了从内存技术中榨取更多性能，DDR2引入了更多的创新。从图2.12中可以看出，最明显的变化是总线频率加倍。频率加倍意味着带宽加倍。由于对单元阵列而言，频率加倍并不经济，现在要求I/O缓冲区在每个时钟周期获取四位，然后再把它们发送到总线上。这意味着对DDR2模块的改动只在于让DIMM的I/O缓冲区组件能够以更高的速度运行。这当然是可能的，并且不会需要明显更多的能量，因为它只是一个很小的组件，而不是整个模块。营销人员为DDR2想出的名称与DDR1的名称类似，只是在计算数值时把因子2换成了4（我们现在有了四泵总线）。表2.1列出了如今正在使用的模块名称。

To get even more out of the memory technology DDR2 includes a bit more innovation. The most obvious change that can be seen in Figure 2.12 is the doubling of the frequency of the bus. Doubling the frequency means doubling the bandwidth. Since this doubling of the frequency is not economical for the cell array it is now required that the I/O buffer gets four bits in each clock cycle which it then can send on the bus. This means the changes to the DDR2 modules consist of making only the I/O buffer component of the DIMM capable of running at higher speeds. This is certainly possible and will not require measurably more energy, it is just one tiny component and not the whole module. The names the marketers came up with for DDR2 are similar to the DDR1 names only in the computation of the value the factor of two is replaced by four (we now have a quad-pumped bus). Table 2.1 shows the names of the modules in use today.

命名还有一处转折。CPU、主板和DRAM模块所使用的FSB速度是用有效频率来规定的。也就是说，它计入了在时钟周期两个沿上的传输，从而夸大了数字。因此，一个带266MHz总线的133MHz模块，其FSB“频率”为533MHz。

There is one more twist to the naming. The FSB speed used by CPU, motherboard, and DRAM module is specified by using the effective frequency. I.e., it factors in the transmission on both flanks of the clock cycle and thereby inflates the number. So, a 133MHz module with a 266MHz bus has an FSB “frequency” of 533MHz.

DDR3（真正的DDR3，而不是显卡中使用的冒牌GDDR3）的规范要求沿着向DDR2过渡的方向作出更多改变。电压将从DDR2的1.8V降低到DDR3的1.5V。由于功耗公式是用电压的平方计算的，仅此一项就带来30%的改进。再加上晶片尺寸的缩小以及其他电气方面的进步，DDR3在相同频率下能够以一半的功耗运行。或者，在更高的频率下，可以达到相同的功耗包络。或者，以两倍的容量达到相同的散热量。

The specification for DDR3 (the real one, not the fake GDDR3 used in graphics cards) calls for more changes along the lines of the transition to DDR2. The voltage will be reduced from 1.8V for DDR2 to 1.5V for DDR3. Since the power consumption equation is calculated using the square of the voltage this alone brings a 30% improvement. Add to this a reduction in die size plus other electrical advances and DDR3 can manage, at the same frequency, to get by with half the power consumption. Alternatively, with higher frequencies, the same power envelope can be hit. Or with double the capacity the same heat emission can be achieved.

DDR3模块的单元阵列将以外部总线速度的四分之一运行，这需要一个8位的I/O缓冲区，比DDR2的4位有所增加。原理图见图2.13。

The cell array of DDR3 modules will run at a quarter of the speed of the external bus which requires an 8 bit I/O buffer, up from 4 bits for DDR2. See Figure 2.13 for the schematics.

最初，DDR3模块的CAS延迟可能会略高一些，仅仅是因为DDR2技术更成熟。这将使得DDR3只有在高于DDR2所能达到的频率时才有用，即便如此，也主要是在带宽比延迟更重要的时候。已经有人在谈论能够达到与DDR2相同CAS延迟的1.3V模块。无论如何，由于总线更快而获得更高速度的可能性，将会超过延迟增加带来的影响。

Initially DDR3 modules will likely have slightly higher CAS latencies just because the DDR2 technology is more mature. This would cause DDR3 to be useful only at frequencies which are higher than those which can be achieved with DDR2, and, even then, mostly when bandwidth is more important than latency. There is already talk about 1.3V modules which can achieve the same CAS latency as DDR2. In any case, the possibility of achieving higher speeds because of faster buses will outweigh the increased latency.

DDR3一个可能的问题是，对于1,600Mb/s或更高的传输速率，每个通道的模块数可能会减少到只有一个。在早期版本中，这一要求适用于所有频率，因此人们可以希望这一要求在某个时候对所有频率都被取消。否则，系统的容量将受到严重限制。

One possible problem with DDR3 is that, for 1,600Mb/s transfer rate or higher, the number of modules per channel may be reduced to just one. In earlier versions this requirement held for all frequencies, so one can hope that the requirement will at some point be lifted for all frequencies. Otherwise the capacity of systems will be severely limited.

表2.2列出了我们可能会看到的DDR3模块的名称。到目前为止，JEDEC已就前四种类型达成一致。鉴于Intel的45nm处理器的FSB速度为1,600Mb/s，1,866Mb/s是超频市场所需要的。在DDR3生命周期接近尾声时，我们很可能会看到更多此类产品。

Table 2.2 shows the names of the DDR3 modules we are likely to see. JEDEC agreed so far on the first four types. Given that Intel’s 45nm processors have an FSB speed of 1,600Mb/s, the 1,866Mb/s is needed for the overclocking market. We will likely see more of this towards the end of the DDR3 lifecycle.

所有DDR内存都有一个问题：总线频率的提高使得构建并行数据总线变得困难。一个DDR2模块有240个引脚。所有到数据引脚和地址引脚的连接都必须这样布线：使它们的长度大致相同。更麻烦的是，如果要在同一条总线上菊花链式连接不止一个DDR模块，每增加一个模块，信号的失真就越来越严重。DDR2规范只允许每条总线（又称通道）上有两个模块，DDR3规范在高频率下只允许一个模块。由于每个通道有240个引脚，单个北桥无法合理地驱动两个以上的通道。另一种选择是使用外部内存控制器（如图2.2所示），但这很昂贵。

All DDR memory has one problem: the increased bus frequency makes it hard to create parallel data busses. A DDR2 module has 240 pins. All connections to data and address pins must be routed so that they have approximately the same length. Even more of a problem is that, if more than one DDR module is to be daisy-chained on the same bus, the signals get more and more distorted for each additional module. The DDR2 specification allow only two modules per bus (aka channel), the DDR3 specification only one module for high frequencies. With 240 pins per channel a single Northbridge cannot reasonably drive more than two channels. The alternative is to have external memory controllers (as in Figure 2.2) but this is expensive.

这意味着通用主板最多只能容纳四个DDR2或DDR3模块。这一限制严重限制了系统所能拥有的内存数量。即使是老旧的32位IA-32处理器也能处理64GB的RAM，而且即使是家庭用途的内存需求也在增长，所以必须做点什么。

What this means is that commodity motherboards are restricted to hold at most four DDR2 or DDR3 modules. This restriction severely limits the amount of memory a system can have. Even old 32-bit IA-32 processors can handle 64GB of RAM and memory demand even for home use is growing, so something has to be done.

一个解决办法是像第2节所解释的那样，把内存控制器加入到每个处理器中。AMD在Opteron产品线上这样做了，Intel也将通过其CSI技术这样做。只要处理器能够使用的合理数量的内存可以连接到单个处理器上，这就会有所帮助。在某些情况下情况并非如此，而这种配置将引入NUMA架构及其负面影响。在某些情况下需要另一种解决方案。

One answer is to add memory controllers into each processor as explained in section 2. AMD does it with the Opteron line and Intel will do it with their CSI technology. This will help as long as the reasonable amount of memory a processor is able to use can be connected to a single processor. In some situations this is not the case and this setup will introduce a NUMA architecture and its negative effects. For some situations another solution is needed.

Intel针对大型服务器机器的这一问题的解决方案，至少目前，称为全缓冲DRAM（FB-DRAM）。FB-DRAM模块使用与当今DDR2模块相同的内存芯片，这使得它们的生产成本相对较低。区别在于与内存控制器的连接方式。FB-DRAM不使用并行数据总线，而是使用串行总线（Rambus DRAM早在当年就有这个，SATA是PATA的后继者，PCI Express是PCI/AGP的后继者，也是如此）。串行总线可以在高得多的频率下驱动，从而扭转串行化的负面影响，甚至提高带宽。使用串行总线的主要效果是

Intel’s answer to this problem for big server machines, at least at the moment, is called Fully Buffered DRAM (FB-DRAM). The FB-DRAM modules use the same memory chips as today’s DDR2 modules which makes them relatively cheap to produce. The difference is in the connection with the memory controller. Instead of a parallel data bus FB-DRAM utilizes a serial bus (Rambus DRAM had this back when, too, and SATA is the successor of PATA, as is PCI Express for PCI/AGP). The serial bus can be driven at a much higher frequency, reverting the negative impact of the serialization and even increasing the bandwidth. The main effects of using a serial bus are

  1. 每个通道可以使用更多模块。

    more modules per channel can be used.

  2. 每个北桥/内存控制器可以使用更多通道。

    more channels per Northbridge/memory controller can be used.

  3. 串行总线被设计为全双工的（两条线）。

    the serial bus is designed to be fully-duplex (two lines).

  4. 实现差分总线（每个方向两条线）的成本足够低，从而可以提高速度。

    it is cheap enough to implement a differential bus (two lines in each direction) and so increase the speed.

与DDR2的240个引脚相比，一个FB-DRAM模块只有69个引脚。菊花链式连接FB-DRAM模块要容易得多，因为总线的电气效应可以得到好得多的处理。FB-DRAM规范允许每个通道最多8个DRAM模块。

An FB-DRAM module has only 69 pins, compared with the 240 for DDR2. Daisy chaining FB-DRAM modules is much easier since the electrical effects of the bus can be handled much better. The FB-DRAM specification allows up to 8 DRAM modules per channel.

与双通道北桥的连接需求相比，现在可以用更少的引脚驱动6个FB-DRAM通道：2×240个引脚对比6×69个引脚。每个通道的布线也简单得多，这也有助于降低主板的成本。

Compared with the connectivity requirements of a dual-channel Northbridge it is now possible to drive 6 channels of FB-DRAM with fewer pins: 2×240 pins versus 6×69 pins. The routing for each channel is much simpler which could also help reducing the cost of the motherboards.

对于传统DRAM模块，全双工并行总线的成本高得令人望而却步，把所有这些线路都复制一遍代价太大。对于串行线路（即使像FB-DRAM所要求的那样是差分的），情况并非如此，因此串行总线被设计为全双工的，这意味着在某些情况下，仅此一项就使带宽在理论上翻了一番。但这并不是唯一利用并行性来提高带宽的地方。由于一个FB-DRAM控制器可以同时运行多达六个通道，即使对于RAM容量较小的系统，使用FB-DRAM也可以提高带宽。在一个有四个模块的DDR2系统有两个通道的地方，使用普通的FB-DRAM控制器可以通过四个通道来处理相同的容量。串行总线的实际带宽取决于FB-DRAM模块上所使用的DDR2（或DDR3）芯片的类型。

Fully duplex parallel busses are prohibitively expensive for the traditional DRAM modules, duplicating all those lines is too costly. With serial lines (even if they are differential, as FB-DRAM requires) this is not the case and so the serial bus is designed to be fully duplexed, which means, in some situations, that the bandwidth is theoretically doubled alone by this. But it is not the only place where parallelism is used for bandwidth increase. Since an FB-DRAM controller can run up to six channels at the same time the bandwidth can be increased even for systems with smaller amounts of RAM by using FB-DRAM. Where a DDR2 system with four modules has two channels, the same capacity can be handled via four channels using an ordinary FB-DRAM controller. The actual bandwidth of the serial bus depends on the type of DDR2 (or DDR3) chips used on the FB-DRAM module.

我们可以把优势总结如下：

We can summarize the advantages like this:

DDR2FB-DRAM
引脚 Pins24069
通道 Channels26
每通道DIMM数 DIMMs/Channel28
最大内存13 Max Memory16GB14192GB
吞吐量15 Throughput~10GB/s~40GB/s

如果在一个通道上使用多个DIMM，FB-DRAM会有一些缺点。信号在链上的每个DIMM处都会被延迟——尽管只是极小的延迟——从而增加了延迟。第二个问题是，由于频率非常高并且需要驱动总线，驱动串行总线的芯片需要相当多的能量。但对于相同频率下相同数量的内存，FB-DRAM总是可以比DDR2和DDR3更快，因为多达四个DIMM中的每一个都可以拥有自己的通道；对于大内存系统，DDR使用通用组件根本无法应对。

There are a few drawbacks to FB-DRAMs if multiple DIMMs on one channel are used. The signal is delayed–albeit minimally–at each DIMM in the chain, thereby increasing the latency. A second problem is that the chip driving the serial bus requires significant amounts of energy because of the very high frequency and the need to drive a bus. But for the same amount of memory with the same frequency FB-DRAM can always be faster than DDR2 and DDR3 since the up-to four DIMMS can each get their own channel; for large memory systems DDR simply has no answer using commodity components.

2.2.5 结论

2.2.5 Conclusions

本节应该已经表明，访问DRAM并不是一个可以任意快的过程。至少，与处理器运行的速度以及它访问寄存器和缓存的速度相比并不快。必须牢记CPU频率与内存频率之间的差异。一颗运行在2.933GHz的Intel Core 2处理器与1.066GHz的FSB，其时钟比为11:1（注意：1.066GHz总线是四泵的）。内存总线上每停顿一个周期，就意味着处理器停顿11个周期。对于大多数机器，实际使用的DRAM更慢，从而进一步增加了延迟。在接下来的各节中讨论停顿时，请记住这些数字。

This section should have shown that accessing DRAM is not an arbitrarily fast process. At least not fast compared with the speed the processor is running and with which it can access registers and cache. It is important to keep in mind the differences between CPU and memory frequencies. An Intel Core 2 processor running at 2.933GHz and a 1.066GHz FSB have a clock ratio of 11:1 (note: the 1.066GHz bus is quad-pumped). Each stall of one cycle on the memory bus means a stall of 11 cycles for the processor. For most machines the actual DRAMs used are slower, thusly increasing the delay. Keep these numbers in mind when we are talking about stalls in the upcoming sections.

读命令的时序图表明，DRAM模块能够维持很高的持续数据速率。整个DRAM行可以在没有任何停顿的情况下传输。数据总线可以保持100%的占用。对于DDR模块，这意味着每个周期传输两个64位字。对于DDR2-800模块和两个通道，这意味着12.8GB/s的速率。

The timing charts for the read command have shown that DRAM modules are capable of high sustained data rates. Entire DRAM rows could be transported without a single stall. The data bus could be kept occupied 100%. For DDR modules this means two 64-bit words transferred each cycle. With DDR2-800 modules and two channels this means a rate of 12.8GB/s.

但是，除非专门这样设计，DRAM访问并不总是顺序的。程序会使用不连续的内存区域，这意味着需要预充电和新的RAS信号。这时速度就会变慢，DRAM模块就需要帮助了。预充电越早发生、RAS信号越早发出，在实际使用该行时的代价就越小。

But, unless designed this way, DRAM access is not always sequential. Non-continuous memory regions are used which means precharging and new RAS signals are needed. This is when things slow down and when the DRAM modules need help. The sooner the precharging can happen and the RAS signal sent the smaller the penalty when the row is actually used.

硬件预取和软件预取（见6.3节）可以用来在时序上创造更多的重叠，减少停顿。预取还有助于在时间上转移内存操作，从而在稍后、即实际需要数据之前的那一刻减少争用。当一轮中产生的数据必须被存储、而下一轮所需的数据必须被读取时，这是一个常见的问题。通过在时间上提前读取，写操作和读操作就不必在基本相同的时间发出。

Hardware and software prefetching (see section 6.3) can be used to create more overlap in the timing and reduce the stall. Prefetching also helps shift memory operations in time so that there is less contention at later times, right before the data is actually needed. This is a frequent problem when the data produced in one round has to be stored and the data required for the next round has to be read. By shifting the read in time, the write and read operations do not have to be issued at basically the same time.

2.3 其他主存使用者

2.3 Other Main Memory Users

除了CPU之外，还有其他系统组件可以访问主存。网络和大容量存储控制器等高性能卡负担不起把它们需要或提供的所有数据都经由CPU传递。相反，它们直接从主存读取或向主存写入数据（直接内存访问，DMA）。从图2.1中可以看到，这些卡可以通过南桥和北桥直接与内存通信。其他总线，例如USB，也需要FSB带宽——即使它们不使用DMA——因为南桥也是经由北桥、通过FSB连接到处理器的。

Beside CPUs there are other system components which can access the main memory. High-performance cards such as network and mass-storage controllers cannot afford to pipe all the data they need or provide through the CPU. Instead, they read or write the data directly from/to the main memory (Direct Memory Access, DMA). In Figure 2.1 we can see that the cards can talk through the South- and Northbridge directly with the memory. Other buses, like USB, also require FSB bandwidth–even if they do not use DMA–since the Southbridge is connected via the Northbridge to the processor through the FSB, too.

虽然DMA无疑是有益的，但它意味着对FSB带宽的竞争更加激烈。在DMA流量很大的时候，CPU在等待来自主存的数据时可能会比平时停顿得更多。只要有合适的硬件，就有办法绕过这个问题。在图2.3那样的架构中，可以确保计算使用不受DMA影响的节点上的内存。也可以为每个节点连接一个南桥，把负载均匀地分布到所有节点的FSB上。可能性多种多样。在第6节中，我们将介绍有助于实现软件中可能的改进的技术和编程接口。

While DMA is certainly beneficial, it means that there is more competition for the FSB bandwidth. In times with high DMA traffic the CPU might stall more than usual while waiting for data from the main memory. There are ways around this given the right hardware. With an architecture as in Figure 2.3 one can make sure the computation uses memory on nodes which are not affected by DMA. It is also possible to attach a Southbridge to each node, equally distributing the load on the FSB of all the nodes. There are a myriad of possibilities. In section 6 we will introduce techniques and programming interfaces which help achieving the improvements which are possible in software.

最后应当提到，一些廉价系统的图形系统没有单独的专用显存。这些系统把主存的一部分用作显存。由于对显存的访问很频繁（对于一个以60Hz刷新的1024x768、16bpp的显示器，我们说的是94MB/s），而且系统内存与显卡上的RAM不同，没有两个端口，这会严重影响系统的性能，尤其是延迟。在性能优先的情况下，最好忽略这类系统。它们带来的麻烦比价值更多。购买这些机器的人知道他们不会得到最好的性能。

Finally it should be mentioned that some cheap systems have graphics systems without separate, dedicated video RAM. Those systems use parts of the main memory as video RAM. Since access to the video RAM is frequent (for a 1024x768 display with 16 bpp at 60Hz we are talking 94MB/s) and system memory, unlike RAM on graphics cards, does not have two ports this can substantially influence the systems performance and especially the latency. It is best to ignore such systems when performance is a priority. They are more trouble than they are worth. People buying those machines know they will not get the best performance.

  1. ↑ 超线程使单个处理器内核只需少量额外硬件，就能用于两个或更多的并发执行。

    ↑ Hyper-threading enables a single processor core to be used for two or more concurrent executions with just a little extra hardware.

  2. ↑ 本文不讨论多端口RAM，因为这类RAM在通用硬件中找不到，至少在程序员可以接触到的地方找不到。它可以在网络路由器等依赖极致速度的专用硬件中找到。

    ↑ We will not discuss multi-port RAM in this document as this type of RAM is not found in commodity hardware, at least not in places where the programmer has access to it. It can be found in specialized hardware such as network routers which depend on utmost speed.

  3. ↑ 为完整起见应当提到，这种内存控制器布局还可用于其他目的，例如“内存RAID”，它与热插拔内存结合使用时很有用。

    ↑ For completeness it should be mentioned that such a memory controller arrangement can be used for other purposes such as “memory RAID” which is useful in combination with hotplug memory.

  4. ↑ 在其他语境中，SRAM可能指“同步RAM”。

    ↑ In other contexts SRAM might mean “synchronous RAM”.

  5. ↑ 我讨厌那些SI前缀。对我来说，一个吉比特永远是230位，而不是109位。

    ↑ I hate those SI prefixes. For me a giga-bit will always be 230 and not 109 bits.

  6. ↑ 像DDR3这样的现代DRAM类型可以自动调整时序，但可容忍的范围是有限的。

    ↑ Modern DRAM types like DDR3 can automatically adjust the timing but there is a limit as to what can be tolerated.

  7. ↑ 复用器和解复用器是等价的，这里的复用器在写入时需要作为解复用器工作。因此从现在起我们将不再加以区分。

    ↑ Multiplexers and demultiplexers are equivalent and the multiplexer here needs to work as a demultiplexer when writing. So we will drop the differentiation from now on.

  8. ↑ ↑ 名称上方的横线表示该信号是取反的。

    ↑ ↑ The line over the name indicates that the signal is negated.

  9. ↑ 尽管[3]和其他文献另有说法，但刷新正是以行为粒度进行的（见[18]）。

    ↑ Rows are the granularity this happens with despite what [3] and other literature says (see [18]).

    ↑ Power = Dynamic Capacity × Voltage2 × Frequency.

    ↑ I will take the factor of two but I do not have to like the inflated numbers.

    Assuming 4GB modules.

  13. ↑ Intel的一份演示文稿出于某种我无法理解的原因说是8GB……

3 CPU缓存

3 CPU Caches

CPU如今比仅仅25年前复杂得多。在那时，CPU内核的频率与内存总线的频率处于同一水平。内存访问只比寄存器访问慢一点点。但这种情况在90年代初发生了剧变，CPU设计者提高了CPU内核的频率，而内存总线的频率和RAM芯片的性能却没有成比例地提高。正如上一节所解释的，这并不是因为无法制造更快的RAM。这是可能的，但并不经济。与当前CPU内核一样快的RAM，比任何动态RAM都要贵上几个数量级。

CPUs are today much more sophisticated than they were only 25 years ago. In those days, the frequency of the CPU core was at a level equivalent to that of the memory bus. Memory access was only a bit slower than register access. But this changed dramatically in the early 90s, when CPU designers increased the frequency of the CPU core but the frequency of the memory bus and the performance of RAM chips did not increase proportionally. This is not due to the fact that faster RAM could not be built, as explained in the previous section. It is possible but it is not economical. RAM as fast as current CPU cores is orders of magnitude more expensive than any dynamic RAM.

如果要在一台只有极少量、极快RAM的机器和一台有大量相对快速RAM的机器之间作出选择，只要工作集大小超过了那一小块RAM的大小，并考虑到访问硬盘等二级存储介质的代价，后者总是会胜出。这里的问题在于二级存储（通常是硬盘）的速度，它必须用来容纳工作集中被换出的部分。访问这些磁盘比访问DRAM还要慢几个数量级。

If the choice is between a machine with very little, very fast RAM and a machine with a lot of relatively fast RAM, the second will always win given a working set size which exceeds the small RAM size and the cost of accessing secondary storage media such as hard drives. The problem here is the speed of secondary storage, usually hard disks, which must be used to hold the swapped out part of the working set. Accessing those disks is orders of magnitude slower than even DRAM access.

幸运的是，这不必是一个全有或全无的决定。计算机除了大量的DRAM之外，还可以有少量的高速SRAM。一种可能的实现是：把处理器地址空间中的某一区域专门用于SRAM，其余部分用于DRAM。这样，操作系统的任务就是以最优方式分配数据，以充分利用SRAM。基本上，在这种情况下SRAM充当了处理器寄存器组的扩展。

Fortunately it does not have to be an all-or-nothing decision. A computer can have a small amount of high-speed SRAM in addition to the large amount of DRAM. One possible implementation would be to dedicate a certain area of the address space of the processor as containing the SRAM and the rest the DRAM. The task of the operating system would then be to optimally distribute data to make use of the SRAM. Basically, the SRAM serves in this situation as an extension of the register set of the processor.

虽然这是一种可能的实现，但它并不可行。撇开把这种由SRAM支持的内存的物理资源映射到进程虚拟地址空间的问题不谈（这本身就极其困难），这种方法还要求每个进程在软件中管理这块内存区域的分配。内存区域的大小可能因处理器而异（即处理器拥有不同数量的、昂贵的SRAM支持的内存）。构成程序一部分的每个模块都会争夺它在快速内存中的份额，这又会因同步需求而带来额外的开销。简而言之，拥有快速内存的收益将被管理这些资源的开销完全吞噬。

While this is a possible implementation it is not viable. Ignoring the problem of mapping the physical resources of such SRAM-backed memory to the virtual address spaces of the processes (which by itself is terribly hard) this approach would require each process to administer in software the allocation of this memory region. The size of the memory region can vary from processor to processor (i.e., processors have different amounts of the expensive SRAM-backed memory). Each module which makes up part of a program will claim its share of the fast memory, which introduces additional costs through synchronization requirements. In short, the gains of having fast memory would be eaten up completely by the overhead of administering the resources.

因此，SRAM并没有置于操作系统或用户的控制之下，而是成为一种由处理器透明地使用和管理的资源。在这种模式下，SRAM被用来为主存中很可能马上就会被处理器使用的数据制作临时副本（换句话说，就是缓存这些数据）。之所以可能做到这一点，是因为程序代码和数据具有时间局部性和空间局部性。这意味着，在短时间内，同样的代码或数据很有可能被重复使用。对于代码而言，这意味着代码中很可能有循环，使得同样的代码被一遍又一遍地执行（这是空间局部性的完美情况）。理想情况下，数据访问也局限于小的区域。即使在短时间内使用的内存并不相邻，同样的数据也很有可能在不久之后被重用（时间局部性）。对于代码而言，这意味着，例如，在一个循环中进行了一次函数调用，而该函数位于地址空间的其他地方。函数在内存中可能很远，但对该函数的调用在时间上是接近的。对于数据而言，这意味着一次所使用的内存总量（工作集大小）理想情况下是有限的，但由于RAM随机访问的特性，所使用的内存并不相邻。认识到局部性的存在，是我们今天所使用的CPU缓存这一概念的关键。

So, instead of putting the SRAM under the control of the OS or user, it becomes a resource which is transparently used and administered by the processors. In this mode, SRAM is used to make temporary copies of (to cache, in other words) data in main memory which is likely to be used soon by the processor. This is possible because program code and data has temporal and spatial locality. This means that, over short periods of time, there is a good chance that the same code or data gets reused. For code this means that there are most likely loops in the code so that the same code gets executed over and over again (the perfect case for spatial locality). Data accesses are also ideally limited to small regions. Even if the memory used over short time periods is not close together there is a high chance that the same data will be reused before long (temporal locality). For code this means, for instance, that in a loop a function call is made and that function is located elsewhere in the address space. The function may be distant in memory, but calls to that function will be close in time. For data it means that the total amount of memory used at one time (the working set size) is ideally limited but the memory used, as a result of the random access nature of RAM, is not close together. Realizing that locality exists is key to the concept of CPU caches as we use them today.

一个简单的计算可以表明缓存在理论上能有多有效。假设访问主存需要200个周期，访问缓存需要15个周期。那么，使用100个数据元素、每个使用100次的代码，在没有缓存的情况下将花费2,000,000个周期在内存操作上，而如果所有数据都能被缓存，则只需168,500个周期。这是91.5%的改进。

A simple computation can show how effective caches can theoretically be. Assume access to main memory takes 200 cycles and access to the cache memory take 15 cycles. Then code using 100 data elements 100 times each will spend 2,000,000 cycles on memory operations if there is no cache and only 168,500 cycles if all data can be cached. That is an improvement of 91.5%.

用于缓存的SRAM比主存小许多倍。根据作者在带CPU缓存的工作站上的经验，缓存大小一直约为主存大小的1/1000（如今：4MB缓存和4GB主存）。仅这一点本身并不构成问题。如果工作集（当前正在处理的数据集合）的大小小于缓存大小，那就无关紧要。但计算机拥有大容量主存并不是没有原因的。工作集必然会比缓存大。对于运行多个进程的系统尤其如此，其工作集的大小是所有单个进程和内核大小之和。

The size of the SRAM used for caches is many times smaller than the main memory. In the author’s experience with workstations with CPU caches the cache size has always been around 1/1000th of the size of the main memory (today: 4MB cache and 4GB main memory). This alone does not constitute a problem. If the size of the working set (the set of data currently worked on) is smaller than the cache size it does not matter. But computers do not have large main memories for no reason. The working set is bound to be larger than the cache. This is especially true for systems running multiple processes where the size of the working set is the sum of the sizes of all the individual processes and the kernel.

为了应对缓存大小有限的问题，需要一套好的策略来决定在任一给定时刻应当缓存什么。由于工作集中的所有数据并不是在完全相同的时间被使用，我们可以利用一些技术，临时用其他数据替换缓存中的某些数据。也许这甚至可以在实际需要这些数据之前完成。这种预取会消除访问主存的部分代价，因为它相对于程序的执行是异步发生的。所有这些以及更多的技术都可以用来使缓存看起来比实际更大。我们将在3.3节中讨论它们。一旦所有这些技术都被利用，就轮到程序员来帮助处理器了。如何做到这一点将在第6节中讨论。

What is needed to deal with the limited size of the cache is a set of good strategies to determine what should be cached at any given time. Since not all data of the working set is used at exactly the same time we can use techniques to temporarily replace some data in the cache with others. And maybe this can be done before the data is actually needed. This prefetching would remove some of the costs of accessing main memory since it happens asynchronously with respect to the execution of the program. All these techniques and more can be used to make the cache appear bigger than it actually is. We will discuss them in section 3.3. Once all these techniques are exploited it is up to the programmer to help the processor. How this can be done will be discussed in section 6.

3.1 全局视角下的CPU缓存

3.1 CPU Caches in the Big Picture

在深入探讨CPU缓存实现的技术细节之前，一些读者可能会发现，先更详细地了解缓存如何融入现代计算机系统的“全局”是有用的。

Before diving into technical details of the implementation of CPU caches some readers might find it useful to first see in some more details how caches fit into the “big picture” of a modern computer system.

图3.1展示了最小的缓存配置。它对应于早期部署CPU缓存的系统中可以找到的架构。CPU内核不再直接连接到主存。16所有的加载和存储都必须经过缓存。CPU内核与缓存之间的连接是一条特殊的快速连接。在简化的表示中，主存和缓存连接到系统总线，系统总线也可以用于与系统的其他组件通信。我们曾把系统总线称为“FSB”，这是如今使用的名称；见2.2节。在本节中我们忽略北桥；假定它存在，以便CPU与主存之间的通信。

Figure 3.1 shows the minimum cache configuration. It corresponds to the architecture which could be found in early systems which deployed CPU caches.
