The CPU core is no longer directly connected to the main memory.16 All loads and stores have to go through the cache. The connection between the CPU core and the cache is a special, fast connection. In a simplified representation, the main memory and the cache are connected to the system bus which can also be used for communication with other components of the system. We introduced the system bus as “FSB” which is the name in use today; see section 2.2. In this section we ignore the Northbridge; it is assumed to be present to facilitate the communication of the CPU(s) with the main memory.

尽管过去几十年来大多数计算机都使用冯·诺依曼架构，但经验表明，把用于代码和用于数据的缓存分开是有好处的。Intel从1993年起就使用分离的代码缓存和数据缓存，再也没有回头。代码和数据所需的内存区域彼此几乎是独立的，这就是独立的缓存效果更好的原因。近年来又出现了另一个优点：对于最常见的处理器，指令解码步骤很慢；缓存解码后的指令可以加快执行速度，尤其是当流水线因预测错误或无法预测的分支而变空时。

Even though most computers for the last several decades have used the von Neumann architecture, experience has shown that it is of advantage to separate the caches used for code and for data. Intel has used separate code and data caches since 1993 and never looked back. The memory regions needed for code and data are pretty much independent of each other, which is why independent caches work better. In recent years another advantage emerged: the instruction decoding step for the most common processors is slow; caching decoded instructions can speed up the execution, especially when the pipeline is empty due to incorrectly predicted or impossible-to-predict branches.

缓存引入后不久，系统变得更加复杂。缓存与主存之间的速度差异再次扩大，以至于又增加了一级缓存，它比第一级缓存更大、更慢。出于经济原因，仅仅增大第一级缓存的大小是不可行的。如今，甚至有机器在常规使用中拥有三级缓存。带有这种处理器的系统如图3.2所示。随着单个CPU中内核数量的增加，未来缓存的级数可能还会增加。

Soon after the introduction of the cache the system got more complicated. The speed difference between the cache and the main memory increased again, to a point that another level of cache was added, bigger and slower than the first-level cache. Only increasing the size of the first-level cache was not an option for economical reasons. Today, there are even machines with three levels of cache in regular use. A system with such a processor looks like Figure 3.2. With the increase on the number of cores in a single CPU the number of cache levels might increase in the future even more.

图3.2展示了三级缓存，并引入了本文其余部分将使用的命名法。L1d是一级数据缓存，L1i是一级指令缓存，等等。注意这只是一个示意图；在现实中，数据从内核到主存的流动不必经过任何更高级别的缓存。CPU设计者在设计缓存接口方面有很大的自由。对于程序员来说，这些设计选择是不可见的。

Figure 3.2 shows three levels of cache and introduces the nomenclature we will use in the remainder of the document. L1d is the level 1 data cache, L1i the level 1 instruction cache, etc. Note that this is a schematic; the data flow in reality need not pass through any of the higher-level caches on the way from the core to the main memory. CPU designers have a lot of freedom designing the interfaces of the caches. For programmers these design choices are invisible.

此外，我们还有拥有多个内核的处理器，每个内核可以有多个“线程”。内核与线程的区别在于，不同的内核拥有（几乎17）所有硬件资源的独立副本。除非同时使用相同的资源——例如对外的连接——否则各内核可以完全独立地运行。而线程则共享处理器的几乎所有资源。Intel的线程实现只为各线程提供了独立的寄存器，而且即便如此也是有限的，有些寄存器是共享的。因此，现代CPU的完整图景如图3.3所示。

In addition we have processors which have multiple cores and each core can have multiple “threads”. The difference between a core and a thread is that separate cores have separate copies of (almost17) all the hardware resources. The cores can run completely independently unless they are using the same resources–e.g., the connections to the outside–at the same time. Threads, on the other hand, share almost all of the processor’s resources. Intel’s implementation of threads has only separate registers for the threads and even that is limited, some registers are shared. The complete picture for a modern CPU therefore looks like Figure 3.3.

在这幅图中，我们有两个处理器，每个处理器有两个内核，每个内核有两个线程。线程共享一级缓存。内核（以较深的灰色表示）拥有各自的一级缓存。CPU的所有内核共享更高级别的缓存。两个处理器（以较浅灰色表示的两个大方框）当然不共享任何缓存。所有这些都很重要，尤其是在我们讨论缓存对多进程和多线程应用程序的影响时。

In this figure we have two processors, each with two cores, each of which has two threads. The threads share the Level 1 caches. The cores (shaded in the darker gray) have individual Level 1 caches. All cores of the CPU share the higher-level caches. The two processors (the two big boxes shaded in the lighter gray) of course do not share any caches. All this will be important, especially when we are discussing the cache effects on multi-process and multi-thread applications.

3.2 高层次的缓存操作

3.2 Cache Operation at High Level

为了理解使用缓存的代价和节省，我们必须把第2节中关于机器架构和RAM技术的知识，与上一节描述的缓存结构结合起来。

To understand the costs and savings of using a cache we have to combine the knowledge about the machine architecture and RAM technology from section 2 with the structure of caches described in the previous section.

默认情况下，CPU内核读取或写入的所有数据都存储在缓存中。有些内存区域是不能被缓存的，但这只是操作系统实现者需要关心的事情；对应用程序员来说它是不可见的。也有一些指令允许程序员有意绕过某些缓存。这将在第6节中讨论。

By default all data read or written by the CPU cores is stored in the cache. There are memory regions which cannot be cached but this is something only the OS implementers have to be concerned about; it is not visible to the application programmer. There are also instructions which allow the programmer to deliberately bypass certain caches. This will be discussed in section 6.

如果CPU需要一个数据字，首先会搜索缓存。显然，缓存不可能包含整个主存的内容（否则我们就不需要缓存了），但由于所有内存地址都是可缓存的，每个缓存条目都用该数据字在主存中的地址加以标记。这样，读取或写入某个地址的请求就可以在缓存中搜索匹配的标记。在这里，地址可以是虚拟地址，也可以是物理地址，这取决于缓存的实现。

If the CPU needs a data word the caches are searched first. Obviously, the cache cannot contain the content of the entire main memory (otherwise we would need no cache), but since all memory addresses are cacheable, each cache entry is tagged using the address of the data word in the main memory. This way a request to read or write to an address can search the caches for a matching tag. The address in this context can be either the virtual or physical address, varying based on the cache implementation.

由于标记除了实际的内存之外还需要额外的空间，选择一个字作为缓存的粒度是低效的。对于x86机器上的一个32位字，标记本身可能就需要32位或更多。此外，由于空间局部性是缓存所依据的原则之一，不考虑这一点就不好了。由于相邻的内存很可能会被一起使用，它也应该被一起加载到缓存中。还请记住我们在2.2.1节中学到的：如果RAM模块可以在不需要新的CAS甚至RAS信号的情况下连续传输许多数据字，它们的效率就会高得多。因此，存储在缓存中的条目不是单个的字，而是由若干连续的字组成的“行”。在早期的缓存中，这些行长32字节；如今的标准是64字节。如果内存总线宽64位，这意味着每个缓存行需要8次传输。DDR能高效地支持这种传输模式。

Since for the tag, in addition to the actual memory, additional space is required, it is inefficient to chose a word as the granularity of the cache. For a 32-bit word on an x86 machine the tag itself might need 32 bits or more. Furthermore, since spatial locality is one of the principles on which caches are based, it would be bad to not take this into account. Since neighboring memory is likely to be used together it should also be loaded into the cache together. Remember also what we learned in section 2.2.1: RAM modules are much more effective if they can transport many data words in a row without a new CAS or even RAS signal. So the entries stored in the caches are not single words but, instead, “lines” of several contiguous words. In early caches these lines were 32 bytes long; nowadays the norm is 64 bytes. If the memory bus is 64 bits wide this means 8 transfers per cache line. DDR supports this transport mode efficiently.

当处理器需要内存内容时，整个缓存行都被加载到L1d中。每个缓存行的内存地址是通过根据缓存行大小对地址值进行掩码计算得出的。对于64字节的缓存行，这意味着低6位被清零。被丢弃的位用作缓存行内的偏移量。在某些情况下，其余的位被用来在缓存中定位该行，并用作标记。在实践中，一个地址值被分成三部分。对于32位地址，它可能如下所示：

When memory content is needed by the processor the entire cache line is loaded into the L1d. The memory address for each cache line is computed by masking the address value according to the cache line size. For a 64 byte cache line this means the low 6 bits are zeroed. The discarded bits are used as the offset into the cache line. The remaining bits are in some cases used to locate the line in the cache and as the tag. In practice an address value is split into three parts. For a 32-bit address it might look as follows:

310
标记 Tag缓存组 Cache Set偏移 Offset
TSO

当缓存行大小为2O时，低O位用作缓存行内的偏移量。接下来的S位选择“缓存组”。我们很快就会更详细地说明为什么缓存行使用组而不是单个槽位。目前只需理解存在2S个缓存行组即可。剩下的最高32 − S − O = T位构成标记。这T位是与每个缓存行相关联的值，用于区分缓存在同一缓存组中的所有别名18。用于寻址缓存组的S位不必存储，因为同一组中所有缓存行的这些位都相同。

With a cache line size of 2O the low O bits are used as the offset into the cache line. The next S bits select the “cache set”. We will go into more detail soon on why sets, and not single slots, are used for cache lines. For now it is sufficient to understand there are 2S sets of cache lines. This leaves the top 32 − S − O = T bits which form the tag. These T bits are the value associated with each cache line to distinguish all the aliases18 which are cached in the same cache set. The S bits used to address the cache set do not have to be stored since they are the same for all cache lines in the same set.

当一条指令修改内存时，处理器仍然必须先加载一个缓存行，因为没有指令会一次修改整个缓存行（规则的例外：写合并，见6.1节的解释）。因此，必须加载写操作之前的缓存行内容。缓存不可能保存部分缓存行。已被写入但尚未写回主存的缓存行被称为“脏的”。一旦写回，脏标志就被清除。

When an instruction modifies memory the processor still has to load a cache line first because no instruction modifies an entire cache line at once (exception to the rule: write-combining as explained in section 6.1). The content of the cache line before the write operation therefore has to be loaded. It is not possible for a cache to hold partial cache lines. A cache line which has been written to and which has not been written back to main memory is said to be “dirty”. Once it is written the dirty flag is cleared.

为了能在缓存中加载新数据，几乎总是必须先在缓存中腾出空间。从L1d中逐出会把缓存行推到L2中（L2使用相同的缓存行大小）。这当然意味着必须在L2中腾出空间。这又可能把内容推到L3，最终推到主存中。每一次逐出的代价都越来越高。这里描述的是现代AMD和VIA处理器所偏好的独占式缓存模型。Intel实现的是包含式缓存19，其中L1d中的每个缓存行也存在于L2中。因此从L1d中逐出要快得多。只要L2缓存足够大，在两个地方保存内容所浪费的内存就微不足道，并且在逐出时能带来回报。独占式缓存的一个可能优点是，加载一个新的缓存行只需触及L1d而不必触及L2，这可能更快。

To be able to load new data in a cache it is almost always first necessary to make room in the cache. An eviction from L1d pushes the cache line down into L2 (which uses the same cache line size). This of course means room has to be made in L2. This in turn might push the content into L3 and ultimately into main memory. Each eviction is progressively more expensive. What is described here is the model for an exclusive cache as is preferred by modern AMD and VIA processors. Intel implements inclusive caches19 where each cache line in L1d is also present in L2. Therefore evicting from L1d is much faster. With enough L2 cache the disadvantage of wasting memory for content held in two places is minimal and it pays off when evicting. A possible advantage of an exclusive cache is that loading a new cache line only has to touch the L1d and not the L2, which could be faster.

只要不改变为处理器架构所定义的内存模型，CPU就可以随意管理缓存。例如，处理器利用内存总线活动很少或没有活动的时机，主动把脏的缓存行写回主存，是完全没有问题的。在x86和x86-64的处理器之间，在不同制造商之间，甚至在同一制造商的不同型号之间，缓存架构都千差万别，这正证明了内存模型抽象的威力。

The CPUs are allowed to manage the caches as they like as long as the memory model defined for the processor architecture is not changed. It is, for instance, perfectly fine for a processor to take advantage of little or no memory bus activity and proactively write dirty cache lines back to main memory. The wide variety of cache architectures among the processors for the x86 and x86-64, between manufacturers and even within the models of the same manufacturer, are testament to the power of the memory model abstraction.

在对称多处理器（SMP）系统中，各CPU的缓存不能彼此独立地工作。所有处理器都应当在任何时候看到相同的内存内容。维持这种一致的内存视图被称为“缓存一致性”。如果一个处理器只看自己的缓存和主存，它就看不到其他处理器中脏缓存行的内容。让一个处理器直接访问另一个处理器的缓存，代价将极其高昂，并且会成为巨大的瓶颈。取而代之的是，处理器会检测另一个处理器何时想要读取或写入某个缓存行。

In symmetric multi-processor (SMP) systems the caches of the CPUs cannot work independently from each other. All processors are supposed to see the same memory content at all times. The maintenance of this uniform view of memory is called “cache coherency”. If a processor were to look simply at its own caches and main memory it would not see the content of dirty cache lines in other processors. Providing direct access to the caches of one processor from another processor would be terribly expensive and a huge bottleneck. Instead, processors detect when another processor wants to read or write to a certain cache line.

如果检测到写访问，而处理器在其缓存中有该缓存行的干净副本，这个缓存行就被标记为无效。以后的引用将需要重新加载该缓存行。注意，另一个CPU上的读访问并不需要使缓存行无效，多个干净的副本完全可以同时保留。

If a write access is detected and the processor has a clean copy of the cache line in its cache, this cache line is marked invalid. Future references will require the cache line to be reloaded. Note that a read access on another CPU does not necessitate an invalidation, multiple clean copies can very well be kept around.

更复杂的缓存实现允许另一种可能。假设一个缓存行在一个处理器的缓存中是脏的，而第二个处理器想要读取或写入该缓存行。在这种情况下，主存是过时的，请求的处理器必须改为从第一个处理器那里获取缓存行的内容。通过窥探，第一个处理器注意到这种情况，并自动把数据发送给请求的处理器。这一操作绕过了主存，不过在某些实现中，内存控制器应当注意到这次直接传输，并把更新后的缓存行内容存储到主存中。如果访问是为了写入，第一个处理器随后会使其本地缓存行的副本无效。

More sophisticated cache implementations allow another possibility to happen. Assume a cache line is dirty in one processor’s cache and a second processor wants to read or write that cache line. In this case the main memory is out-of-date and the requesting processor must, instead, get the cache line content from the first processor. Through snooping, the first processor notices this situation and automatically sends the requesting processor the data. This action bypasses main memory, though in some implementations the memory controller is supposed to notice this direct transfer and store the updated cache line content in main memory. If the access is for writing the first processor then invalidates its copy of the local cache line.

随着时间的推移，人们开发了许多缓存一致性协议。其中最重要的是MESI，我们将在3.3.4节中介绍它。所有这一切的结果可以概括为几条简单的规则：

Over time a number of cache coherency protocols have been developed. The most important is MESI, which we will introduce in section 3.3.4. The outcome of all this can be summarized in a few simple rules:

  • 脏的缓存行不会存在于任何其他处理器的缓存中。

    A dirty cache line is not present in any other processor’s cache.

  • 同一缓存行的干净副本可以存在于任意多个缓存中。

    Clean copies of the same cache line can reside in arbitrarily many caches.

如果能维持这些规则，即使在多处理器系统中，处理器也能高效地使用它们的缓存。处理器所需要做的只是监视彼此的写访问，并把地址与其本地缓存中的地址进行比较。在下一节中，我们将更详细地讨论其实现，尤其是其代价。

If these rules can be maintained, processors can use their caches efficiently even in multi-processor systems. All the processors need to do is to monitor each others’ write accesses and compare the addresses with those in their local caches. In the next section we will go into a few more details about the implementation and especially the costs.

最后，我们至少应该对缓存命中和未命中的相关代价给出一个印象。以下是Intel为Pentium M列出的数字：

Finally, we should at least give an impression of the costs associated with cache hits and misses. These are the numbers Intel lists for a Pentium M:

访问目标
To Where		周期数
Cycles
寄存器 Register≤ 1
L1d~3
L2~14
主存 Main Memory~240

这些是以CPU周期为单位测得的实际访问时间。值得注意的是，对于片上L2缓存，访问时间的很大一部分（甚至可能是大部分）是由线路延迟造成的。这是一种物理限制，只会随着缓存尺寸的增大而变得更糟。只有制程缩小（例如，在Intel的产品线中从Merom的60nm到Penryn的45nm）才能改善这些数字。

These are the actual access times measured in CPU cycles. It is interesting to note that for the on-die L2 cache a large part (probably even the majority) of the access time is caused by wire delays. This is a physical limitation which can only get worse with increasing cache sizes. Only process shrinking (for instance, going from 60nm for Merom to 45nm for Penryn in Intel’s lineup) can improve those numbers.

表中的数字看起来很高，但幸运的是，并不是每次发生缓存加载和未命中都必须支付全部代价。部分代价是可以被隐藏的。如今的处理器都使用长度不同的内部流水线，指令在其中被解码并为执行做准备。准备工作的一部分是：如果值要被传送到寄存器，就从内存（或缓存）中加载它们。如果内存加载操作能在流水线中足够早地启动，它就可能与其他操作并行发生，加载的全部代价就可能被隐藏。对于L1d，这通常是可能的；对于某些流水线较长的处理器，L2也是如此。

The numbers in the table look high but, fortunately, the entire cost does not have to be paid for each occurrence of the cache load and miss. Some parts of the cost can be hidden. Today’s processors all use internal pipelines of different lengths where the instructions are decoded and prepared for execution. Part of the preparation is loading values from memory (or cache) if they are transferred to a register. If the memory load operation can be started early enough in the pipeline, it may happen in parallel with other operations and the entire cost of the load might be hidden. This is often possible for L1d; for some processors with long pipelines for L2 as well.

提前开始内存读取有许多障碍。原因可能很简单，就是没有足够的资源来进行内存访问；也可能是加载的最终地址作为另一条指令的结果而较晚才可用。在这些情况下，加载的代价无法（完全）被隐藏。

There are many obstacles to starting the memory read early. It might be as simple as not having sufficient resources for the memory access or it might be that the final address of the load becomes available late as the result of another instruction. In these cases the load costs cannot be hidden (completely).

对于写操作，CPU不一定要等到值被安全地存储到内存中。只要后续指令的执行看起来与值已被存储到内存中具有相同的效果，就没有什么能阻止CPU走捷径。它可以提前开始执行下一条指令。借助影子寄存器——它们可以保存在普通寄存器中已不再可用的值——甚至可以修改在未完成的写操作中要存储的值。

For write operations the CPU does not necessarily have to wait until the value is safely stored in memory. As long as the execution of the following instructions appears to have the same effect as if the value were stored in memory there is nothing which prevents the CPU from taking shortcuts. It can start executing the next instruction early. With the help of shadow registers which can hold values no longer available in a regular register it is even possible to change the value which is to be stored in the incomplete write operation.

关于缓存行为影响的说明，请参见图3.4。我们稍后会讨论生成这些数据的程序；它是对一个程序的简单模拟，该程序以随机方式反复访问一块大小可配置的内存。每个数据项的大小是固定的。元素的数量取决于所选的工作集大小。Y轴显示处理一个元素平均所需的CPU周期数；注意Y轴的刻度是对数的。在所有这类图表中，X轴也是如此。工作集的大小总是以2的幂表示。

For an illustration of the effects of cache behavior see Figure 3.4. We will talk about the program which generated the data later; it is a simple simulation of a program which accesses a configurable amount of memory repeatedly in a random fashion. Each data item has a fixed size. The number of elements depends on the selected working set size. The Y–axis shows the average number of CPU cycles it takes to process one element; note that the scale for the Y–axis is logarithmic. The same applies in all the diagrams of this kind to the X–axis. The size of the working set is always shown in powers of two.

该图显示出三个明显的平台。这并不奇怪：这个特定的处理器有L1d和L2缓存，但没有L3。凭借一些经验我们可以推断，L1d的大小为213字节，L2的大小为220字节。如果整个工作集都能放进L1d，处理每个元素的周期数低于10。一旦超出L1d的大小，处理器就必须从L2加载数据，平均时间跃升到28左右。一旦L2也不够用了，时间就跳到480个周期及以上。这时许多或大部分操作都必须从主存加载数据。更糟的是：由于数据正在被修改，脏的缓存行也必须被写回。

The graph shows three distinct plateaus. This is not surprising: the specific processor has L1d and L2 caches, but no L3. With some experience we can deduce that the L1d is 213 bytes in size and that the L2 is 220 bytes in size. If the entire working set fits into the L1d the cycles per operation on each element is below 10. Once the L1d size is exceeded the processor has to load data from L2 and the average time springs up to around 28. Once the L2 is not sufficient anymore the times jump to 480 cycles and more. This is when many or most operations have to load data from main memory. And worse: since data is being modified dirty cache lines have to be written back, too.

这张图应该足以激发人们去研究有助于改善缓存使用的编码改进。我们说的不是区区几个百分点的差别；我们说的是有时可能实现的数量级上的改进。在第6节中，我们将讨论能够写出更高效代码的技术。下一节将更详细地讨论CPU缓存的设计。了解这些知识是有益的，但对于本文的其余部分并非必需。因此可以跳过这一节。

This graph should give sufficient motivation to look into coding improvements which help improve cache usage. We are not talking about a difference of a few measly percent here; we are talking about orders-of-magnitude improvements which are sometimes possible. In section 6 we will discuss techniques which allow writing more efficient code. The next section goes into more details of CPU cache designs. The knowledge is good to have but not necessary for the rest of the paper. So this section could be skipped.

3.3 CPU缓存的实现细节

3.3 CPU Cache Implementation Details

缓存实现者面临这样一个问题：庞大主存中的每一个单元都有可能需要被缓存。如果一个程序的工作集足够大，这意味着有许多主存位置在争夺缓存中的每一个位置。前面提到过，缓存与主存大小之比为1比1000并不罕见。

Cache implementers have the problem that each cell in the huge main memory potentially has to be cached. If the working set of a program is large enough this means there are many main memory locations which fight for each place in the cache. Previously it was noted that a ratio of 1-to-1000 for cache versus main memory size is not uncommon.

3.3.1 相联度

3.3.1 Associativity

可以实现这样一种缓存：其中每个缓存行都可以保存任何内存位置的副本（见图3.5）。这被称为全相联缓存。要访问一个缓存行，处理器内核必须把每一个缓存行的标记与所请求地址的标记进行比较。标记将由地址中不属于缓存行内偏移量的全部部分组成（这意味着第15页图中的S为零）。

It would be possible to implement a cache where each cache line can hold a copy of any memory location (see Figure 3.5). This is called a fully associative cache. To access a cache line the processor core would have to compare the tags of each and every cache line with the tag for the requested address. The tag would be comprised of the entire part of the address which is not the offset into the cache line (that means, S in the figure on page 15 is zero).

确实有以这种方式实现的缓存，但看看如今使用的L2的数字就会发现这是不切实际的。给定一个缓存行为64B的4MB缓存，该缓存将有65,536个条目。为了达到足够的性能，缓存逻辑必须能在短短几个周期内，从所有这些条目中挑出与给定标记相匹配的那一个。实现这一点所需的工作量将是巨大的。

There are caches which are implemented like this but, by looking at the numbers for an L2 in use today, will show that this is impractical. Given a 4MB cache with 64B cache lines the cache would have 65,536 entries. To achieve adequate performance the cache logic would have to be able to pick from all these entries the one matching a given tag in just a few cycles. The effort to implement this would be enormous.

对于每个缓存行，都需要一个比较器来比较那个很大的标记（注意，S为零）。每条连线旁边的字母表示以位为单位的宽度。如果没有标注，则是单比特线路。每个比较器都必须比较两个T位宽的值。然后，根据比较结果，选出相应的缓存行内容并使其可用。这需要合并与缓存桶数量一样多的O条数据线组。实现单个比较器所需的晶体管数量很大，尤其因为它必须工作得非常快。迭代比较器是不能用的。节省比较器数量的唯一方法是通过迭代比较标记来减少比较器的数量。这同样不适用，原因与迭代比较器不适用的原因相同：它需要的时间太长了。

For each cache line a comparator is needed to compare the large tag (note, S is zero). The letter next to each connection indicates the width in bits. If none is given it is a single bit line. Each comparator has to compare two T-bit-wide values. Then, based on the result, the appropriate cache line content is selected and made available. This requires merging as many sets of O data lines as there are cache buckets. The number of transistors needed to implement a single comparator is large especially since it must work very fast. No iterative comparator is usable. The only way to save on the number of comparators is to reduce the number of them by iteratively comparing the tags. This is not suitable for the same reason that iterative comparators are not: it takes too long.

全相联缓存对于小型缓存是可行的（例如，某些Intel处理器上的TLB缓存就是全相联的），但那些缓存很小，真的很小。我们说的是最多几十个条目。

Fully associative caches are practical for small caches (for instance, the TLB caches on some Intel processors are fully associative) but those caches are small, really small. We are talking about a few dozen entries at most.

对于L1i、L1d以及更高级别的缓存，需要一种不同的方法。可以做的是限制搜索范围。在最极端的限制下，每个标记恰好映射到一个缓存条目。计算很简单：对于有65,536个条目的4MB/64B缓存，我们可以使用地址的第6到第21位（16位）直接寻址每个条目。低6位是缓存行内的索引。

For L1i, L1d, and higher level caches a different approach is needed. What can be done is to restrict the search. In the most extreme restriction each tag maps to exactly one cache entry. The computation is simple: given the 4MB/64B cache with 65,536 entries we can directly address each entry by using bits 6 to 21 of the address (16 bits). The low 6 bits are the index into the cache line.

如图3.6所示，这样的直接映射缓存速度快，而且相对容易实现。它恰好需要一个比较器、一个复用器（在这张图中有两个，因为标记和数据是分开的，但这并不是对设计的硬性要求），以及一些只选择有效缓存行内容的逻辑。由于速度要求，比较器很复杂，但现在只有一个；因此可以投入更多精力使它变快。这种方法真正的复杂性在于复用器。一个简单复用器中的晶体管数量以O(log N)增长，其中N是缓存行的数量。这是可以容忍的，但可能会变慢，在这种情况下，可以在复用器中花费更多的芯片面积用于晶体管，把部分工作并行化以提高速度。随着缓存大小的增长，晶体管总数可以缓慢增长，这使得这种方案非常有吸引力。但它有一个缺点：只有当程序使用的地址相对于用于直接映射的那些位是均匀分布时，它才能很好地工作。如果不是这样（而通常就不是这样），一些缓存条目会被频繁使用，因而被反复逐出，而另一些则几乎不被使用或一直是空的。

Such a direct-mapped cache is fast and relatively easy to implement as can be seen in Figure 3.6. It requires exactly one comparator, one multiplexer (two in this diagram where tag and data are separated, but this is not a hard requirement on the design), and some logic to select only valid cache line content. The comparator is complex due to the speed requirements but there is only one of them now; as a result more effort can be spent on making it fast. The real complexity in this approach lies in the multiplexers. The number of transistors in a simple multiplexer grows with O(log N), where N is the number of cache lines. This is tolerable but might get slow, in which case speed can be increased by spending more real estate on transistors in the multiplexers to parallelize some of the work and to increase the speed. The total number of transistors can grow slowly with a growing cache size which makes this solution very attractive. But it has a drawback: it only works well if the addresses used by the program are evenly distributed with respect to the bits used for the direct mapping. If they are not, and this is usually the case, some cache entries are heavily used and therefore repeated evicted while others are hardly used at all or remain empty.

这个问题可以通过使缓存成为组相联的来解决。组相联缓存结合了全相联缓存和直接映射缓存的优点，在很大程度上避免了这两种设计的弱点。图3.7展示了组相联缓存的设计。标记和数据存储被划分为若干组，其中一组由缓存行的地址选中。这与直接映射缓存类似。但对于缓存中的每个组值，不是只有一个元素，而是为同一组值缓存少量的值。所有组成员的标记被并行比较，这与全相联缓存的工作方式类似。

This problem can be solved by making the cache set associative. A set-associative cache combines the good features of the full associative and direct-mapped caches to largely avoid the weaknesses of those designs. Figure 3.7 shows the design of a set-associative cache. The tag and data storage are divided into sets, one of which is selected by the address of a cache line. This is similar to the direct-mapped cache. But instead of only having one element for each set value in the cache a small number of values is cached for the same set value. The tags for all the set members are compared in parallel, which is similar to the functioning of the fully associative cache.

其结果是一种不容易被不幸地——或蓄意地——选择具有相同组号的地址所击败的缓存，同时缓存的大小也不受能够经济地实现的比较器数量的限制。如果缓存变大，（在这张图中）增加的只是列数，而不是行数。只有在提高缓存的相联度时，行数（以及比较器的数量）才会增加。如今的处理器对L2缓存使用高达24或更高的相联度。L1缓存通常只需8路组相联即可。

The result is a cache which is not easily defeated by unfortunate–or deliberate–selection of addresses with the same set numbers and at the same time the size of the cache is not limited by the number of comparators which can be implemented economically. If the cache grows it is (in this figure) only the number of columns which increases, not the number of rows. The number of rows (and therefore comparators) only increases if the associativity of the cache is increased. Today processors are using associativity levels of up to 24 for L2 caches or higher. L1 caches usually get by with 8 sets.

对于我们的4MB/64B缓存和8路组相联，我们得到的缓存有8,192个组，并且只有13位标记用于寻址缓存组。要确定缓存组中的哪个条目（如果有的话）包含被寻址的缓存行，必须比较8个标记。这在很短的时间内是可以做到的。通过实验我们可以看到这样做是有道理的。

Given our 4MB/64B cache and 8-way set associativity the cache we are left with has 8,192 sets and only 13 bits of the tag are used in addressing the cache set. To determine which (if any) of the entries in the cache set contains the addressed cache line 8 tags have to be compared. That is feasible to do in very short time. With an experiment we can see that this makes sense.

表3.1显示了一个程序（这里是gcc，根据Linux内核开发者的说法，它是所有基准测试中最重要的一个）在改变缓存大小、缓存行大小和相联组大小时的L2缓存未命中次数。在7.2节中，我们将介绍为该测试模拟缓存所需的工具。

Table 3.1 shows the number of L2 cache misses for a program (gcc in this case, the most important benchmark of them all, according to the Linux kernel people) for changing cache size, cache line size, and associativity set size. In section 7.2 we will introduce the tool to simulate the caches as required for this test.

以防这一点还不够明显，所有这些值之间的关系是：缓存大小为

Just in case this is not yet obvious, the relationship of all these values is that the cache size is

cache line size×associativity×number of sets

地址按照第15页的图所示的方式映射到缓存中，使用

The addresses are mapped into the cache by using

O=log2 cache line sizeS=log2 number of sets

图3.8使表中的数据更易于理解。它显示了缓存行大小固定为32字节时的数据。观察给定缓存大小的数字，我们可以看到相联度确实能显著减少缓存未命中的次数。对于8MB缓存，从直接映射变为2路组相联缓存，节省了几乎44%的缓存未命中。与直接映射缓存相比，使用组相联缓存时处理器可以在缓存中保留更多的工作集。

Figure 3.8 makes the data of the table more comprehensible. It shows the data for a fixed cache line size of 32 bytes. Looking at the numbers for a given cache size we can see that associativity can indeed help to reduce the number of cache misses significantly. For an 8MB cache going from direct mapping to 2-way set associative cache saves almost 44% of the cache misses. The processor can keep more of the working set in the cache with a set associative cache compared with a direct mapped cache.

在文献中，人们偶尔会读到：引入相联度与把缓存大小加倍有相同的效果。在一些极端情况下这是对的，正如从4MB到8MB缓存的跳变中可以看到的那样。但对于进一步把相联度加倍，这肯定是不对的。正如我们在数据中看到的，后续的收益要小得多。不过，我们也不应完全忽视这些效果。在示例程序中，内存使用峰值为5.6M。因此对于8MB缓存，同一缓存组不太可能有很多次（超过两次）使用。对于更大的工作集，节省可以更多，正如我们从较小缓存大小下相联度带来的更大收益中所看到的那样。

In the literature one can occasionally read that introducing associativity has the same effect as doubling cache size. This is true in some extreme cases as can be seen in the jump from the 4MB to the 8MB cache. But it certainly is not true for further doubling of the associativity. As we can see in the data, the successive gains are much smaller. We should not completely discount the effects, though. In the example program the peak memory use is 5.6M. So with a 8MB cache there are unlikely to be many (more than two) uses for the same cache set. With a larger working set the savings can be higher as we can see from the larger benefits of associativity for the smaller cache sizes.

一般来说，对于单线程工作负载，把缓存的相联度提高到8以上似乎效果甚微。随着第一级缓存被共享的超线程处理器、以及使用共享L2缓存的多核处理器的出现，情况发生了变化。现在基本上是两个程序在冲击同一个缓存，这使得相联度在实践中减半（对于四核处理器则减为四分之一）。因此可以预期，随着内核数量的增加，共享缓存的相联度应当随之增长。一旦这不再可能（16路组相联已经很难实现了），处理器设计者就必须开始使用共享的L3缓存乃至更高级别的缓存，而L2缓存则可能由一部分内核共享。

In general, increasing the associativity of a cache above 8 seems to have little effects for a single-threaded workload. With the introduction of hyper-threaded processors where the first level cache is shared and multi-core processors which use a shared L2 cache the situation changes. Now you basically have two programs hitting on the same cache which causes the associativity in practice to be halved (or quartered for quad-core processors). So it can be expected that, with increasing numbers of cores, the associativity of the shared caches should grow. Once this is not possible anymore (16-way set associativity is already hard) processor designers have to start using shared L3 caches and beyond, while L2 caches are potentially shared by a subset of the cores.

我们可以在图3.8中研究的另一个效果是缓存大小的增加如何有助于性能。如果不知道工作集的大小，就无法解释这些数据。显然，一个与主存一样大的缓存会比较小的缓存带来更好的结果，因此一般来说，能带来可测量收益的最大缓存大小是没有上限的。

Another effect we can study in Figure 3.8 is how the increase in cache size helps with performance. This data cannot be interpreted without knowing about the working set size. Obviously, a cache as large as the main memory would lead to better results than a smaller cache, so there is in general no limit to the largest cache size with measurable benefits.

正如上面已经提到的，工作集在峰值时的大小为5.6M。这并没有给出最大有益缓存大小的任何绝对数字，但它让我们可以估计这个数字。问题在于，所使用的内存并不全是连续的，因此即使使用16M缓存和5.6M工作集，我们仍然会遇到冲突（见2路组相联16MB缓存相对于直接映射版本的优势）。但可以有把握地说，对于同样的工作负载，32MB缓存带来的收益将微乎其微。但谁说工作集必须保持不变呢？工作负载随时间增长，缓存大小也应随之增长。在购买机器、必须选择愿意为之付费的缓存大小时，测量一下工作集大小是值得的。为什么这很重要，可以从第21页的图中看出。

As already mentioned above, the size of the working set at its peak is 5.6M. This does not give us any absolute number of the maximum beneficial cache size but it allows us to estimate the number. The problem is that not all the memory used is contiguous and, therefore, we have, even with a 16M cache and a 5.6M working set, conflicts (see the benefit of the 2-way set associative 16MB cache over the direct mapped version). But it is a safe bet that with the same workload the benefits of a 32MB cache would be negligible. But who says the working set has to stay the same? Workloads are growing over time and so should the cache size. When buying machines, and one has to choose the cache size one is willing to pay for, it is worthwhile to measure the working set size. Why this is important can be seen in the figures on page 21.

我们运行了两类测试。在第一种测试中，元素按顺序处理。测试程序沿着指针n前进，但数组元素是这样链接起来的：它们按照在内存中出现的顺序被遍历。这可以在图3.9的下半部分看到。从最后一个元素有一个回指。在第二种测试中（图的上半部分），数组元素以随机顺序遍历。在这两种情况下，数组元素都构成一个循环单链表。

Two types of tests are run. In the first test the elements are processed sequentially. The test program follows the pointer n but the array elements are chained so that they are traversed in the order in which they are found in memory. This can be seen in the lower part of Figure 3.9. There is one back reference from the last element. In the second test (upper part of the figure) the array elements are traversed in a random order. In both cases the array elements form a circular single-linked list.

3.3.2 缓存效应的测量

3.3.2 Measurements of Cache Effects

所有的图都是通过测量一个程序而得到的，该程序可以模拟任意大小的工作集、读访问和写访问，以及顺序访问或随机访问。我们已经在图3.4中看到了一些结果。该程序创建一个与工作集大小相对应的数组，其元素为如下类型：

All the figures are created by measuring a program which can simulate working sets of arbitrary size, read and write access, and sequential or random access. We have already seen some results in Figure 3.4. The program creates an array corresponding to the working set size of elements of this type:

struct l {
  struct l *n;
  long int pad[NPAD];
};

所有条目都通过n元素以顺序或随机的次序链接成一个循环链表。即使元素是按顺序排列的，从一个条目前进到下一个条目也总是使用指针。pad元素是有效载荷，它可以任意增大。在某些测试中数据会被修改，在另一些测试中程序只执行读操作。

All entries are chained in a circular list using the n element, either in sequential or random order. Advancing from one entry to the next always uses the pointer, even if the elements are laid out sequentially. The pad element is the payload and it can grow arbitrarily large. In some tests the data is modified, in others the program only performs read operations.

在性能测量中，我们谈论的是工作集大小。工作集由一个struct l元素数组组成。一个2N字节的工作集包含2N/sizeof(struct l)个元素。显然，sizeof(struct l)取决于NPAD的值。对于32位系统，NPAD=7意味着每个数组元素的大小为32字节，对于64位系统则为64字节。

In the performance measurements we are talking about working set sizes. The working set is made up of an array of struct l elements. A working set of 2N bytes contains 2N/sizeof(struct l) elements. Obviously sizeof(struct l) depends on the value of NPAD. For 32-bit systems, NPAD=7 means the size of each array element is 32 bytes, for 64-bit systems the size is 64 bytes.

单线程顺序访问
Single Threaded Sequential Access

最简单的情况是对链表中所有条目的一次简单遍历。链表元素按顺序紧密排列。处理的顺序是向前还是向后并不重要，处理器可以同样好地应对两个方向。我们在这里——以及在接下来所有的测试中——所测量的，是处理单个链表元素需要多长时间。时间单位是处理器周期。图3.10显示了结果。除非另有说明，所有测量都是在一台64位模式下的Pentium 4机器上进行的，这意味着NPAD=0的结构l大小为八字节。

The simplest case is a simple walk over all the entries in the list. The list elements are laid out sequentially, densely packed. Whether the order of processing is forward or backward does not matter, the processor can deal with both directions equally well. What we measure here–and in all the following tests–is how long it takes to handle a single list element. The time unit is a processor cycle. Figure 3.10 shows the result. Unless otherwise specified, all measurements are made on a Pentium 4 machine in 64-bit mode which means the structure l with NPAD=0 is eight bytes in size.

前两个测量值受到噪声的污染。所测量的工作负载实在太小，无法滤除系统其余部分的影响。我们可以有把握地假设这些值都在4个周期的水平上。考虑到这一点，我们可以看到三个明显的水平：

The first two measurements are polluted by noise. The measured workload is simply too small to filter the effects of the rest of the system out. We can safely assume that the values are all at the 4 cycles level. With this in mind we can see three distinct levels:

  • 工作集大小最多到214字节。

    Up to a working set size of 214 bytes.

  • 从215字节到220字节。

    From 215 bytes to 220 bytes.

  • 从221字节及以上。

    From 221 bytes and up.

这些台阶很容易解释：该处理器有16kB的L1d和1MB的L2。我们在从一个水平到另一个水平的过渡中看不到清晰的边缘，因为缓存也被系统的其他部分使用，因此缓存并不是专供程序数据使用的。具体来说，L2缓存是一个统一缓存，也用于指令（注：Intel使用包含式缓存）。

These steps can be easily explained: the processor has a 16kB L1d and 1MB L2. We do not see sharp edges in the transition from one level to the other because the caches are used by other parts of the system as well and so the cache is not exclusively available for the program data. Specifically the L2 cache is a unified cache and also used for the instructions (NB: Intel uses inclusive caches).

或许不太符合预期的是不同工作集大小下的实际时间。L1d命中的时间是符合预期的：在P4上，L1d命中后的加载时间约为4个周期。但L2访问呢？一旦L1d不足以容纳数据，人们可能会预期每个元素需要14个周期或更多，因为这是L2的访问时间。但结果显示只需要大约9个周期。这一差异可以用处理器中的高级逻辑来解释。由于预期会使用连续的内存区域，处理器会预取下一个缓存行。这意味着当下一行实际被使用时，它已经加载了一半。因此等待下一个缓存行加载所需的延迟要比L2访问时间短得多。

What is perhaps not quite expected are the actual times for the different working set sizes. The times for the L1d hits are expected: load times after an L1d hit are around 4 cycles on the P4. But what about the L2 accesses? Once the L1d is not sufficient to hold the data one might expect it would take 14 cycles or more per element since this is the access time for the L2. But the results show that only about 9 cycles are required. This discrepancy can be explained by the advanced logic in the processors. In anticipation of using consecutive memory regions, the processor prefetches the next cache line. This means that when the next line is actually used it is already halfway loaded. The delay required to wait for the next cache line to be loaded is therefore much less than the L2 access time.

一旦工作集大小超过L2的大小，预取的效果就更加明显了。前面我们说过，一次主存访问需要200多个周期。只有通过有效的预取，处理器才可能把访问时间保持在低至9个周期。从200和9之间的差异可以看出，这一机制运作得很好。

The effect of prefetching is even more visible once the working set size grows beyond the L2 size. Before we said that a main memory access takes 200+ cycles. Only with effective prefetching is it possible for the processor to keep the access times as low as 9 cycles. As we can see from the difference between 200 and 9, this works out nicely.

我们可以观察处理器的预取，至少是间接地观察。在图3.11中，我们看到的是相同工作集大小下的时间，但这一次我们看到的是结构l不同大小时的曲线。这意味着链表中的元素更少但更大。不同的大小导致（仍然连续的）链表中n元素之间的距离增大。在图中的四种情况下，这一距离分别为0、56、120和248字节。

We can observe the processor while prefetching, at least indirectly. In Figure 3.11 we see the times for the same working set sizes but this time we see the graphs for different sizes of the structure l. This means we have fewer but larger elements in the list. The different sizes have the effect that the distance between the n elements in the (still consecutive) list grows. In the four cases of the graph the distance is 0, 56, 120, and 248 bytes respectively.

在底部我们可以看到图3.10中的那条线，但这一次它看起来或多或少是一条平坦的线。其他情况下的时间实在差得太多了。在这张图中我们同样可以看到三个不同的水平，也可以看到小工作集的测试中误差很大（同样忽略它们）。只要只涉及L1d，这些线或多或少都彼此吻合。不需要预取，因此每次访问时所有元素大小都只是命中L1d。

At the bottom we can see the line from Figure 3.10, but this time it appears more or less as a flat line. The times for the other cases are simply so much worse. We can see in this graph, too, the three different levels and we see the large errors in the tests with the small working set sizes (ignore them again). The lines more or less all match each other as long as only the L1d is involved. There is no prefetching necessary so all element sizes just hit the L1d for each access.

对于L2缓存命中，我们看到三条新的线几乎彼此吻合，但它们处于更高的水平（大约28）。这正是L2访问时间的水平。这意味着从L2到L1d的预取基本上被禁用了。即使NPAD=7，我们在循环的每次迭代中也需要一个新的缓存行；而对于NPAD=0，循环要迭代八次才需要下一个缓存行。预取逻辑不可能每个周期都加载一个新的缓存行。因此我们看到每次迭代都会因从L2加载而停顿。

For the L2 cache hits we see that the three new lines all pretty much match each other but that they are at a higher level (about 28). This is the level of the access time for the L2. This means prefetching from L2 into L1d is basically disabled. Even with NPAD=7 we need a new cache line for each iteration of the loop; for NPAD=0, instead, the loop has to iterate eight times before the next cache line is needed. The prefetch logic cannot load a new cache line every cycle. Therefore we see a stall to load from L2 in every iteration.

一旦工作集大小超过L2的容量，情况就变得更加有趣了。现在四条线差异巨大。不同的元素大小在性能差异中显然起着很大的作用。处理器应当识别出步长的大小，并且对于NPAD=15和31不去获取不必要的缓存行，因为元素大小小于预取窗口（见6.3.1节）。元素大小妨碍预取工作的地方，是硬件预取的一个限制造成的：它不能跨越页边界。每增加一次大小，我们就使硬件调度器的有效性降低50%。如果允许硬件预取器跨越页边界，而下一页不驻留或无效，那么操作系统将不得不介入定位该页。这意味着程序会遇到一个并非它自己引发的缺页。这是完全不可接受的，因为处理器不知道一个页面是不存在于内存中还是根本不存在。在后一种情况下，操作系统将不得不终止该进程。无论如何，鉴于对于NPAD=7及更大的值，我们每个链表元素都需要一个缓存行，硬件预取器就无能为力了。根本没有时间从内存加载数据，因为处理器所做的只是读一个字然后加载下一个元素。

It gets even more interesting once the working set size exceeds the L2 capacity. Now all four lines vary widely. The different element sizes play obviously a big role in the difference in performance. The processor should recognize the size of the strides and not fetch unnecessary cache lines for NPAD=15 and 31 since the element size is smaller than the prefetch window (see section 6.3.1). Where the element size is hampering the prefetching efforts is a result of a limitation of hardware prefetching: it cannot cross page boundaries. We are reducing the effectiveness of the hardware scheduler by 50% for each size increase. If the hardware prefetcher were allowed to cross page boundaries and the next page is not resident or valid the OS would have to get involved in locating the page. That means the program would experience a page fault it did not initiate itself. This is completely unacceptable since the processor does not know whether a page is not present or does not exist. In the latter case the OS would have to abort the process. In any case, given that, for NPAD=7 and higher, we need one cache line per list element the hardware prefetcher cannot do much. There simply is no time to load the data from memory since all the processor does is read one word and then load the next element.

变慢的另一个重要原因是TLB缓存的未命中。这是一个存储虚拟地址到物理地址转换结果的缓存，第4节将对此作更详细的解释。TLB缓存相当小，因为它必须极快。如果被反复访问的页数多于TLB缓存的条目数，从虚拟地址到物理地址的转换就必须不断重复。这是一个代价非常高的操作。元素越大，TLB查找的代价被分摊到的元素就越少。这意味着每个链表元素需要计算的TLB条目总数就越多。

Another big reason for the slowdown are the misses of the TLB cache. This is a cache where the results of the translation of a virtual address to a physical address are stored, as is explained in more detail in section 4. The TLB cache is quite small since it has to be extremely fast. If more pages are accessed repeatedly than the TLB cache has entries for the translation from virtual to physical address has to be constantly repeated. This is a very costly operation. With larger element sizes the cost of a TLB lookup is amortized over fewer elements. That means the total number of TLB entries which have to be computed per list element is higher.

为了观察TLB的效应，我们可以运行一个不同的测试。在一次测量中，我们照常顺序排列元素。我们使用NPAD=7，使每个元素占据一整个缓存行。在第二次测量中，我们把每个链表元素放在一个单独的页面上。每页的其余部分保持不动，我们也不把它计入工作集大小的总数中。20其结果是，在第一次测量中，每次链表迭代都需要一个新的缓存行，并且每64个元素需要一个新的页面。在第二次测量中，每次迭代都需要加载一个位于新页面上的新缓存行。

To observe the TLB effects we can run a different test. For one measurement we lay out the elements sequentially as usual. We use NPAD=7 for elements which occupy one entire cache line. For the second measurement we place each list element on a separate page. The rest of each page is left untouched and we do not count it in the total for the working set size.20 The consequence is that, for the first measurement, each list iteration requires a new cache line and, for every 64 elements, a new page. For the second measurement each iteration requires loading a new cache line which is on a new page.

结果可以在图3.12中看到。测量是在与图3.11相同的机器上进行的。由于可用RAM的限制，工作集大小必须限制在224字节，这需要1GB来把对象放在单独的页面上。较低的红色曲线与图3.11中的NPAD=7曲线完全对应。我们看到了显示L1d和L2缓存大小的明显台阶。第二条曲线看起来截然不同。重要的特征是，从工作集大小达到213字节开始出现的巨大尖峰。这就是TLB缓存溢出的时候。元素大小为64字节时，我们可以计算出TLB缓存有64个条目。不存在影响代价的缺页，因为程序锁定了内存以防止其被换出。

The result can be seen in Figure 3.12. The measurements were performed on the same machine as Figure 3.11. Due to limitations of the available RAM the working set size had to be restricted to 224 bytes which requires 1GB to place the objects on separate pages. The lower, red curve corresponds exactly to the NPAD=7 curve in Figure 3.11. We see the distinct steps showing the sizes of the L1d and L2 caches. The second curve looks radically different. The important feature is the huge spike starting when the working set size reaches 213 bytes. This is when the TLB cache overflows. With an element size of 64 bytes we can compute that the TLB cache has 64 entries. There are no page faults affecting the cost since the program locks the memory to prevent it from being swapped out.

可以看到，计算物理地址并将其存储到TLB中所需的周期数非常高。图3.12中的图显示的是极端情况，但现在应当清楚，对于较大的NPAD值，变慢的一个重要因素是TLB缓存效率的降低。由于在为L2或主存读取缓存行之前必须计算出物理地址，地址转换的代价是叠加在内存访问时间之上的。这在一定程度上解释了为什么NPAD=31时每个链表元素的总代价高于RAM的理论访问时间。

As can be seen the number of cycles it takes to compute the physical address and store it in the TLB is very high. The graph in Figure 3.12 shows the extreme case, but it should now be clear that a significant factor in the slowdown for larger NPAD values is the reduced efficiency of the TLB cache. Since the physical address has to be computed before a cache line can be read for either L2 or main memory the address translation penalties are additive to the memory access times. This in part explains why the total cost per list element for NPAD=31 is higher than the theoretical access time for the RAM.

通过查看修改链表元素的测试运行数据，我们可以瞥见预取实现的更多细节。图3.13显示了三条线。在所有情况下，元素宽度都是16字节。第一条线是现在已经熟悉的链表遍历，作为基线。第二条线标为“Inc”，它只是在前进到下一个元素之前，把当前元素的pad[0]成员加一。第三条线标为“Addnext0”，它取出下一个元素的pad[0]，并把它加到当前链表元素的pad[0]成员上。

We can glimpse a few more details of the prefetch implementation by looking at the data of test runs where the list elements are modified. Figure 3.13 shows three lines. The element width is in all cases 16 bytes. The first line is the now familiar list walk which serves as a baseline. The second line, labeled “Inc”, simply increments the pad[0] member of the current element before going on to the next. The third line, labeled “Addnext0”, takes the pad[0] list element of the next element and adds it to the pad[0] member of the current list element.

天真的假设是，“Addnext0”测试运行得更慢，因为它要做更多的工作。在前进到下一个链表元素之前，必须先加载该元素中的一个值。这就是为什么看到这个测试在某些工作集大小下实际上比“Inc”测试运行得更快会令人惊讶。对此的解释是，从下一个链表元素的加载基本上是一次强制预取。每当程序前进到下一个链表元素时，我们可以确定该元素已经在L1d缓存中了。因此我们看到，只要工作集大小能放进L2缓存，“Addnext0”的表现就与简单的“Follow”测试一样好。

The naïve assumption would be that the “Addnext0” test runs slower because it has more work to do. Before advancing to the next list element a value from that element has to be loaded. This is why it is surprising to see that this test actually runs, for some working set sizes, faster than the “Inc” test. The explanation for this is that the load from the next list element is basically a forced prefetch. Whenever the program advances to the next list element we know for sure that element is already in the L1d cache. As a result we see that the “Addnext0” performs as well as the simple “Follow” test as long as the working set size fits into the L2 cache.

不过，“Addnext0”测试比“Inc”测试更早地耗尽L2。它需要从主存加载更多的数据。这就是为什么“Addnext0”测试在工作集大小为221字节时达到了28个周期的水平。28个周期的水平是“Follow”测试所达到的14个周期水平的两倍。这也很容易解释。由于另外两个测试会修改内存，为新缓存行腾出空间的L2缓存逐出不能简单地丢弃数据。相反，数据必须被写回内存。这意味着FSB上的可用带宽被减半，因此把数据从主存传输到L2所需的时间加倍。

The “Addnext0” test runs out of L2 faster than the “Inc” test, though. It needs more data loaded from main memory. This is why the “Addnext0” test reaches the 28 cycles level for a working set size of 221 bytes. The 28 cycles level is twice as high as the 14 cycles level the “Follow” test reaches. This is easy to explain, too. Since the other two tests modify memory an L2 cache eviction to make room for new cache lines cannot simply discard the data. Instead it has to be written to memory. This means the available bandwidth on the FSB is cut in half, hence doubling the time it takes to transfer the data from main memory to L2.

顺序的、高效的缓存处理的最后一个方面是缓存的大小。这应该是显而易见的，但仍然值得指出。图3.14显示了使用128字节元素（在64位机器上NPAD=15）的Increment基准测试的时间。这一次我们看到来自三台不同机器的测量结果。前两台机器是P4，最后一台是Core2处理器。前两台的区别在于缓存大小不同。第一个处理器有32k L1d和1M L2。第二个有16k L1d、512k L2和2M L3。Core2处理器有32k L1d和4M L2。

One last aspect of the sequential, efficient cache handling is the size of the cache. This should be obvious but it still should be pointed out. Figure 3.14 shows the timing for the Increment benchmark with 128-byte elements (NPAD=15 on 64-bit machines). This time we see the measurement from three different machines. The first two machines are P4s, the last one a Core2 processor. The first two differentiate themselves by having different cache sizes. The first processor has a 32k L1d and an 1M L2. The second one has 16k L1d, 512k L2, and 2M L3. The Core2 processor has 32k L1d and 4M L2.

这张图有趣的地方并不一定在于Core2处理器相对于另外两个处理器的表现有多好（尽管它令人印象深刻）。这里主要的关注点在于这样一个区域：工作集大小对于各自的最后一级缓存来说太大了，主存因此被大量卷入。

The interesting part of the graph is not necessarily how well the Core2 processor performs relative to the other two (although it is impressive). The main point of interest here is the region where the working set size is too large for the respective last level cache and the main memory gets heavily involved.

正如预期的那样，最后一级缓存越大，曲线在对应于L2访问代价的低水平上停留的时间就越长。需要注意的重要部分是这带来的性能优势。第二个处理器（稍旧一些）在220字节的工作集上完成工作的速度是第一个处理器的两倍。这完全要归功于增大的最后一级缓存。拥有4M L2的Core2处理器表现得更好。

As expected, the larger the last level cache is the longer the curve stays at the low level corresponding to the L2 access costs. The important part to notice is the performance advantage this provides. The second processor (which is slightly older) can perform the work on the working set of 220 bytes twice as fast as the first processor. All thanks to the increased last level cache size. The Core2 processor with its 4M L2 performs even better.

对于随机的工作负载，这可能意义不大。但如果工作负载可以根据最后一级缓存的大小进行调整，程序的性能就能相当显著地提高。这就是为什么有时值得多花些钱购买缓存更大的处理器。

For a random workload this might not mean that much. But if the workload can be tailored to the size of the last level cache the program performance can be increased quite dramatically. This is why it sometimes is worthwhile to spend the extra money for a processor with a larger cache.

单线程随机访问
Single Threaded Random Access

我们已经看到，通过把缓存行预取到L2和L1d中，处理器能够隐藏大部分主存乃至L2的访问延迟。不过，这只有在内存访问可预测时才能很好地发挥作用。

We have seen that the processor is able to hide most of the main memory and even L2 access latency by prefetching cache lines into L2 and L1d. This can work well only when the memory access is predictable, though.

如果访问模式不可预测或是随机的，情况就大不相同了。图3.15把顺序访问时（与图3.10相同）每个链表元素的时间，与链表元素在工作集中随机分布时的时间进行了比较。顺序由随机化的链表决定。处理器无法可靠地预取数据。只有当紧接着使用的元素在内存中也彼此靠近时，预取才可能碰巧起作用。

If the access pattern is unpredictable or random the situation is quite different. Figure 3.15 compares the per-list-element times for the sequential access (same as in Figure 3.10) with the times when the list elements are randomly distributed in the working set. The order is determined by the linked list which is randomized. There is no way for the processor to reliably prefetch data. This can only work by chance if elements which are used shortly after one another are also close to each other in memory.

图3.15中有两点值得注意。第一点是随着工作集增大所需的周期数很多。这台机器可以在200–300个周期内访问主存，但这里我们达到了450个周期甚至更多。我们之前已经见过这种现象（比较图3.11）。自动预取在这里实际上起了反作用。

There are two important points to note in Figure 3.15. The first is the large number of cycles needed for growing working set sizes. The machine makes it possible to access the main memory in 200-300 cycles but here we reach 450 cycles and more. We have seen this phenomenon before (compare Figure 3.11). The automatic prefetching is actually working to a disadvantage here.

第二个有趣的点是，这条曲线并没有像顺序访问的情况那样在不同的平台上变平。曲线不断上升。为了解释这一点，我们可以测量程序在不同工作集大小下的L2访问情况。结果可以在图3.16和表3.2中看到。

The second interesting point is that the curve is not flattening at various plateaus as it has been for the sequential access cases. The curve keeps on rising. To explain this we can measure the L2 access of the program for the various working set sizes. The result can be seen in Figure 3.16 and Table 3.2.

该图显示，当工作集大小大于L2大小时，缓存未命中率（L2访问次数/L2未命中次数）开始增长。这条曲线与图3.15中的曲线形状相似：迅速上升，略微下降，然后再次开始上升。它与每链表元素周期数的图有很强的相关性。L2未命中率将一直增长，直到最终接近100%。给定足够大的工作集（以及RAM），随机挑选的任意缓存行位于L2中或正在被加载的概率可以被任意降低。

The figure shows that, when the working set size is larger than the L2 size, the cache miss ratio (L2 accesses / L2 misses) starts to grow. The curve has a similar form to the one in Figure 3.15: it rises quickly, declines slightly, and starts to rise again. There is a strong correlation with the cycles per list element graph. The L2 miss rate will grow until it eventually reaches close to 100%. Given a large enough working set (and RAM) the probability that any of the randomly picked cache lines is in L2 or is in the process of being loaded can be reduced arbitrarily.

仅仅缓存未命中率的增加就解释了部分代价。但还有另一个因素。观察表3.2，我们可以在L2/#Iter列中看到，程序每次迭代对L2的使用总次数在增长。每个工作集都是前一个的两倍大。因此，在没有缓存的情况下，我们预期主存访问次数会加倍。有了缓存和（几乎）完美的可预测性，我们在顺序访问的数据中看到L2使用量的增加很温和。这种增加完全是由于工作集大小的增加，而不是别的原因。

The increasing cache miss rate alone explains some of the costs. But there is another factor. Looking at Table 3.2 we can see in the L2/#Iter columns that the total number of L2 uses per iteration of the program is growing. Each working set is twice as large as the one before. So, without caching we would expect double the main memory accesses. With caches and (almost) perfect predictability we see the modest increase in the L2 use shown in the data for sequential access. The increase is due to the increase of the working set size and nothing else.

对于随机访问，工作集大小每加倍一次，每个元素的访问时间就增加一倍以上。这意味着每个链表元素的平均访问时间在增加，因为工作集大小只是加倍。其背后的原因是TLB未命中率的上升。在图3.17中我们看到NPAD=7时随机访问的代价。只是这一次随机化的方式被修改了。在通常的情况下，整个链表作为一个块被随机化（用标签∞表示），而其他11条曲线显示的是在较小的块中进行的随机化。对于标为“60”的曲线，每组60个页面（245.760字节）被单独随机化。这意味着块中的所有链表元素都被遍历完之后，才会转到下一个块中的元素。其效果是在任一时刻使用的TLB条目数量是有限的。

For random access the per-element access time more than doubles for each doubling of the working set size. This means the average access time per list element increases since the working set size only doubles. The reason behind this is a rising rate of TLB misses. In Figure 3.17 we see the cost for random accesses for NPAD=7. Only this time the randomization is modified. While in the normal case the entire list of randomized as one block (indicated by the label ∞) the other 11 curves show randomizations which are performed in smaller blocks. For the curve labeled ‘60’ each set of 60 pages (245.760 bytes) is randomized individually. That means all list elements in the block are traversed before going over to an element in the next block. This has the effect that number of TLB entries which are used at any one time is limited.

NPAD=7时的元素大小为64字节，正好对应缓存行大小。由于链表元素的随机顺序，硬件预取器不太可能起任何作用，对于超过少数几个元素的情况更是肯定不会。这意味着L2缓存未命中率与整个链表在一个块中随机化时没有显著差异。随着块大小的增加，测试的性能渐近地趋向于单块随机化的曲线。这意味着后一种测试情形的性能受到TLB未命中的显著影响。如果能降低TLB未命中，性能就会显著提高（在我们稍后将看到的一个测试中，提高可达38%）。

The element size for NPAD=7 is 64 bytes, which corresponds to the cache line size. Due to the randomized order of the list elements it is unlikely that the hardware prefetcher has any effect, most certainly not for more than a handful of elements. This means the L2 cache miss rate does not differ significantly from the randomization of the entire list in one block. The performance of the test with increasing block size approaches asymptotically the curve for the one-block randomization. This means the performance of this latter test case is significantly influenced by the TLB misses. If the TLB misses can be lowered the performance increases significantly (in one test we will see later up to 38%).

3.3.3 写行为

3.3.3 Write Behavior

在我们开始研究多个执行上下文（线程或进程）使用同一内存时的缓存行为之前，我们必须探讨缓存实现的一个细节。缓存应当是一致的，并且这种一致性对用户级代码应当是完全透明的。内核代码则是另一回事；它偶尔需要刷新缓存。

Before we start looking at the cache behavior when multiple execution contexts (threads or processes) use the same memory we have to explore a detail of cache implementations. Caches are supposed to be coherent and this coherency is supposed to be completely transparent for the userlevel code. Kernel code is a different story; it occasionally requires cache flushes.

这具体意味着，如果一个缓存行被修改，那么在此时刻之后，对系统而言的结果与根本没有缓存、而是主存位置本身被修改的情况相同。这可以通过两种方式或策略来实现：

This specifically means that, if a cache line is modified, the result for the system after this point in time is the same as if there were no cache at all and the main memory location itself had been modified. This can be implemented in two ways or policies:

  • 直写式缓存实现；

    write-through cache implementation;

  • 回写式缓存实现。

    write-back cache implementation.

直写式缓存是实现缓存一致性最简单的方法。如果缓存行被写入，处理器会立即也把该缓存行写入主存。这确保了主存和缓存在任何时候都是同步的。每当一个缓存行被替换时，缓存内容都可以简单地被丢弃。这种缓存策略简单但不太快。例如，一个反复修改局部变量的程序，即使这些数据很可能不在其他任何地方使用并且可能是短暂的，也会在FSB上产生大量流量。

The write-through cache is the simplest way to implement cache coherency. If the cache line is written to, the processor immediately also writes the cache line into main memory. This ensures that, at all times, the main memory and cache are in sync. The cache content could simply be discarded whenever a cache line is replaced. This cache policy is simple but not very fast. A program which, for instance, modifies a local variable over and over again would create a lot of traffic on the FSB even though the data is likely not used anywhere else and might be short-lived.

回写策略更为复杂。在这里，处理器不会立即把修改过的缓存行写回主存。相反，缓存行只是被标记为脏的。当缓存行在将来某个时刻被从缓存中丢弃时，脏位会指示处理器在那时把数据写回，而不是仅仅丢弃内容。

The write-back policy is more sophisticated. Here the processor does not immediately write the modified cache line back to main memory. Instead, the cache line is only marked as dirty. When the cache line is dropped from the cache at some point in the future the dirty bit will instruct the processor to write the data back at that time instead of just discarding the content.

回写式缓存有可能显著地表现得更好，这就是为什么在配有像样处理器的系统中，大部分内存都以这种方式缓存。处理器甚至可以利用FSB上的空闲容量，在缓存行必须被腾出之前就存储其内容。这使得脏位可以被清除，处理器在需要缓存空间时就可以直接丢弃该缓存行。

Write-back caches have the chance to be significantly better performing, which is why most memory in a system with a decent processor is cached this way. The processor can even take advantage of free capacity on the FSB to store the content of a cache line before the line has to be evacuated. This allows the dirty bit to be cleared and the processor can just drop the cache line when the room in the cache is needed.

但回写式实现有一个重大问题。当有不止一个处理器（或内核、超线程）可用并访问同一内存时，仍然必须保证两个处理器在任何时候都看到相同的内存内容。如果一个缓存行在一个处理器上是脏的（即尚未写回），而第二个处理器试图读取同一内存位置，读操作就不能直接去主存。相反，需要第一个处理器缓存行的内容。在下一节中，我们将看到这一点目前是如何实现的。

But there is a significant problem with the write-back implementation. When more than one processor (or core or hyper-thread) is available and accessing the same memory it must still be assured that both processors see the same memory content at all times. If a cache line is dirty on one processor (i.e., it has not been written back yet) and a second processor tries to read the same memory location, the read operation cannot just go out to the main memory. Instead the content of the first processor’s cache line is needed. In the next section we will see how this is currently implemented.

在讨论这一点之前，还有两种缓存策略需要提及：

Before we get to this there are two more cache policies to mention:

  • 写合并；以及

    write-combining; and

  • 不可缓存。

    uncacheable.

这两种策略都用于地址空间中不由真实RAM支持的特殊区域。内核为这些地址范围设置这些策略（在x86处理器上使用内存类型范围寄存器，MTRR），其余的事情就自动发生了。MTRR也可用于在直写和回写策略之间进行选择。

Both these policies are used for special regions of the address space which are not backed by real RAM. The kernel sets up these policies for the address ranges (on x86 processors using the Memory Type Range Registers, MTRRs) and the rest happens automatically. The MTRRs are also usable to select between write-through and write-back policies.

写合并是一种有限的缓存优化，更常用于显卡等设备上的RAM。由于传输到设备的代价比访问本地RAM高得多，避免进行过多传输就更加重要。如果下一个操作会修改下一个字，那么仅仅因为行中的一个字被写入就传输整个缓存行是一种浪费。很容易想象这是常见的情况，屏幕上水平相邻像素的内存在大多数情况下也是相邻的。顾名思义，写合并会在缓存行被写出之前把多次写访问合并起来。在理想情况下，整个缓存行被逐字修改，只有在最后一个字被写入之后，缓存行才被写到设备。这可以显著加快对设备上RAM的访问。

Write-combining is a limited caching optimization more often used for RAM on devices such as graphics cards. Since the transfer costs to the devices are much higher than the local RAM access it is even more important to avoid doing too many transfers. Transferring an entire cache line just because a word in the line has been written is wasteful if the next operation modifies the next word. One can easily imagine that this is a common occurrence, the memory for horizontal neighboring pixels on a screen are in most cases neighbors, too. As the name suggests, write-combining combines multiple write accesses before the cache line is written out. In ideal cases the entire cache line is modified word by word and, only after the last word is written, the cache line is written to the device. This can speed up access to RAM on devices significantly.

最后是不可缓存的内存。这通常意味着该内存位置根本不由RAM支持。它可能是一个特殊地址，被硬编码为具有在CPU之外实现的某种功能。对于通用硬件，最常见的情况是内存映射的地址范围，对它们的访问会被转换为对连接在总线（PCIe等）上的卡和设备的访问。在嵌入式电路板上，人们有时会发现可以用来开关LED的内存地址。缓存这样的地址显然是个坏主意。在这种情况下，LED用于调试或状态报告，人们希望尽快看到它。PCIe卡上的内存可以在没有CPU参与的情况下发生变化，因此这种内存不应被缓存。

Finally there is uncacheable memory. This usually means the memory location is not backed by RAM at all. It might be a special address which is hardcoded to have some functionality implemented outside the CPU. For commodity hardware this most often is the case for memory mapped address ranges which translate to accesses to cards and devices attached to a bus (PCIe etc). On embedded boards one sometimes finds such a memory address which can be used to turn an LED on and off. Caching such an address would obviously be a bad idea. LEDs in this context are used for debugging or status reports and one wants to see this as soon as possible. The memory on PCIe cards can change without the CPU’s interaction, so this memory should not be cached.

3.3.4 多处理器支持

3.3.4 Multi-Processor Support

在上一节中，我们已经指出了多个处理器参与时我们面临的问题。即使是多核处理器，对于那些不共享的缓存级别（至少是L1d）也存在这个问题。

In the previous section we have already pointed out the problem we have when multiple processors come into play. Even multi-core processors have the problem for those cache levels which are not shared (at least the L1d).

让一个处理器直接访问另一个处理器的缓存是完全不切实际的。首先，连接根本不够快。切实可行的替代方案是在需要时把缓存内容传送给另一个处理器。注意，这也适用于同一处理器上不共享的缓存。

It is completely impractical to provide direct access from one processor to the cache of another processor. The connection is simply not fast enough, for a start. The practical alternative is to transfer the cache content over to the other processor in case it is needed. Note that this also applies to caches which are not shared on the same processor.

现在的问题是：这种缓存行传输必须在什么时候发生？这个问题很容易回答：当一个处理器为了读或写而需要一个在另一个处理器缓存中是脏的缓存行时。但处理器如何确定一个缓存行在另一个处理器的缓存中是否是脏的呢？仅仅因为一个缓存行被另一个处理器加载过就作此假设，（往好了说）也是次优的。通常大多数内存访问都是读访问，由此产生的缓存行也不是脏的。处理器对缓存行的操作非常频繁（当然了，不然我们为什么要写这篇文章？），这意味着在每次写访问之后广播关于被修改缓存行的信息是不切实际的。

The question now is when does this cache line transfer have to happen? This question is pretty easy to answer: when one processor needs a cache line which is dirty in another processor’s cache for reading or writing. But how can a processor determine whether a cache line is dirty in another processor’s cache? Assuming it just because a cache line is loaded by another processor would be suboptimal (at best). Usually the majority of memory accesses are read accesses and the resulting cache lines are not dirty. Processor operations on cache lines are frequent (of course, why else would we have this paper?) which means broadcasting information about changed cache lines after each write access would be impractical.

多年来发展起来的是MESI缓存一致性协议（Modified修改、Exclusive独占、Shared共享、Invalid无效）。该协议以使用MESI协议时缓存行可能处于的四种状态命名：

What developed over the years is the MESI cache coherency protocol (Modified, Exclusive, Shared, Invalid). The protocol is named after the four states a cache line can be in when using the MESI protocol:

修改（Modified）
Modified

本地处理器已经修改了该缓存行。这也意味着它是所有缓存中唯一的副本。

The local processor has modified the cache line. This also implies it is the only copy in any cache.

独占（Exclusive）
Exclusive

该缓存行未被修改，但已知没有被加载到任何其他处理器的缓存中。

The cache line is not modified but known to not be loaded into any other processor’s cache.

共享（Shared）
Shared

该缓存行未被修改，并且可能存在于另一个处理器的缓存中。

The cache line is not modified and might exist in another processor’s cache.

无效（Invalid）
Invalid

该缓存行无效，即未被使用。

The cache line is invalid, i.e., unused.

这个协议是多年来从一些不那么复杂、但效率也更低的较简单版本发展而来的。有了这四种状态，就可以高效地实现回写式缓存，同时也支持在不同处理器上并发使用只读数据。

This protocol developed over the years from simpler versions which were less complicated but also less efficient. With these four states it is possible to efficiently implement write-back caches while also supporting concurrent use of read-only data on different processors.

状态的改变是通过处理器监听（或窥探）其他处理器的工作而实现的，并不需要太多额外的工作。处理器执行的某些操作会在外部引脚上公布，从而使处理器的缓存处理对外部可见。相关缓存行的地址在地址总线上是可见的。在下面对状态及其转换（如图3.18所示）的描述中，我们将指出何时涉及总线。

The state changes are accomplished without too much effort by the processors listening, or snooping, on the other processors’ work. Certain operations a processor performs are announced on external pins and thus make the processor’s cache handling visible to the outside. The address of the cache line in question is visible on the address bus. In the following description of the states and their transitions (shown in Figure 3.18) we will point out when the bus is involved.

最初，所有缓存行都是空的，因此也是无效的。如果为了写入而把数据加载到缓存中，缓存行变为修改状态。如果为了读取而加载数据，新状态取决于另一个处理器是否也加载了该缓存行。如果是，新状态为共享，否则为独占。

Initially all cache lines are empty and hence also Invalid. If data is loaded into the cache for writing the cache changes to Modified. If the data is loaded for reading the new state depends on whether another processor has the cache line loaded as well. If this is the case then the new state is Shared, otherwise Exclusive.

如果在本地处理器上读取或写入一个修改状态的缓存行，指令可以使用当前的缓存内容，状态不变。如果第二个处理器想要读取该缓存行，第一个处理器必须把它的缓存内容发送给第二个处理器，然后可以把状态改为共享。发送给第二个处理器的数据也会被内存控制器接收和处理，后者把内容存储到内存中。如果不这样做，该缓存行就不能被标记为共享。如果第二个处理器想要写入该缓存行，第一个处理器发送缓存行内容，并在本地把该缓存行标记为无效。这就是臭名昭著的“所有权请求”（RFO）操作。在最后一级缓存中执行这一操作，就像I→M转换一样，代价相对较高。对于直写式缓存，我们还必须加上把新的缓存行内容写入下一个更高级别的缓存或主存所需的时间，这进一步增加了代价。

If a Modified cache line is read from or written to on the local processor, the instruction can use the current cache content and the state does not change. If a second processor wants to read from the cache line the first processor has to send the content of its cache to the second processor and then it can change the state to Shared. The data sent to the second processor is also received and processed by the memory controller which stores the content in memory. If this did not happen the cache line could not be marked as Shared. If the second processor wants to write to the cache line the first processor sends the cache line content and marks the cache line locally as Invalid. This is the infamous “Request For Ownership” (RFO) operation. Performing this operation in the last level cache, just like the I→M transition is comparatively expensive. For write-through caches we also have to add the time it takes to write the new cache line content to the next higher-level cache or the main memory, further increasing the cost.

如果一个缓存行处于共享状态，而本地处理器读取它，则不需要改变状态，读请求可以从缓存中满足。如果在本地写入该缓存行，同样可以使用该缓存行，但状态变为修改。这还要求把其他处理器中该缓存行所有可能的副本都标记为无效。因此，写操作必须通过一条RFO消息通告给其他处理器。如果第二个处理器为了读取而请求该缓存行，则什么也不需要发生。主存包含当前数据，本地状态已经是共享的。如果第二个处理器想要写入该缓存行（RFO），该缓存行只需被标记为无效。不需要任何总线操作。

If a cache line is in the Shared state and the local processor reads from it no state change is necessary and the read request can be fulfilled from the cache. If the cache line is locally written to the cache line can be used as well but the state changes to Modified. It also requires that all other possible copies of the cache line in other processors are marked as Invalid. Therefore the write operation has to be announced to the other processors via an RFO message. If the cache line is requested for reading by a second processor nothing has to happen. The main memory contains the current data and the local state is already Shared. In case a second processor wants to write to the cache line (RFO) the cache line is simply marked Invalid. No bus operation is needed.

独占状态与共享状态大体相同，只有一个关键的区别：本地写操作不必在总线上通告。已知本地缓存是唯一持有这一特定缓存行的缓存。这可能是一个巨大的优势，因此处理器会尽量让尽可能多的缓存行处于独占状态而不是共享状态。后者是在当时无法获得相关信息时的退路。独占状态也可以完全省略而不会引起功能上的问题。受影响的只是性能，因为E→M转换比S→M转换快得多。

The Exclusive state is mostly identical to the Shared state with one crucial difference: a local write operation does not have to be announced on the bus. The local cache is known to be the only one holding this specific cache line. This can be a huge advantage so the processor will try to keep as many cache lines as possible in the Exclusive state instead of the Shared state. The latter is the fallback in case the information is not available at that moment. The Exclusive state can also be left out completely without causing functional problems. It is only the performance that will suffer since the E→M transition is much faster than the S→M transition.

从对状态转换的这一描述中，应当可以清楚地看出多处理器操作特有的代价在哪里。是的，填充缓存仍然很昂贵，但现在我们还必须留意RFO消息。每当必须发送这样一条消息时，事情就会变慢。

From this description of the state transitions it should be clear where the costs specific to multi-processor operations are. Yes, filling caches is still expensive but now we also have to look out for RFO messages. Whenever such a message has to be sent things are going to be slow.

有两种情况需要RFO消息：

There are two situations when RFO messages are necessary:

  • 一个线程从一个处理器迁移到另一个处理器，所有的缓存行都必须一次性地移到新处理器上。

    A thread is migrated from one processor to another and all the cache lines have to be moved over to the new processor once.

  • 一个缓存行确实在两个不同的处理器中都需要。21

    A cache line is truly needed in two different processors.21

在多线程或多进程程序中，总是需要某种同步；这种同步是通过内存实现的。因此有一些RFO消息是合理的。它们仍然必须尽可能地少。不过，RFO消息还有其他来源。在第6节中我们将解释这些场景。缓存一致性协议的消息必须分发给系统中的各个处理器。在确定系统中所有处理器都有机会回复该消息之前，MESI转换不能发生。这意味着回复可能花费的最长时间决定了一致性协议的速度。22总线上可能发生冲突，在NUMA系统中延迟可能很高，当然，纯粹的流量也会拖慢速度。这些都是专注于避免不必要流量的充分理由。

In multi-thread or multi-process programs there is always some need for synchronization; this synchronization is implemented using memory. So there are some valid RFO messages. They still have to be kept as infrequent as possible. There are other sources of RFO messages, though. In section 6 we will explain these scenarios. The Cache coherency protocol messages must be distributed among the processors of the system. A MESI transition cannot happen until it is clear that all the processors in the system have had a chance to reply to the message. That means that the longest possible time a reply can take determines the speed of the coherency protocol.22 Collisions on the bus are possible, latency can be high in NUMA systems, and of course sheer traffic volume can slow things down. All good reasons to focus on avoiding unnecessary traffic.

当有不止一个处理器参与时，还有一个问题。其影响与机器高度相关，但原则上这个问题始终存在：FSB是一种共享资源。在大多数机器中，所有处理器都通过一条总线连接到内存控制器（见图2.1）。如果单个处理器就能使总线饱和（通常就是这种情况），那么共享同一总线的两个或四个处理器将使每个处理器可用的带宽受到更大的限制。

There is one more problem related to having more than one processor in play. The effects are highly machine specific but in principle the problem always exists: the FSB is a shared resource. In most machines all processors are connected via one single bus to the memory controller (see Figure 2.1). If a single processor can saturate the bus (as is usually the case) then two or four processors sharing the same bus will restrict the bandwidth available to each processor even more.

即使像图2.2那样每个处理器都有自己通往内存控制器的总线，仍然存在通往内存模块的总线。通常这是一条总线，但即使在图2.2的扩展模型中，对同一内存模块的并发访问也会限制带宽。

Even if each processor has its own bus to the memory controller as in Figure 2.2 there is still the bus to the memory modules. Usually this is one bus but, even in the extended model in Figure 2.2, concurrent accesses to the same memory module will limit the bandwidth.

在每个处理器都可以拥有本地内存的AMD模型中也是如此。所有处理器确实都可以并发且快速地访问它们的本地内存，尤其是有了集成内存控制器之后。但多线程和多进程程序——至少时不时地——必须访问相同的内存区域以进行同步。

The same is true with the AMD model where each processor can have local memory. All processors can indeed concurrently access their local memory quickly, especially with the integrated memory controller. But multi-thread and multi-process programs–at least from time to time–have to access the same memory regions to synchronize.

可用于实现必要同步的有限带宽严重限制了并发性。程序需要被精心设计，以尽量减少不同处理器和内核对相同内存位置的访问。接下来的测量将展示这一点以及与多线程代码相关的其他缓存效应。

Concurrency is severely limited by the finite bandwidth available for the implementation of the necessary synchronization. Programs need to be carefully designed to minimize accesses from different processors and cores to the same memory locations. The following measurements will show this and the other cache effects related to multi-threaded code.

多线程访问
Multi Threaded Access

为了确保人们理解在不同处理器上并发使用相同缓存行所引入问题的严重性，我们在这里再看一些我们之前用过的同一程序的性能图。不过这一次，同时运行着不止一个线程。所测量的是所有线程中最快的运行时间。这意味着所有线程都完成时一次完整运行的时间还要更长。所使用的机器有四个处理器；测试最多使用四个线程。所有处理器共享一条通往内存控制器的总线，并且通往内存模块的总线也只有一条。

To ensure that the gravity of the problems introduced by concurrently using the same cache lines on different processors is understood, we will look here at some more performance graphs for the same program we used before. This time, though, more than one thread is running at the same time. What is measured is the fastest runtime of any of the threads. This means the time for a complete run when all threads are done is even higher. The machine used has four processors; the tests use up to four threads. All processors share one bus to the memory controller and there is only one bus to the memory modules.

图3.19显示了128字节条目（在64位机器上NPAD=15）顺序只读访问的性能。对于单线程的曲线，我们可以预期得到一条与图3.11相似的曲线。测量是在另一台机器上进行的，因此实际数字有所不同。

Figure 3.19 shows the performance for sequential read-only access for 128 bytes entries (NPAD=15 on 64-bit machines). For the curve for one thread we can expect a curve similar to Figure 3.11. The measurements are for a different machine so the actual numbers vary.

这张图中重要的部分当然是运行多个线程时的行为。注意，在遍历链表时没有修改任何内存，也没有尝试让线程保持同步。尽管不需要RFO消息，并且所有缓存行都可以共享，我们仍然看到，使用两个线程时最快线程的性能下降多达18%，使用四个线程时下降多达34%。由于不需要在处理器之间传输缓存行，这种变慢完全是由两个瓶颈中的一个或两个造成的：从处理器到内存控制器的共享总线，以及从内存控制器到内存模块的总线。一旦工作集大小超过这台机器的L3缓存，所有三个线程都将预取新的链表元素。即使只有两个线程，可用带宽也不足以线性扩展（即运行多个线程时没有损失）。

The important part in this figure is of course the behavior when running multiple threads. Note that no memory is modified and no attempts are made to keep the threads in sync when walking the linked list. Even though no RFO messages are necessary and all the cache lines can be shared, we see up to an 18% performance decrease for the fastest thread when two threads are used and up to 34% when four threads are used. Since no cache lines have to be transported between the processors this slowdown is solely caused by the one or both of the two bottlenecks: the shared bus from the processor to the memory controller and bus from the memory controller to the memory modules. Once the working set size is larger than the L3 cache in this machine all three threads will be prefetching new list elements. Even with two threads the available bandwidth is not sufficient to scale linearly (i.e., have no penalty from running multiple threads).

当我们修改内存时，情况变得更加糟糕。图3.20显示了顺序Increment测试的结果。这张图对Y轴使用了对数刻度。所以，不要被看似很小的差异所迷惑。运行两个线程我们仍有大约18%的损失，而现在运行四个线程的损失竟高达93%。这意味着当使用四个线程时，预取流量加上回写流量几乎使总线饱和了。

When we modify memory things get even uglier. Figure 3.20 shows the results for the sequential Increment test. This graph is using a logarithmic scale for the Y axis. So, do not be fooled by the apparently small differences. We still have about a 18% penalty for running two threads and now an amazing 93% penalty for running four threads. This means the prefetch traffic together with the write-back traffic is pretty much saturating the bus when four threads are used.

我们使用对数刻度来展示L1d范围的结果。可以看到，一旦运行不止一个线程，L1d基本上就失效了。只有当L1d不足以容纳工作集时，单线程的访问时间才会超过20个周期。而在运行多个线程时，即使是最小的工作集大小，也会立即达到这样的访问时间。

We use the logarithmic scale to show the results for the L1d range. What can be seen is that, as soon as more than one thread is running, the L1d is basically ineffective. The single-thread access times exceed 20 cycles only when the L1d is not sufficient to hold the working set. When multiple threads are running, those access times are hit immediately, even with the smallest working set sizes.

问题的一个方面在这里没有显示出来。用这个特定的测试程序很难测量它。即使测试修改了内存，因而我们必然会预期有RFO消息，我们在使用不止一个线程时也没有看到L2范围的代价更高。程序将不得不使用大量内存，并且所有线程必须并行访问同一内存。如果没有大量同步，这很难实现，而同步本身又会主导执行时间。

One aspect of the problem is not shown here. It is hard to measure with this specific test program. Even though the test modifies memory and we therefore must expect RFO messages we do not see higher costs for the L2 range when more than one thread is used. The program would have to use a large amount of memory and all threads must access the same memory in parallel. This is hard to achieve without a lot of synchronization which would then dominate the execution time.

最后，在图3.21中我们给出了随机访问内存的Addnextlast测试的数字。提供这张图主要是为了展示那些高得骇人的数字。在极端情况下，现在处理单个链表元素需要大约1,500个周期。使用更多的线程就更成问题了。我们可以用一张表来总结多线程使用的效率。

Finally in Figure 3.21 we have the numbers for the Addnextlast test with random access of memory. This figure is provided mainly to show the appallingly high numbers. It now takes around 1,500 cycles to process a single list element in the extreme case. The use of more threads is even more questionable. We can summarize the efficiency of multiple thread use in a table.

该表显示了在第28页三张图中最大工作集大小下多线程运行的效率。这个数字表示测试程序在最大工作集大小下使用两个或四个线程所能获得的最佳加速比。对于两个线程，加速比的理论极限是2；对于四个线程是4。两个线程的数字还不算太差。但对于四个线程，最后一项测试的数字表明，扩展到两个线程以上几乎是不值得的。额外的收益微乎其微。如果我们稍微换一种方式表示图3.21中的数据，就能更容易地看出这一点。

The table shows the efficiency for the multi-thread run with the largest working set size in the three figures on page 28. The number shows the best possible speed-up the test program incurs for the largest working set size by using two or four threads. For two threads the theoretical limits for the speed-up are 2 and, for four threads, 4. The numbers for two threads are not that bad. But for four threads the numbers for the last test show that it is almost not worth it to scale beyond two threads. The additional benefit is minuscule. We can see this more easily if we represent the data in Figure 3.21 a bit differently.

图3.22中的曲线显示了加速比，即与单线程执行代码相比的相对性能。我们必须忽略最小的那些大小，那些测量不够准确。对于L2和L3缓存的范围，我们可以看到我们确实实现了几乎线性的加速。我们几乎分别达到了2和4的倍数。但一旦L3缓存不足以容纳工作集，数字就崩溃了。它们崩溃到两个线程和四个线程的加速比相同的程度（见表3.3的第四列）。这就是为什么人们几乎找不到带有四个以上CPU插槽、且全都使用同一内存控制器的主板的原因之一。拥有更多处理器的机器必须以不同的方式构建（见第5节）。

The curves in Figure 3.22 show the speed-up factors, i.e., relative performance compared to the code executed by a single thread. We have to ignore the smallest sizes, the measurements are not accurate enough. For the range of the L2 and L3 cache we can see that we indeed achieve almost linear acceleration. We almost reach factors of 2 and 4 respectively. But as soon as the L3 cache is not sufficient to hold the working set the numbers crash. They crash to the point that the speed-up of two and four threads is identical (see the fourth column in Table 3.3). This is one of the reasons why one can hardly find motherboard with sockets for more than four CPUs all using the same memory controller. Machines with more processors have to be built differently (see section 5).

这些数字并不是普遍适用的。在某些情况下，即使是能放进最后一级缓存的工作集也无法实现线性加速。事实上，这才是常态，因为线程通常不像这个测试程序中那样彼此解耦。另一方面，处理大型工作集并仍然利用两个以上线程是可能的。不过，这需要深思熟虑。我们将在第6节中讨论一些方法。

These numbers are not universal. In some cases even working sets which fit into the last level cache will not allow linear speed-ups. In fact, this is the norm since threads are usually not as decoupled as is the case in this test program. On the other hand it is possible to work with large working sets and still take advantage of more than two threads. Doing this requires thought, though. We will talk about some approaches in section 6.

特殊情况：超线程
Special Case: Hyper-Threads

超线程（有时称为对称多线程，SMT）由CPU实现，是一种特殊情况，因为各个线程不能真正地并发运行。它们共享除寄存器组之外几乎所有的处理资源。各个内核和CPU仍然并行工作，但在每个内核上实现的线程受到这一限制。理论上每个内核可以有许多线程，但到目前为止，Intel的CPU每个内核最多有两个线程。CPU负责对线程进行时分复用。不过，仅此一点意义不大。真正的优势在于，当当前运行的超线程被延迟时，CPU可以调度另一个超线程，并利用算术逻辑单元（ALU）等可用资源。在大多数情况下，这种延迟是由内存访问引起的。

Hyper-Threads (sometimes called Symmetric Multi-Threading, SMT) are implemented by the CPU and are a special case since the individual threads cannot really run concurrently. They all share almost all the processing resources except for the register set. Individual cores and CPUs still work in parallel but the threads implemented on each core are limited by this restriction. In theory there can be many threads per core but, so far, Intel’s CPUs at most have two threads per core. The CPU is responsible for time-multiplexing the threads. This alone would not make much sense, though. The real advantage is that the CPU can schedule another hyper-thread and take advantage of available resources such as arithmetic logic units (ALUs) when the currently running hyper-thread is delayed. In most cases this is a delay caused by memory accesses.

如果两个线程在一个超线程内核上运行，那么只有当两个线程的总运行时间低于单线程代码的运行时间时，程序才比单线程代码更高效。通过重叠不同内存访问的等待时间（这些访问通常会顺序发生），这是可能的。一个简单的计算可以显示要达到一定的加速比对缓存命中率的最低要求。

If two threads are running on one hyper-threaded core the program is only more efficient than the single-threaded code if the combined runtime of both threads is lower than the runtime of the single-threaded code.
