This is possible by overlapping the wait times for different memory accesses which usually would happen sequentially. A simple calculation shows the minimum requirement on the cache hit rate to achieve a certain speed-up.

程序的执行时间可以用一个只有一级缓存的简单模型来近似，如下所示（见[16]）：

The execution time for a program can be approximated with a simple model with only one level of cache as follows (see [16]):

Texe=N[(1−Fmem)Tproc+Fmem(GhitTcache+(1−Ghit)Tmiss)]

各变量的含义如下：

The meaning of the variables is as follows:

N=指令数。
Number of instructions.
Fmem=N中访问内存的比例。
Fraction of N that access memory.
Ghit=命中缓存的加载所占比例。
Fraction of loads that hit the cache.
Tproc=每条指令的周期数。
Number of cycles per instruction.
Tcache=缓存命中的周期数。
Number of cycles for cache hit.
Tmiss=缓存未命中的周期数。
Number of cycles for cache miss.
Texe=程序的执行时间。
Execution time for program.

要使使用两个线程有意义，两个线程中每一个的执行时间都必须至多是单线程代码的一半。等式两边唯一的变量是缓存命中次数。如果我们求解该方程，得到为了不使线程执行慢50%或更多所需的最低缓存命中率，就得到了图3.23中的图。

For it to make any sense to use two threads the execution time of each of the two threads must be at most half of that of the single-threaded code. The only variable on either side is the number of cache hits. If we solve the equation for the minimum cache hit rate required to not slow down the thread execution by 50% or more we get the graph in Figure 3.23.

在X轴上测量的输入是单线程代码的缓存命中率Ghit。Y轴显示多线程代码的缓存命中率。这个值永远不可能高于单线程的命中率，否则单线程代码也会使用那种改进后的代码。对于单线程命中率——在这个特定情况下——低于55%的情况，程序在所有情况下都可以从使用线程中获益。由于缓存未命中，CPU或多或少足够空闲，可以运行第二个超线程。

The input, measured on the X–axis, is the cache hit rate Ghit of the single-thread code. The Y–axis shows the cache hit rate for the multi-threaded code. This value can never be higher than the single-threaded hit rate since, otherwise, the single-threaded code would use that improved code, too. For single-threaded hit rates–in this specific case–below 55% the program can in all cases benefit from using threads. The CPU is more or less idle enough due to cache misses to enable running a second hyper-thread.

绿色区域是目标。如果线程的变慢小于50%，并且每个线程的工作量减半，那么总运行时间可能少于单线程的运行时间。对于所建模的处理器（使用的是带超线程的P4的数字），单线程代码命中率为60%的程序，要求双线程程序的命中率至少为10%。这通常是可以做到的。但如果单线程代码的命中率为95%，那么多线程代码需要至少80%的命中率。这就比较难了。尤其是——这正是超线程的问题所在——因为现在每个超线程可用的有效缓存大小（这里是L1d，在实践中也包括L2等）被减半了。两个超线程使用同一个缓存来加载它们的数据。如果两个线程的工作集不重叠，原来95%的命中率也可能被减半，因而远低于所要求的80%。

The green area is the target. If the slowdown for the thread is less than 50% and the workload of each thread is halved the combined runtime might be less than the single-thread runtime. For the modeled processor (numbers for a P4 with hyper-threads were used) a program with a hit rate of 60% for the single-threaded code requires a hit rate of at least 10% for the dual-threaded program. That is usually doable. But if the single-threaded code has a hit rate of 95% then the multi-threaded code needs a hit rate of at least 80%. That is harder. Especially, and this is the problem with hyper-threads, because now the effective cache size (L1d here, in practice also L2 and so on) available to each hyper-thread is cut in half. Both hyper-threads use the same cache to load their data. If the working set of the two threads is non-overlapping the original 95% hit rate could also be cut in half and is therefore much lower than the required 80%.

因此，超线程只在有限的情况下才有用。单线程代码的缓存命中率必须足够低，以便在给定上述方程以及缩小的缓存大小时，新的命中率仍能达到目标。只有在那时，使用超线程才可能有意义。结果在实践中是否更快，取决于处理器能否充分地把一个线程中的等待时间与其他线程中的执行时间重叠起来。并行化代码的开销必须加到新的总运行时间中，而这一额外代价往往不可忽略。

Hyper-threads are therefore only useful in a limited range of situations. The cache hit rate of the single-threaded code must be low enough that given the equations above and reduced cache size the new hit rate still meets the goal. Then and only then can it make any sense at all to use hyper-threads. Whether the result is faster in practice depends on whether the processor is sufficiently able to overlap the wait times in one thread with execution times in the other threads. The overhead of parallelizing the code must be added to the new total runtime and this additional cost often cannot be neglected.

在6.3.4节中我们将看到一种技术，其中线程紧密协作，通过共同缓存实现的紧密耦合实际上是一种优势。只要程序员愿意投入时间和精力来扩展他们的代码，这种技术就可以适用于许多情况。

In section 6.3.4 we will see a technique where threads collaborate closely and the tight coupling through the common cache is actually an advantage. This technique can be applicable to many situations if only the programmers are willing to put in the time and energy to extend their code.

应当清楚的是，如果两个超线程执行完全不同的代码（即这两个线程被操作系统当作独立的处理器来执行独立的进程），缓存大小确实会减半，这意味着缓存未命中显著增加。除非缓存足够大，否则这种操作系统调度做法是有问题的。除非机器的工作负载由那些从设计上确实能从超线程中获益的进程组成，否则最好在计算机的BIOS中关闭超线程。23

What should be clear is that if the two hyper-threads execute completely different code (i.e., the two threads are treated like separate processors by the OS to execute separate processes) the cache size is indeed cut in half which means a significant increase in cache misses. Such OS scheduling practices are questionable unless the caches are sufficiently large. Unless the workload for the machine consists of processes which, through their design, can indeed benefit from hyper-threads it might be best to turn off hyper-threads in the computer’s BIOS.23

3.3.5 其他细节

3.3.5 Other Details

到目前为止，我们一直把地址说成由三部分组成：标记、组索引和缓存行偏移。但实际使用的是什么地址呢？如今所有相关的处理器都为进程提供虚拟地址空间，这意味着有两种不同的地址：虚拟地址和物理地址。

So far we talked about the address as consisting of three parts, tag, set index, and cache line offset. But what address is actually used? All relevant processors today provide virtual address spaces to processes, which means that there are two different kinds of addresses: virtual and physical.

虚拟地址的问题在于它们不是唯一的。一个虚拟地址可以随着时间推移指向不同的物理内存地址。不同进程中的同一地址很可能也指向不同的物理地址。所以使用物理内存地址总是更好的，对吧？

The problem with virtual addresses is that they are not unique. A virtual address can, over time, refer to different physical memory addresses. The same address in different processes also likely refers to different physical addresses. So it is always better to use the physical memory address, right?

这里的问题在于执行期间使用的虚拟地址，它们必须借助内存管理单元（MMU）转换为物理地址。这是一个不简单的操作。在执行一条指令的流水线中，物理地址可能只有在较晚的阶段才可用。这意味着缓存逻辑必须非常迅速地确定该内存位置是否已被缓存。如果可以使用虚拟地址，缓存查找就可以在流水线中早得多的阶段进行，并且在缓存命中的情况下就可以提供内存内容。结果是更多的内存访问代价可以被流水线隐藏。

The problem here are the virtual addresses used during execution which must to be translated with the help of the Memory Management Unit (MMU) into physical addresses. This is a non-trivial operation. In the pipeline to execute an instruction the physical address might only be available at a later stage. This means that the cache logic has to be very quick in determining whether the memory location is cached. If virtual addresses could be used the cache lookup can happen much earlier in the pipeline and in case of a cache hit the memory content can be made available. The result is that more of the memory access costs could be hidden by the pipeline.

处理器设计者目前对第一级缓存使用虚拟地址标记。这些缓存相当小，清除它们不会带来太多痛苦。如果一个进程的页表树发生变化，至少需要部分清除缓存。如果处理器有一条能够指定已变化的虚拟地址范围的指令，也许可以避免完全刷新。鉴于L1i和L1d缓存的延迟很低（约3个周期），使用虚拟地址几乎是必须的。

Processor designers are currently using virtual address tagging for the first level caches. These caches are rather small and can be cleared without too much pain. At least partial clearing the cache is necessary if the page table tree of a process changes. It might be possible to avoid a complete flush if the processor has an instruction which allows to specify the virtual address range which has changed. Given the low latency of L1i and L1d caches (~3 cycles) using virtual addresses is almost mandatory.

对于包括L2、L3……在内的更大的缓存，需要使用物理地址标记。这些缓存的延迟更高，虚拟→物理地址转换可以及时完成。由于这些缓存更大（即刷新时会丢失大量信息），并且由于主存访问延迟，重新填充它们需要很长时间，频繁刷新它们的代价将很高。

For larger caches including L2, L3, . . . caches physical address tagging is needed. These caches have a higher latency and the virtual→physical address translation can finish in time. Because these caches are larger (i.e., a lot of information is lost when they are flushed) and refilling them takes a long time due to the main memory access latency, flushing them often would be costly.

一般来说，没有必要了解这些缓存中地址处理的细节。它们是不能改变的，而所有会影响性能的因素通常要么是应当避免的，要么是与高昂代价相关联的。溢出缓存容量是不好的，而且如果所使用的大多数缓存行都落入同一个组，所有缓存都会很早就遇到问题。后者对于虚拟寻址的缓存是可以避免的，但对于使用物理地址寻址的缓存，用户级进程是不可能避免的。人们或许应该记住的唯一细节是：如果可能的话，不要在同一个进程中把同一个物理内存位置映射到两个或更多的虚拟地址。

It should, in general, not be necessary to know about the details of the address handling in those caches. They cannot be changed and all the factors which would influence the performance are normally something which should be avoided or is associated with high cost. Overflowing the cache capacity is bad and all caches run into problems early if the majority of the used cache lines fall into the same set. The latter can be avoided with virtually addressed caches but is impossible for user-level processes to avoid for caches addressed using physical addresses. The only detail one might want to keep in mind is to not map the same physical memory location to two or more virtual addresses in the same process, if at all possible.

缓存的另一个对程序员来说相当无趣的细节是缓存替换策略。大多数缓存首先逐出最近最少使用（LRU）的元素。这总是一个很好的默认策略。随着相联度增大（而且由于更多内核的加入，相联度在未来几年确实可能进一步增长），维护LRU列表变得越来越昂贵，我们可能会看到采用不同的策略。

Another detail of the caches which is rather uninteresting to programmers is the cache replacement strategy. Most caches evict the Least Recently Used (LRU) element first. This is always a good default strategy. With larger associativity (and associativity might indeed grow further in the coming years due to the addition of more cores) maintaining the LRU list becomes more and more expensive and we might see different strategies adopted.

至于缓存替换，程序员能做的不多。如果缓存使用物理地址标记，就无法找出虚拟地址与缓存组之间的对应关系。可能所有逻辑页中的缓存行都映射到相同的缓存组，使得大部分缓存未被使用。如果说有什么的话，确保这种情况不要太频繁发生是操作系统的工作。

As for the cache replacement there is not much a programmer can do. If the cache is using physical address tags there is no way to find out how the virtual addresses correlate with the cache sets. It might be that cache lines in all logical pages are mapped to the same cache sets, leaving much of the cache unused. If anything, it is the job of the OS to arrange that this does not happen too often.

随着虚拟化的出现，情况变得更加复杂。现在甚至操作系统也无法控制物理内存的分配。虚拟机监视器（VMM，又称Hypervisor）负责物理内存的分配。

With the advent of virtualization things get even more complicated. Now not even the OS has control over the assignment of physical memory. The Virtual Machine Monitor (VMM, aka Hypervisor) is responsible for the physical memory assignment.

程序员所能做的最好的事情是：a）完整地使用逻辑内存页；b）使用尽可能大的有意义的页大小，以尽可能地分散物理地址。更大的页大小还有其他好处，但那是另一个话题（见第4节）。

The best a programmer can do is to a) use logical memory pages completely and b) use page sizes as large as meaningful to diversify the physical addresses as much as possible. Larger page sizes have other benefits, too, but this is another topic (see section 4).

3.4 指令缓存

3.4 Instruction Cache

被缓存的不仅仅是处理器使用的数据；处理器执行的指令也会被缓存。不过，这种缓存比数据缓存的问题少得多。原因有以下几个：

Not just the data used by the processor is cached; the instructions executed by the processor are also cached. However, this cache is much less problematic than the data cache. There are several reasons:

  • 被执行的代码量取决于所需代码的大小。代码的大小一般取决于问题的复杂度。问题的复杂度是固定的。

    The quantity of code which is executed depends on the size of the code that is needed. The size of the code in general depends on the complexity of the problem. The complexity of the problem is fixed.

  • 程序的数据处理是由程序员设计的，而程序的指令通常是由编译器生成的。编译器的编写者了解良好代码生成的规则。

    While the program’s data handling is designed by the programmer the program’s instructions are usually generated by a compiler. The compiler writers know about the rules for good code generation.

  • 程序流程比数据访问模式可预测得多。如今的CPU非常擅长检测模式。这有助于预取。

    Program flow is much more predictable than data access patterns. Today’s CPUs are very good at detecting patterns. This helps with prefetching.

  • 代码总是具有相当好的空间局部性和时间局部性。

    Code always has quite good spatial and temporal locality.

程序员应该遵循一些规则，但这些规则主要是关于如何使用工具的。我们将在第6节中讨论它们。这里我们只讨论指令缓存的技术细节。

There are a few rules programmers should follow but these mainly consist of rules on how to use the tools. We will discuss them in section 6. Here we talk only about the technical details of the instruction cache.

自从CPU的内核时钟大幅提高、缓存（即使是第一级缓存）与内核之间的速度差距扩大以来，CPU就采用流水线设计。这意味着一条指令的执行是分阶段进行的。首先对指令解码，然后准备参数，最后执行它。这样的流水线可能相当长（对于Intel的Netburst架构，超过20级）。长流水线意味着如果流水线停顿（即流经其中的指令流被中断），需要一段时间才能重新恢复速度。例如，如果无法正确预测下一条指令的位置，或者加载下一条指令花费的时间太长（例如必须从内存中读取时），就会发生流水线停顿。

Ever since the core clock of CPUs increased dramatically and the difference in speed between cache (even first level cache) and core grew, CPUs have been designed with pipelines. That means the execution of an instruction happens in stages. First an instruction is decoded, then the parameters are prepared, and finally it is executed. Such a pipeline can be quite long (> 20 stages for Intel’s Netburst architecture). A long pipeline means that if the pipeline stalls (i.e., the instruction flow through it is interrupted) it takes a while to get up to speed again. Pipeline stalls happen, for instance, if the location of the next instruction cannot be correctly predicted or if it takes too long to load the next instruction (e.g., when it has to be read from memory).

因此，CPU设计者在分支预测上花费了大量的时间和芯片面积，以使流水线停顿尽可能少地发生。

As a result CPU designers spend a lot of time and chip real estate on branch prediction so that pipeline stalls happen as infrequently as possible.

在CISC处理器上，解码阶段也可能需要一些时间。x86和x86-64处理器尤其受到影响。因此近年来，这些处理器不在L1i中缓存指令的原始字节序列，而是缓存解码后的指令。在这种情况下，L1i被称为“踪迹缓存”（trace cache）。在缓存命中的情况下，踪迹缓存使处理器能够跳过流水线的最初几个步骤，这在流水线停顿时尤其有益。

On CISC processors the decoding stage can also take some time. The x86 and x86-64 processors are especially affected. In recent years these processors therefore do not cache the raw byte sequence of the instructions in L1i but instead they cache the decoded instructions. L1i in this case is called the “trace cache”. Trace caching allows the processor to skip over the first steps of the pipeline in case of a cache hit which is especially good if the pipeline stalled.

如前所述，从L2开始的缓存是同时包含代码和数据的统一缓存。显然，在这里代码以字节序列的形式缓存，而不是以解码后的形式。

As said before, the caches from L2 on are unified caches which contain both code and data. Obviously here the code is cached in the byte sequence form and not decoded.

为了获得最佳性能，与指令缓存相关的规则只有几条：

To achieve the best performance there are only a few rules related to the instruction cache:

  1. 生成尽可能小的代码。也有例外情况：为了利用流水线而进行软件流水线时需要生成更多代码，或者使用小代码的开销太高。

    Generate code which is as small as possible. There are exceptions when software pipelining for the sake of using pipelines requires creating more code or where the overhead of using small code is too high.

  2. 帮助处理器作出良好的预取决策。这可以通过代码布局或显式预取来实现。

    Help the processor making good prefetching decisions. This can be done through code layout or with explicit prefetching.

这些规则通常由编译器的代码生成来执行。程序员可以做的事情有一些，我们将在第6节中讨论。

These rules are usually enforced by the code generation of a compiler. There are a few things the programmer can do and we will talk about them in section 6.

3.4.1 自修改代码

3.4.1 Self Modifying Code

在计算机的早期，内存非常珍贵。人们想尽办法减小程序的大小，以便为程序数据腾出更多空间。一个常用的技巧是让程序随时间修改自身。这种自修改代码（SMC）偶尔仍能见到，如今大多是出于性能原因，或出现在安全漏洞利用中。

In early computer days memory was a premium. People went to great lengths to reduce the size of the program to make more room for program data. One trick frequently deployed was to change the program itself over time. Such Self Modifying Code (SMC) is occasionally still found, these days mostly for performance reasons or in security exploits.

一般来说应当避免SMC。尽管它通常能被正确执行，但存在不能正确执行的边界情况，而且如果做得不正确会造成性能问题。显然，被修改的代码不能保存在包含解码后指令的踪迹缓存中。但即使因为代码根本还没被执行过（或已有一段时间没被执行）而没有使用踪迹缓存，处理器也可能遇到问题。如果一条即将执行的指令在已经进入流水线后被修改，处理器就不得不丢弃大量工作并从头开始。甚至在某些情况下，处理器的大部分状态都必须被丢弃。

SMC should in general be avoided. Though it is generally correctly executed there are boundary cases which are not and it creates performance problems if not done correctly. Obviously, code which is changed cannot be kept in the trace cache which contains the decoded instructions. But even if the trace cache is not used because the code has not been executed at all (or for some time) the processor might have problems. If an upcoming instruction is changed while it already entered the pipeline the processor has to throw away a lot of work and start all over again. There are even situations where most of the state of the processor has to be tossed away.

最后，由于处理器假定——出于简化的原因，也因为在99.9999999%的情况下都是如此——代码页是不可变的，L1i的实现不使用MESI协议，而是使用一种简化的SI协议。这意味着如果检测到修改，就必须作出大量悲观的假设。

Finally, since the processor assumes–for simplicity reasons and because it is true in 99.9999999% of all cases–that the code pages are immutable, the L1i implementation does not use the MESI protocol but instead a simplified SI protocol. This means if modifications are detected a lot of pessimistic assumptions have to be made.

强烈建议尽可能避免SMC。内存已不再是那么稀缺的资源了。编写独立的函数，比根据特定需要修改一个函数要好。也许有一天，对SMC的支持可以成为可选的，我们就能检测出试图以这种方式修改代码的漏洞利用代码。如果绝对必须使用SMC，写操作应当绕过缓存，以免L1i中需要的数据在L1d中造成问题。关于这些指令的更多信息，见6.1节。

It is highly advised to avoid SMC whenever possible. Memory is not such a scarce resource anymore. It is better to write separate functions instead of modifying one function according to specific needs. Maybe one day SMC support can be made optional and we can detect exploit code trying to modify code this way. If SMC absolutely has to be used, the write operations should bypass the cache as to not create problems with data in L1d needed in L1i. See section 6.1 for more information on these instructions.

在Linux上，识别包含SMC的程序通常相当容易。用常规工具链构建时，所有程序代码都是写保护的。程序员必须在链接时施展相当的魔法，才能创建代码页可写的可执行文件。当这种情况发生时，现代Intel x86和x86-64处理器有专门的性能计数器来统计自修改代码的使用次数。借助这些计数器，即使程序由于权限放宽而能够成功运行，也很容易识别出带有SMC的程序。

On Linux it is normally quite easy to recognize programs which contain SMC. All program code is write-protected when built with the regular toolchain. The programmer has to perform significant magic at link time to create an executable where the code pages are writable. When this happens, modern Intel x86 and x86-64 processors have dedicated performance counters which count uses of self-modifying code. With the help of these counters it is quite easily possible to recognize programs with SMC even if the program will succeed due to relaxed permissions.

3.5 缓存未命中因素

3.5 Cache Miss Factors

我们已经看到，当内存访问未命中缓存时，代价会急剧上升。有时这是无法避免的，重要的是了解实际的代价以及可以做些什么来缓解这个问题。

We have already seen that when memory accesses miss the caches the costs skyrocket. Sometimes this is not avoidable and it is important to understand the actual costs and what can be done to mitigate the problem.

3.5.1 缓存与内存带宽

3.5.1 Cache and Memory Bandwidth

为了更好地了解处理器的能力，我们测量在最佳情况下的可用带宽。这一测量特别有意思，因为不同处理器版本之间差异很大。这就是为什么本节充满了几台不同机器的数据。测量性能的程序使用x86和x86-64处理器的SSE指令一次加载或存储16字节。与我们的其他测试一样，工作集从1kB增加到512MB，并测量每个周期能加载或存储多少字节。

To get a better understanding of the capabilities of the processors we measure the bandwidth available in optimal circumstances. This measurement is especially interesting since different processor versions vary widely. This is why this section is filled with the data of several different machines. The program to measure performance uses the SSE instructions of the x86 and x86-64 processors to load or store 16 bytes at once. The working set is increased from 1kB to 512MB just as in our other tests and it is measured how many bytes per cycle can be loaded or stored.

图3.24显示了64位Intel Netburst处理器上的性能。对于能放进L1d的工作集大小，处理器能够每个周期读取完整的16字节，即每个周期执行一条加载指令（movaps指令一次移动16字节）。测试对读取的数据不做任何处理，我们只测试读指令本身。一旦L1d不够用了，性能就急剧下降到每周期不到6字节。218字节处的台阶是由于DTLB缓存耗尽，这意味着每个新页面都需要额外的工作。由于读取是顺序的，预取可以完美地预测访问，并且对于所有大小的工作集，FSB都能以每周期约5.3字节的速度流式传输内存内容。不过，预取的数据不会被传播到L1d中。当然，在真实程序中这些数字是永远无法达到的。可以把它们看作实际的极限。

Figure 3.24 shows the performance on a 64-bit Intel Netburst processor. For working set sizes which fit into L1d the processor is able to read the full 16 bytes per cycle, i.e., one load instruction is performed per cycle (the movaps instruction moves 16 bytes at once). The test does not do anything with the read data, we test only the read instructions themselves. As soon as the L1d is not sufficient anymore the performance goes down dramatically to less than 6 bytes per cycle. The step at 218 bytes is due to the exhaustion of the DTLB cache which means additional work for each new page. Since the reading is sequential prefetching can predict the accesses perfectly and the FSB can stream the memory content at about 5.3 bytes per cycle for all sizes of the working set. The prefetched data is not propagated into L1d, though. These are of course numbers which will never be achievable in a real program. Think of them as practical limits.

比读性能更令人吃惊的是写和复制的性能。写性能即使在很小的工作集大小下也从未超过每周期4字节。这表明，在这些Netburst处理器中，Intel选择对L1d使用直写模式，其性能显然受限于L2的速度。这也意味着复制测试（从一个内存区域复制到另一个不重叠的内存区域）的性能并没有显著变差。所需的读操作要快得多，并且可以与写操作部分重叠。写和复制测量中最值得注意的细节是，一旦L2缓存不够用了，性能就变得很低。性能下降到每周期0.5字节！这意味着写操作比读操作慢十倍。这意味着优化这些操作对程序的性能更加重要。

What is more astonishing than the read performance is the write and copy performance. The write performance, even for small working set sizes, does not ever rise above 4 bytes per cycle. This indicates that, in these Netburst processors, Intel elected to use a Write-Through mode for L1d where the performance is obviously limited by the L2 speed. This also means that the performance of the copy test, which copies from one memory region into a second, non-overlapping memory region, is not significantly worse. The necessary read operations are so much faster and can partially overlap with the write operations. The most noteworthy detail of the write and copy measurements is the low performance once the L2 cache is not sufficient anymore. The performance drops to 0.5 bytes per cycle! That means write operations are by a factor of ten slower than the read operations. This means optimizing those operations is even more important for the performance of the program.

在图3.25中，我们看到的是同一处理器上的结果，但运行了两个线程，每个线程固定在处理器的两个超线程之一上。该图以与前一张相同的刻度显示以说明差异，曲线有些抖动仅仅是因为测量两个并发线程的问题。结果符合预期。由于超线程共享除寄存器以外的所有资源，每个线程只能获得一半的缓存和带宽。这意味着即使每个线程都要等待很久并且可以把执行时间让给另一个线程，这也没有任何区别，因为另一个线程也必须等待内存。这确实展示了超线程最糟糕的使用方式。

In Figure 3.25 we see the results on the same processor but with two threads running, one pinned to each of the two hyper-threads of the processor. The graph is shown at the same scale as the previous one to illustrate the differences and the curves are a bit jittery simply because of the problem of measuring two concurrent threads. The results are as expected. Since the hyper-threads share all the resources except the registers each thread has only half the cache and bandwidth available. That means even though each thread has to wait a lot and could award the other thread with execution time this does not make any difference since the other thread also has to wait for the memory. This truly shows the worst possible use of hyper-threads.

与图3.24和3.25相比，图3.26和3.27中Intel Core 2处理器的结果看起来大不相同。这是一个共享L2的双核处理器，其L2是P4机器上L2的四倍大。不过，这只能解释写和复制性能下降被推迟的原因。还有其他更大的差异。在整个工作集范围内，读性能都徘徊在最佳的每周期16字节左右。220字节之后读性能的下降同样是由于工作集对DTLB来说太大了。达到如此高的数字意味着处理器不仅能够预取数据并及时传输数据。这还意味着数据被预取到了L1d中。

Compared to Figure 3.24 and 3.25 the results in Figure 3.26 and 3.27 look quite different for an Intel Core 2 processor. This is a dual-core processor with shared L2 which is four times as big as the L2 on the P4 machine. This only explains the delayed drop-off of the write and copy performance, though. There are other, bigger differences. The read performance throughout the working set range hovers around the optimal 16 bytes per cycle. The drop-off in the read performance after 220 bytes is again due to the working set being too big for the DTLB. Achieving these high numbers means the processor is not only able to prefetch the data and transport the data in time. It also means the data is prefetched into L1d.

写和复制性能也截然不同。处理器没有采用直写策略；写入的数据存储在L1d中，只在必要时才被逐出。这使得写速度接近最佳的每周期16字节。一旦L1d不够用了，性能就显著下降。与Netburst处理器一样，写性能要低得多。由于读性能很高，这里的差异甚至更大。事实上，当连L2也不够用时，速度差异增大到20倍！这并不意味着Core 2处理器表现不佳。恰恰相反，它们的性能总是优于Netburst内核。

The write and copy performance is dramatically different, too. The processor does not have a Write-Through policy; written data is stored in L1d and only evicted when necessary. This allows for write speeds close to the optimal 16 bytes per cycle. Once L1d is not sufficient anymore the performance drops significantly. As with the Netburst processor, the write performance is significantly lower. Due to the high read performance the difference is even higher here. In fact, when even the L2 is not sufficient anymore the speed difference increases to a factor of 20! This does not mean the Core 2 processors perform poorly. To the contrary, their performance is always better than the Netburst core’s.

在图3.27中，测试运行两个线程，分别在Core 2处理器的两个内核上各一个。两个线程访问同一内存，但不一定完全同步。读性能的结果与单线程情况没有什么不同。可以看到更多的抖动，这在任何多线程测试中都是可以预料的。

In Figure 3.27 the test runs two threads, one on each of the two cores of the Core 2 processor. Both threads access the same memory, not necessarily perfectly in sync, though. The results for the read performance are not different from the single-threaded case. A few more jitters are visible which is to be expected in any multi-threaded test case.

有趣的是对于能放进L1d的工作集大小的写和复制性能。从图中可以看到，性能与数据必须从主存读取时相同。两个线程竞争同一内存位置，必须为缓存行发送RFO消息。问题在于，即使两个内核共享L2缓存，这些请求也不是以L2缓存的速度处理的。一旦L1d缓存不够用，修改过的条目就会从每个内核的L1d刷新到共享的L2中。此时性能显著提高，因为现在L1d未命中由L2缓存满足，只有当数据尚未被刷新时才需要RFO消息。这就是为什么我们在这些工作集大小下看到速度降低了50%。渐近行为符合预期：由于两个内核共享同一FSB，每个内核获得一半的FSB带宽，这意味着对于大工作集，每个线程的性能大约是单线程情况的一半。

The interesting point is the write and copy performance for working set sizes which would fit into L1d. As can be seen in the figure, the performance is the same as if the data had to be read from the main memory. Both threads compete for the same memory location and RFO messages for the cache lines have to be sent. The problematic point is that these requests are not handled at the speed of the L2 cache, even though both cores share the cache. Once the L1d cache is not sufficient anymore modified entries are flushed from each core’s L1d into the shared L2. At that point the performance increases significantly since now the L1d misses are satisfied by the L2 cache and RFO messages are only needed when the data has not yet been flushed. This is why we see a 50% reduction in speed for these sizes of the working set. The asymptotic behavior is as expected: since both cores share the same FSB each core gets half the FSB bandwidth which means for large working sets each thread’s performance is about half that of the single threaded case.

由于即使在同一厂商的不同处理器版本之间也存在显著差异，看一看其他厂商处理器的性能当然也是值得的。图3.28显示了AMD family 10h Opteron处理器的性能。该处理器有64kB L1d、512kB L2和2MB的L3。L3缓存由处理器的所有内核共享。性能测试的结果可以在图3.28中看到。

Because there are significant differences even between the processor versions of one vendor it is certainly worthwhile looking at the performance of other vendors’ processors, too. Figure 3.28 shows the performance of an AMD family 10h Opteron processor. This processor has 64kB L1d, 512kB L2, and 2MB of L3. The L3 cache is shared between all cores of the processor. The results of the performance test can be seen in Figure 3.28.

人们注意到这些数字的第一个细节是，如果L1d缓存足够，处理器每个周期能够处理两条指令。读性能超过每周期32字节，甚至写性能也高达每周期18.7字节。不过，读曲线很快就变平了，并且只有每周期2.3字节，相当低。用于这项测试的处理器不预取任何数据，至少不能高效地预取。

The first detail one notices about the numbers is that the processor is capable of handling two instructions per cycle if the L1d cache is sufficient. The read performance exceeds 32 bytes per cycle and even the write performance is, with 18.7 bytes per cycle, high. The read curve flattens quickly, though, and is, with 2.3 bytes per cycle, pretty low. The processor for this test does not prefetch any data, at least not efficiently.

另一方面，写曲线的表现与各级缓存的大小相符。在L1d的全部大小范围内达到峰值性能，对于L2下降到每周期6字节，对于L3下降到每周期2.8字节，如果连L3都无法容纳所有数据，最终下降到每周期0.5字节。L1d缓存的性能超过了（较旧的）Core 2处理器，L2访问同样快（Core 2的缓存更大），而L3和主存访问更慢。

The write curve on the other hand performs according to the sizes of the various caches. The peak performance is achieved for the full size of the L1d, going down to 6 bytes per cycle for L2, to 2.8 bytes per cycle for L3, and finally .5 bytes per cycle if not even L3 can hold all the data. The performance for the L1d cache exceeds that of the (older) Core 2 processor, the L2 access is equally fast (with the Core 2 having a larger cache), and the L3 and main memory access is slower.

复制性能不可能比读或写性能更好。这就是为什么我们看到曲线起初由读性能主导，后来由写性能主导。

The copy performance cannot be better than either the read or write performance. This is why we see the curve initially dominated by the read performance and later by the write performance.

Opteron处理器的多线程性能如图3.29所示。读性能基本不受影响。每个线程的L1d和L2像以前一样工作，而在这种情况下L3缓存也没有得到很好的预取。两个线程并没有为了它们的目的过度地给L3施加压力。这项测试中的大问题是写性能。线程共享的所有数据都必须经过L3缓存。这种共享似乎相当低效，因为即使L3缓存的大小足以容纳整个工作集，代价也明显高于一次L3访问。把这张图与图3.27比较，我们看到，在适当的工作集大小范围内，Core 2处理器的两个线程以共享L2缓存的速度运行。对于Opteron处理器，只有在非常小的工作集大小范围内才能达到这一性能水平，而且即使在那里，它也只接近L3的速度，而L3比Core 2的L2慢。

The multi-thread performance of the Opteron processor is shown in Figure 3.29. The read performance is largely unaffected. Each thread’s L1d and L2 works as before and the L3 cache is in this case not prefetched very well either. The two threads do not unduly stress the L3 for their purpose. The big problem in this test is the write performance. All data the threads share has to go through the L3 cache. This sharing seems to be quite inefficient since even if the L3 cache size is sufficient to hold the entire working set the cost is significantly higher than an L3 access. Comparing this graph with Figure 3.27 we see that the two threads of the Core 2 processor operate at the speed of the shared L2 cache for the appropriate range of working set sizes. This level of performance is achieved for the Opteron processor only for a very small range of the working set sizes and even here it approaches only the speed of the L3 which is slower than the Core 2’s L2.

3.5.2 关键字加载

3.5.2 Critical Word Load

内存以小于缓存行大小的块从主存传输到缓存中。如今一次传输64位，而缓存行大小为64或128字节。这意味着每个缓存行需要8次或16次传输。

Memory is transferred from the main memory into the caches in blocks which are smaller than the cache line size. Today 64 bits are transferred at once and the cache line size is 64 or 128 bytes. This means 8 or 16 transfers per cache line are needed.

DRAM芯片可以以突发模式传输这些64字节的块。这可以填满缓存行，而无需来自内存控制器的任何进一步命令及其可能伴随的延迟。如果处理器预取缓存行，这可能是最好的工作方式。

The DRAM chips can transfer those 64-byte blocks in burst mode. This can fill the cache line without any further commands from the memory controller and the possibly associated delays. If the processor prefetches cache lines this is probably the best way to operate.

如果程序对数据缓存或指令缓存的访问未命中（即这是一次强制性缓存未命中——因为数据是第一次被使用；或者是一次容量缓存未命中——因为有限的缓存大小需要逐出该缓存行），情况就不同了。程序继续运行所需的缓存行中的那个字可能不是缓存行中的第一个字。即使在突发模式下并采用双倍数据速率传输，各个64位块到达的时间也明显不同。每个块都比前一个块晚4个或更多CPU周期到达。如果程序继续运行所需的字是缓存行的第八个字，那么在第一个字到达之后，程序还必须再等待30个或更多周期。

If a program’s cache access of the data or instruction caches misses (that means, it is a compulsory cache miss, because the data is used for the first time, or a capacity cache miss, because the limited cache size requires eviction of the cache line) the situation is different. The word inside the cache line which is required for the program to continue might not be the first word in the cache line. Even in burst mode and with double data rate transfer the individual 64-bit blocks arrive at noticeably different times. Each block arrives 4 CPU cycles or more later than the previous one. If the word the program needs to continue is the eighth of the cache line the program has to wait an additional 30 cycles or more after the first word arrives.

情况不一定非得如此。内存控制器可以自由地以不同的顺序请求缓存行中的字。处理器可以告知程序正在等待的是哪个字，即关键字，内存控制器可以先请求这个字。一旦这个字到达，程序就可以继续运行，而缓存行的其余部分仍在到达途中，缓存尚未处于一致状态。这种技术称为“关键字优先与提前重启”（Critical Word First & Early Restart）。

Things do not necessarily have to be like this. The memory controller is free to request the words of the cache line in a different order. The processor can communicate which word the program is waiting on, the critical word, and the memory controller can request this word first. Once the word arrives the program can continue while the rest of the cache line arrives and the cache is not yet in a consistent state. This technique is called Critical Word First & Early Restart.

如今的处理器实现了这项技术，但有些情况下这是不可能的。如果处理器预取数据，关键字是未知的。如果处理器在预取操作进行期间请求该缓存行，它将不得不等到关键字到达，而无法影响顺序。

Processors nowadays implement this technique but there are situations when that is not possible. If the processor prefetches data the critical word is not known. Should the processor request the cache line during the time the prefetch operation is in flight it will have to wait until the critical word arrives without being able to influence the order.

即使有了这些优化，关键字在缓存行上的位置也很重要。图3.30显示了顺序访问和随机访问的Follow测试。图中显示的是，在指针追逐中所用的指针位于第一个字时与位于最后一个字时相比，运行测试的变慢程度。元素大小为64字节，对应于缓存行大小。数字噪声相当大，但可以看出，一旦L2不足以容纳工作集，关键字在末尾时的性能大约慢0.7%。顺序访问似乎受影响更大一些。这与前面提到的预取下一个缓存行时的问题是一致的。

Even with these optimizations in place the position of the critical word on a cache line matters. Figure 3.30 shows the Follow test for sequential and random access. Shown is the slowdown of running the test with the pointer used in the chase in the first word versus the case when the pointer is in the last word. The element size is 64 bytes, corresponding the cache line size. The numbers are quite noisy but it can be seen that, as soon as the L2 is not sufficient to hold the working set size, the performance of the case where the critical word is at the end is about 0.7% slower. The sequential access appears to be affected a bit more. This would be consistent with the aforementioned problem when prefetching the next cache line.

3.5.3 缓存的布局

3.5.3 Cache Placement

缓存相对于超线程、内核和处理器的布局不受程序员控制。但程序员可以决定线程在哪里执行，这时缓存与所用CPU之间的关系就变得重要了。

Where the caches are placed in relationship to the hyper-threads, cores, and processors is not under control of the programmer. But programmers can determine where the threads are executed and then it becomes important how the caches relate to the used CPUs.

这里我们不深入讨论何时选择哪些内核来运行线程的细节。我们只描述程序员在设置线程亲和性时必须考虑的架构细节。

Here we will not go into details of when to select what cores to run the threads. We will only describe architecture details which the programmer has to take into account when setting the affinity of the threads.

按照定义，超线程共享除寄存器组之外的一切。这包括L1缓存。这里没什么更多可说的。有趣的是处理器的各个内核。每个内核至少有自己的L1缓存。除此之外，如今它们之间没有多少共同的细节：

Hyper-threads, by definition share everything but the register set. This includes the L1 caches. There is not much more to say here. The fun starts with the individual cores of a processor. Each core has at least its own L1 caches. Aside from this there are today not many details in common:

  • 早期的多核处理器根本没有共享缓存。

    Early multi-core processors had no shared caches at all.

  • 后来的Intel型号为双核处理器提供共享的L2缓存。对于四核处理器，我们必须面对每对内核各有一个单独L2缓存的情况。没有更高级别的缓存。

    Later Intel models have shared L2 caches for dual-core processors. For quad-core processors we have to deal with separate L2 caches for each pair of two cores. There are no higher level caches.

  • AMD的family 10h处理器有独立的L2缓存和一个统一的L3缓存。

    AMD’s family 10h processors have separate L2 caches and a unified L3 cache.

处理器厂商的宣传材料中写了很多关于各自型号优点的内容。如果各内核处理的工作集不重叠，没有共享缓存是有好处的。这对单线程程序很有效。由于这在今天往往仍是现实，这种方法的表现并不太差。但总会有一些重叠。所有缓存都包含常用运行时库中最活跃使用的部分，这意味着一些缓存空间被浪费了。

A lot has been written in the propaganda material of the processor vendors about the advantage of their respective models. Having no shared cache has an advantage if the working sets handled by the cores do not overlap. This works well for single-threaded programs. Since this is still often the reality today this approach does not perform too badly. But there is always some overlap. The caches all contain the most actively used parts of the common runtime libraries which means some cache space is wasted.

像Intel的双核处理器那样完全共享除L1之外的所有缓存，可能有很大的优势。如果在两个内核上工作的线程的工作集显著重叠，可用的缓存总量就会增加，工作集可以更大而不会降低性能。如果工作集不重叠，Intel的高级智能缓存（Advanced Smart Cache）管理应该能防止任何一个内核独占整个缓存。

Completely sharing all caches beside L1 as Intel’s dual-core processors do can have a big advantage. If the working set of the threads working on the two cores overlaps significantly the total available cache memory is increased and working sets can be bigger without performance degradation. If the working sets do not overlap Intel’s Advanced Smart Cache management is supposed to prevent any one core from monopolizing the entire cache.

不过，如果两个内核各自为其工作集使用大约一半的缓存，就会产生一些摩擦。缓存必须不断权衡两个内核的缓存使用，作为这种再平衡的一部分而执行的逐出可能选择得很糟糕。为了看出这些问题，我们来看另一个测试程序的结果。

If both cores use about half the cache for their respective working sets there is some friction, though. The cache constantly has to weigh the two cores’ cache use and the evictions performed as part of this rebalancing might be chosen poorly. To see the problems we look at the results of yet another test program.

该测试程序有一个进程使用SSE指令不断地读取或写入一个2MB的内存块。之所以选择2MB，是因为这是该Core 2处理器L2缓存大小的一半。该进程被固定在一个内核上，而第二个进程被固定在另一个内核上。第二个进程读写一个大小可变的内存区域。图中显示了每个周期读取或写入的字节数。显示了四条不同的曲线，对应两个进程读和写的每种组合。读/写曲线对应的是：后台进程总是使用2MB工作集进行写入，而被测进程以可变工作集进行读取。

The test program has one process constantly reading or writing, using SSE instructions, a 2MB block of memory. 2MB was chosen because this is half the size of the L2 cache of this Core 2 processor. The process is pinned to one core while a second process is pinned to the other core. This second process reads and writes a memory region of variable size. The graph shows the number of bytes per cycle which are read or written. Four different graphs are shown, one for each combination of the processes reading and writing. The read/write graph is for the background process, which always uses a 2MB working set to write, and the measured process with variable working set to read.

图中有趣的部分是220到223字节之间的部分。如果两个内核的L2缓存是完全独立的，我们可以预期所有四项测试的性能都会在221到222字节之间下降，也就是说，在L2缓存耗尽的时候。从图3.31中可以看出，情况并非如此。对于后台进程在写入的情况，这一点最为明显。性能在工作集大小达到1MB之前就开始恶化了。两个进程不共享内存，因此这两个进程不会导致RFO消息的产生。这些纯粹是缓存逐出的问题。智能缓存处理存在问题，其结果是每个内核实际感受到的缓存大小更接近1MB，而不是每个内核可用的2MB。人们只能希望，如果内核之间共享的缓存仍然是未来处理器的特性，用于智能缓存处理的算法能够得到修正。

The interesting part of the graph is the part between 220 and 223 bytes. If the L2 cache of the two cores were completely separate we could expect that the performance of all four tests would drop between 221 and 222 bytes, that means, once the L2 cache is exhausted. As we can see in Figure 3.31 this is not the case. For the cases where the background process is writing this is most visible. The performance starts to deteriorate before the working set size reaches 1MB. The two processes do not share memory and therefore the processes do not cause RFO messages to be generated. These are pure cache eviction problems. The smart cache handling has its problems with the effect that the experienced cache size per core is closer to 1MB than the 2MB per core which are available. One can only hope that, if caches shared between cores remain a feature of upcoming processors, the algorithm used for the smart cache handling will be fixed.

拥有两个L2缓存的四核处理器只是在引入更高级别缓存之前的权宜之计。与独立插槽和双核处理器相比，这种设计没有显著的性能优势。两个内核通过同一条总线通信，从外部看这就是FSB。没有特殊的快速数据交换通道。

Having a quad-core processor with two L2 caches was just a stop-gap solution before higher-level caches could be introduced. This design provides no significant performance advantage over separate sockets and dual-core processors. The two cores communicate via the same bus which is, at the outside, visible as the FSB. There is no special fast-track data exchange.

多核处理器缓存设计的未来将在于更多的层级。AMD的10h处理器家族开了个头。我们是否会继续看到较低级别的缓存由处理器的一部分内核共享，还有待观察（在2008年这一代处理器中，L2缓存不共享）。额外的缓存级别是必要的，因为高速且频繁使用的缓存不能在许多内核之间共享。那样会影响性能。它还将需要相联度很高的非常大的缓存。缓存大小和相联度这两个数字都必须随着共享缓存的内核数量而扩展。使用一个大的L3缓存和大小合理的L2缓存是一个合理的权衡。L3缓存较慢，但理想情况下它不像L2缓存那样频繁使用。

The future of cache design for multi-core processors will lie in more layers. AMD’s 10h processor family makes the start. Whether we will continue to see lower level caches be shared by a subset of the cores of a processor remains to be seen (in the 2008 generation of processors L2 caches are not shared). The extra levels of cache are necessary since the high-speed and frequently used caches cannot be shared among many cores. The performance would be impacted. It would also require very large caches with high associativity. Both numbers, the cache size and the associativity, must scale with the number of cores sharing the cache. Using a large L3 cache and reasonably-sized L2 caches is a reasonable trade-off. The L3 cache is slower but it is ideally not as frequently used as the L2 cache.

对于程序员来说，所有这些不同的设计都意味着在作调度决策时的复杂性。为了获得最佳性能，必须了解工作负载和机器架构的细节。幸运的是，我们有支持来确定机器架构。这些接口将在后面的章节中介绍。

For programmers all these different designs mean complexity when making scheduling decisions. One has to know the workloads and the details of the machine architecture to achieve the best performance. Fortunately we have support to determine the machine architecture. The interfaces will be introduced in later sections.

3.5.4 FSB的影响

3.5.4 FSB Influence

FSB在机器的性能中起着核心作用。缓存内容的存储和加载速度只能与到内存的连接所允许的速度一样快。我们可以在两台仅内存模块速度不同的机器上运行一个程序，来展示其影响有多大。图3.32显示了在64位机器上NPAD=7时Addnext0测试（把下一个元素的pad[0]元素的内容加到自己的pad[0]元素上）的结果。两台机器都使用Intel Core 2处理器，第一台使用667MHz DDR2模块，第二台使用800MHz模块（提高了20%）。

The FSB plays a central role in the performance of the machine. Cache content can only be stored and loaded as quickly as the connection to the memory allows. We can show how much so by running a program on two machines which only differ in the speed of their memory modules. Figure 3.32 shows the results of the Addnext0 test (adding the content of the next elements pad[0] element to the own pad[0] element) for NPAD=7 on a 64-bit machine. Both machines have Intel Core 2 processors, the first uses 667MHz DDR2 modules, the second 800MHz modules (a 20% increase).

数字表明，当FSB在大工作集大小下真正承受压力时，我们确实看到了很大的收益。在这项测试中测得的最大性能提升为18.2%，接近理论最大值。这表明，更快的FSB确实可以带来巨大的回报。当工作集能放进缓存时（这些处理器有4MB L2），它并不关键。必须记住，我们在这里测量的是一个程序。一个系统的工作集包括所有并发运行进程所需的内存。这样，使用小得多的程序就很容易超过4MB甚至更多的内存。

The numbers show that, when the FSB is really stressed for large working set sizes, we indeed see a large benefit. The maximum performance increase measured in this test is 18.2%, close to the theoretical maximum. What this shows is that a faster FSB indeed can pay off big time. It is not critical when the working set fits into the caches (and these processors have a 4MB L2). It must be kept in mind that we are measuring one program here. The working set of a system comprises the memory needed by all concurrently running processes. This way it is easily possible to exceed 4MB memory or more with much smaller programs.

如今Intel的一些处理器支持高达1,333MHz的FSB速度，这将意味着再提高60%。未来将会看到更高的速度。如果速度很重要并且工作集较大，快速的RAM和高FSB速度当然值得花钱。不过必须小心，因为即使处理器可能支持更高的FSB速度，主板/北桥却可能不支持。检查规格至关重要。

Today some of Intel’s processors support FSB speeds up to 1,333MHz which would mean another 60% increase. The future is going to see even higher speeds. If speed is important and the working set sizes are larger, fast RAM and high FSB speeds are certainly worth the money. One has to be careful, though, since even though the processor might support higher FSB speeds the motherboard/Northbridge might not. It is critical to check the specifications.

  1. ↑ 在更早的系统中，缓存像CPU和主存一样连接到系统总线上。这与其说是真正的解决方案，不如说是一种权宜之计。

    ↑ In even earlier systems the cache was attached to the system bus just like the CPU and the main memory. This was more a hack than a real solution.

  2. ↑ 早期的多核处理器甚至拥有独立的二级缓存，并且没有三级缓存。

    ↑ Early multi-core processors even had separate 2nd level caches and no 3rd level cache.

  3. ↑ 地址的S部分相同的所有缓存行都被称为同一个别名。

    ↑ All cache lines with the same S part of the address are known by the same alias.

  4. ↑ 这种概括并不完全正确。有少数缓存是独占式的，而一些包含式缓存也具有独占式缓存的特性。

    ↑ This generalization is not completely correct. A few caches are exclusive and some inclusive caches have exclusive cache properties.

  5. ↑ 是的，这有点不一致，因为在其他测试中我们把结构中未使用的部分计入了元素大小，而且我们本可以定义NPAD使每个元素填满一页。在那种情况下，工作集大小会非常不同。不过这并不是这项测试的重点，而且由于预取无论如何都是无效的，这几乎没有什么区别。

    ↑ Yes, this is a bit inconsistent because in the other tests we count the unused part of the struct in the element size and we could define NPAD so that each element fills a page. In that case the working set sizes would be very different. This is not the point of this test, though, and since prefetching is ineffective anyway this makes little difference.

  6. ↑ 在更小的层面上，同一处理器上的两个内核也是如此。只是代价稍小一些。RFO消息很可能会被发送很多次。

    ↑ Which is why we see nowadays, for instance, AMD Opteron systems with three sockets. Each processor is exactly one hop away given that the processors only have three hyperlinks and one is needed for the Northbridge connection.

    ↑ Another reason to keep hyper-threads enabled is debugging. SMT is astonishingly good at finding some sets of problems in parallel code.

4 虚拟内存

4 Virtual Memory

处理器的虚拟内存（VM）子系统实现了为每个进程提供的虚拟地址空间。这使得每个进程都认为自己独占系统。虚拟内存的种种优点在其他地方已有详细描述，这里不再赘述。本节转而集中讨论虚拟内存子系统的实际实现细节及相关代价。

The virtual memory (VM) subsystem of a processor implements the virtual address spaces provided to each process. This makes each process think it is alone in the system. The list of advantages of virtual memory are described in detail elsewhere so they will not be repeated here. Instead this section concentrates on the actual implementation details of the virtual memory subsystem and the associated costs.

虚拟地址空间由CPU的内存管理单元（MMU）实现。操作系统必须填写页表数据结构，但大多数CPU会自行完成其余的工作。这实际上是一个相当复杂的机制；理解它的最好方法是介绍用于描述虚拟地址空间的数据结构。

A virtual address space is implemented by the Memory Management Unit (MMU) of the CPU. The OS has to fill out the page table data structures, but most CPUs do the rest of the work themselves. This is actually a pretty complicated mechanism; the best way to understand it is to introduce the data structures used to describe the virtual address space.

MMU所执行的地址转换的输入是一个虚拟地址。对其取值通常没有什么限制——即使有也很少。在32位系统上虚拟地址是32位的值，在64位系统上是64位的值。在某些系统上，例如x86和x86-64，所使用的地址实际上还涉及另一层间接：这些架构使用段，段只是给每个逻辑地址加上一个偏移量。我们可以忽略地址生成的这一部分，它很简单，而且就内存处理的性能而言，程序员不必关心它。24

The input to the address translation performed by the MMU is a virtual address. There are usually few–if any–restrictions on its value. Virtual addresses are 32-bit values on 32-bit systems, and 64-bit values on 64-bit systems. On some systems, for instance x86 and x86-64, the addresses used actually involve another level of indirection: these architectures use segments which simply cause an offset to be added to every logical address. We can ignore this part of address generation, it is trivial and not something that programmers have to care about with respect to performance of memory handling.24

4.1 最简单的地址转换

4.1 Simplest Address Translation

有趣的部分是把虚拟地址转换为物理地址。MMU可以按页重新映射地址。就像寻址缓存行时一样，虚拟地址被分成几个不同的部分。这些部分被用作索引，访问构建最终物理地址时所用的各种表。在最简单的模型中，我们只有一级表。

The interesting part is the translation of the virtual address to a physical address. The MMU can remap addresses on a page-by-page basis. Just as when addressing cache lines, the virtual address is split into distinct parts. These parts are used to index into various tables which are used in the construction of the final physical address. For the simplest model we have only one level of tables.

图4.1展示了虚拟地址的不同部分是如何使用的。高位部分用于在页目录中选择一个条目；该目录中的每个条目都可以由操作系统单独设置。页目录条目决定了一个物理内存页的地址；页目录中可以有不止一个条目指向同一个物理地址。存储单元的完整物理地址由页目录中的页地址与虚拟地址的低位组合而成。页目录条目还包含有关该页的一些附加信息，例如访问权限。

Figure 4.1 shows how the different parts of the virtual address are used. A top part is used to select an entry in a Page Directory; each entry in that directory can be individually set by the OS. The page directory entry determines the address of a physical memory page; more than one entry in the page directory can point to the same physical address. The complete physical address of the memory cell is determined by combining the page address from the page directory with the low bits from the virtual address. The page directory entry also contains some additional information about the page such as access permissions.

页目录的数据结构存储在主存中。操作系统必须分配连续的物理内存，并把该内存区域的基地址存入一个特殊寄存器。然后虚拟地址的相应位被用作页目录的索引，而页目录实际上就是一个目录条目数组。

The data structure for the page directory is stored in main memory. The OS has to allocate contiguous physical memory and store the base address of this memory region in a special register. The appropriate bits of the virtual address are then used as an index into the page directory, which is actually an array of directory entries.

举一个具体的例子，这是x86机器上4MB页所使用的布局。虚拟地址的偏移部分为22位，足以寻址4MB页中的每个字节。虚拟地址剩下的10位用于选择页目录中1024个条目之一。每个条目包含一个4MB页的10位基地址，它与偏移量组合形成完整的32位地址。

For a concrete example, this is the layout used for 4MB pages on x86 machines. The Offset part of the virtual address is 22 bits in size, enough to address every byte in a 4MB page. The remaining 10 bits of the virtual address select one of the 1024 entries in the page directory. Each entry contains a 10 bit base address of a 4MB page which is combined with the offset to form a complete 32 bit address.

4.2 多级页表

4.2 Multi-Level Page Tables

4MB页并不是常态，它们会浪费大量内存，因为操作系统必须执行的许多操作都要求按内存页对齐。对于4kB页（这是32位机器上的常态，在64位机器上也仍然常见），虚拟地址的偏移部分只有12位。这就剩下20位作为页目录的选择器。一个有220个条目的表是不切实际的。即使每个条目只有4字节，这个表也有4MB大。由于每个进程都可能拥有自己独立的页目录，系统的大部分物理内存都将被这些页目录占用。

4MB pages are not the norm, they would waste a lot of memory since many operations an OS has to perform require alignment to memory pages. With 4kB pages (the norm on 32-bit machines and, still, often on 64-bit machines), the Offset part of the virtual address is only 12 bits in size. This leaves 20 bits as the selector of the page directory. A table with 220 entries is not practical. Even if each entry would be only 4 bytes the table would be 4MB in size. With each process potentially having its own distinct page directory much of the physical memory of the system would be tied up for these page directories.

解决办法是使用多级页表。这些层级共同构成一个巨大的稀疏页目录；地址空间中实际未被使用的区域不需要分配内存。这样的表示方式紧凑得多，使得内存中可以容纳许多进程的页表，而不会对性能造成太大影响。

The solution is to use multiple levels of page tables. The level then form a huge, sparse page directory; address space regions which are not actually used do not require allocated memory. The representation is therefore much more compact, making it possible to have the page tables for many processes in memory without impacting performance too much.

如今最复杂的页表结构包含四级。图4.2展示了这样一种实现的示意图。在这个例子中，虚拟地址被分成至少五个部分。其中四个部分是各级目录的索引。第4级目录通过CPU中的一个专用寄存器引用。第4级到第2级目录的内容是对下一级目录的引用。如果一个目录条目被标记为空，它显然不必指向任何更低级的目录。这样页表树就可以是稀疏而紧凑的。第1级目录的条目就像在图4.1中一样，是部分物理地址，外加访问权限之类的辅助数据。

Today the most complicated page table structures comprise four levels. Figure 4.2 shows the schematics of such an implementation. The virtual address is, in this example, split into at least five parts. Four of these parts are indexes into the various directories. The level 4 directory is referenced using a special-purpose register in the CPU. The content of the level 4 to level 2 directories is a reference to next lower level directory. If a directory entry is marked empty it obviously need not point to any lower directory. This way the page table tree can be sparse and compact. The entries of the level 1 directory are, just like in Figure 4.1, partial physical addresses, plus auxiliary data like access permissions.

为了确定与某个虚拟地址对应的物理地址，处理器首先确定最高级目录的地址。这个地址通常存储在一个寄存器中。然后CPU取出虚拟地址中对应于该目录的索引部分，用这个索引挑选出相应的条目。这个条目是下一级目录的地址，再用虚拟地址的下一部分对其进行索引。这一过程持续进行，直到到达第1级目录，此时目录条目的值就是物理地址的高位部分。加上虚拟地址中的页偏移位，物理地址就完整了。这个过程称为页树遍历。有些处理器（如x86和x86-64）在硬件中执行这一操作，另一些则需要操作系统的协助。

To determine the physical address corresponding to a virtual address the processor first determines the address of the highest level directory. This address is usually stored in a register. Then the CPU takes the index part of the virtual address corresponding to this directory and uses that index to pick the appropriate entry. This entry is the address of the next directory, which is indexed using the next part of the virtual address. This process continues until it reaches the level 1 directory, at which point the value of the directory entry is the high part of the physical address. The physical address is completed by adding the page offset bits from the virtual address. This process is called page tree walking. Some processors (like x86 and x86-64) perform this operation in hardware, others need assistance from the OS.

系统上运行的每个进程都可能需要自己的页表树。部分共享页表树是可能的，但这只是例外。因此，如果页表树所需的内存尽可能少，对性能和可扩展性都有好处。理想的情况是把所使用的内存在虚拟地址空间中彼此靠近地放置；实际使用的物理地址并不重要。一个小程序可能只需在第2、3、4级各使用一个目录，再加上少量第1级目录就够了。在x86-64上，使用4kB页且每个目录有512个条目，总共用4个目录（每级一个）就可以寻址2MB。1GB的连续内存可以用第2到第4级各一个目录、第1级512个目录来寻址。

Each process running on the system might need its own page table tree. It is possible to partially share trees but this is rather the exception. It is therefore good for performance and scalability if the memory needed by the page table trees is as small as possible. The ideal case for this is to place the used memory close together in the virtual address space; the actual physical addresses used do not matter. A small program might get by with using just one directory at each of levels 2, 3, and 4 and a few level 1 directories. On x86-64 with 4kB pages and 512 entries per directory this allows the addressing of 2MB with a total of 4 directories (one for each level). 1GB of contiguous memory can be addressed with one directory for levels 2 to 4 and 512 directories for level 1.

不过，假设所有内存都可以连续分配未免太过简单化了。出于灵活性的考虑，一个进程的栈和堆区域在大多数情况下被分配在地址空间几乎相对的两端。这使得任何一个区域在需要时都能尽可能地增长。这意味着很可能需要两个第2级目录，以及相应更多的低级目录。

Assuming all memory can be allocated contiguously is too simplistic, though. For flexibility reasons the stack and the heap area of a process are, in most cases, allocated at pretty much opposite ends of the address space. This allows either area to grow as much as possible if needed. This means that there are most likely two level 2 directories needed and correspondingly more lower level directories.

但即便如此也并不总是符合当前的实践。出于安全原因，可执行文件的各个部分（代码、数据、堆、栈、动态共享对象（DSO，又称共享库））被映射到随机化的地址上[9]。随机化扩展到各部分的相对位置；这意味着进程中使用的各个内存区域在整个虚拟地址空间中分布得很广。通过对地址中被随机化的位数加以限制，可以缩小范围，但在大多数情况下，这肯定无法让进程只用一两个第2级和第3级目录就能运行。

But even this does not always match current practice. For security reasons the various parts of an executable (code, data, heap, stack, Dynamic Shared Objects (DSOs), aka shared libraries) are mapped at randomized addresses [9]. The randomization extends to the relative position of the various parts; that implies that the various memory regions in use in a process are widespread throughout the virtual address space. By applying some limits to the number of bits of the address which are randomized the range can be restricted, but it certainly, in most cases, will not allow a process to run with just one or two directories for levels 2 and 3.

如果性能真的比安全重要得多，可以关闭随机化。这时操作系统通常至少会把所有DSO连续地加载到虚拟内存中。

If performance is really much more important than security, randomization can be turned off. The OS will then usually at least load all DSOs contiguously in virtual memory.

4.3 优化页表访问

4.3 Optimizing Page Table Access

页表的所有数据结构都保存在主存中；操作系统在那里构建和更新这些表。在创建进程或修改页表时，CPU会得到通知。页表通过上面描述的页表遍历，把每个虚拟地址解析为物理地址。更确切地说：在解析一个虚拟地址的过程中，每一级至少要使用一个目录。这需要多达四次内存访问（针对运行中进程的一次访问），这很慢。可以把这些目录表条目当作普通数据，缓存在L1d、L2等中，但这样仍然太慢了。

All the data structures for the page tables are kept in the main memory; this is where the OS constructs and updates the tables. Upon creation of a process or a change of a page table the CPU is notified. The page tables are used to resolve every virtual address into a physical address using the page table walk described above. More to the point: at least one directory for each level is used in the process of resolving a virtual address. This requires up to four memory accesses (for a single access by the running process) which is slow. It is possible to treat these directory table entries as normal data and cache them in L1d, L2, etc., but this would still be far too slow.

从虚拟内存的最早期开始，CPU设计者就使用了一种不同的优化。一个简单的计算就可以表明，只把目录表条目保存在L1d及更高级的缓存中，性能会非常糟糕。每一次绝对地址计算都需要与页表深度相对应的若干次L1d访问。这些访问无法并行化，因为它们依赖于前一次查找的结果。仅此一项，在有四级页表的机器上就至少需要12个周期。再加上L1d未命中的可能性，其结果是指令流水线无法隐藏的。额外的L1d访问还会抢占宝贵的缓存带宽。

From the earliest days of virtual memory, CPU designers have used a different optimization. A simple computation can show that only keeping the directory table entries in the L1d and higher cache would lead to horrible performance. Each absolute address computation would require a number of L1d accesses corresponding to the page table depth. These accesses cannot be parallelized since they depend on the previous lookup’s result. This alone would, on a machine with four page table levels, require at the very least 12 cycles. Add to that the probability of an L1d miss and the result is nothing the instruction pipeline can hide. The additional L1d accesses also steal precious bandwidth to the cache.

因此，被缓存的不只是目录表条目，而是物理页地址的完整计算结果。出于与代码缓存和数据缓存有效的相同原因，这种被缓存的地址计算也是有效的。由于虚拟地址的页偏移部分在物理页地址的计算中不起任何作用，只有虚拟地址的其余部分被用作缓存的标记。根据页大小的不同，这意味着成百上千条指令或数据对象共享同一个标记，因而共享同一个物理地址前缀。

So, instead of just caching the directory table entries, the complete computation of the address of the physical page is cached. For the same reason that code and data caches work, such a cached address computation is effective. Since the page offset part of the virtual address does not play any part in the computation of the physical page address, only the rest of the virtual address is used as the tag for the cache. Depending on the page size this means hundreds or thousands of instructions or data objects share the same tag and therefore same physical address prefix.

存放这些计算结果的缓存称为转换后备缓冲区（TLB）。由于它必须极快，它通常是一个很小的缓存。现代CPU与其他缓存一样提供多级TLB缓存；更高级别的缓存更大、更慢。L1TLB容量小的缺点通常通过使其成为全相联缓存并采用LRU逐出策略来弥补。最近，这种缓存的容量一直在增长，在此过程中被改为组相联的。因此，每当必须添加一个新条目时，被逐出和替换的不一定是最旧的条目。

The cache into which the computed values are stored is called the Translation Look-Aside Buffer (TLB). It is usually a small cache since it has to be extremely fast. Modern CPUs provide multi-level TLB caches, just as for the other caches; the higher-level caches are larger and slower. The small size of the L1TLB is often made up for by making the cache fully associative, with an LRU eviction policy. Recently, this cache has been growing in size and, in the process, was changed to be set associative. As a result, it might not be the oldest entry which gets evicted and replaced whenever a new entry has to be added.

如上所述，用于访问TLB的标记是虚拟地址的一部分。如果标记在缓存中有匹配，就把虚拟地址中的页偏移加到缓存的值上，计算出最终的物理地址。这是一个非常快的过程；它也必须很快，因为每一条使用绝对地址的指令都需要物理地址，在某些情况下，以物理地址为键的L2查找也需要它。如果TLB查找未命中，处理器就必须执行页表遍历；这可能代价相当高。

As noted above, the tag used to access the TLB is a part of the virtual address. If the tag has a match in the cache, the final physical address is computed by adding the page offset from the virtual address to the cached value. This is a very fast process; it has to be since the physical address must be available for every instruction using absolute addresses and, in some cases, for L2 look-ups which use the physical address as the key. If the TLB lookup misses the processor has to perform a page table walk; this can be quite costly.

如果地址位于另一页上，通过软件或硬件预取代码或数据可能会隐式地预取TLB条目。对于硬件预取，这是不能允许的，因为硬件可能会发起无效的页表遍历。因此程序员不能依赖硬件预取来预取TLB条目。这必须使用预取指令显式地完成。TLB与数据缓存和指令缓存一样，可以有多级。与数据缓存一样，TLB通常有两种形式：指令TLB（ITLB）和数据TLB（DTLB）。像L2TLB这样的更高级TLB通常是统一的，其他缓存也是如此。

Prefetching code or data through software or hardware could implicitly prefetch entries for the TLB if the address is on another page. This cannot be allowed for hardware prefetching because the hardware could initiate page table walks that are invalid. Programmers therefore cannot rely on hardware prefetching to prefetch TLB entries. It has to be done explicitly using prefetch instructions. TLBs, just like data and instruction caches, can appear in multiple levels. Just as for the data cache, the TLB usually appears in two flavors: an instruction TLB (ITLB) and a data TLB (DTLB). Higher-level TLBs such as the L2TLB are usually unified, as is the case with the other caches.

4.3.1 使用TLB的注意事项

4.3.1 Caveats Of Using A TLB

TLB是处理器内核的全局资源。在该处理器内核上执行的所有线程和进程都使用同一个TLB。由于虚拟地址到物理地址的转换取决于安装的是哪棵页表树，如果页表发生变化，CPU不能盲目地重用缓存的条目。每个进程都有不同的页表树（但同一进程中的线程没有），内核和VMM（虚拟机监视器，如果存在的话）也有各自的页表树。进程的地址空间布局也可能发生变化。有两种方法来处理这个问题：

The TLB is a processor-core global resource. All threads and processes executed on the processor core use the same TLB. Since the translation of virtual to physical addresses depends on which page table tree is installed, the CPU cannot blindly reuse the cached entries if the page table is changed. Each process has a different page table tree (but not the threads in the same process) as does the kernel and the VMM (hypervisor) if present. It is also possible that the address space layout of a process changes. There are two ways to deal with this problem:

  • 每当页表树改变时就刷新TLB。

    The TLB is flushed whenever the page table tree is changed.

  • 扩展TLB条目的标记，使其额外地、唯一地标识它们所引用的页表树。

    The tags for the TLB entries are extended to additionally and uniquely identify the page table tree they refer to.

在第一种情况下，每当执行上下文切换时都要刷新TLB。由于在大多数操作系统中，从一个线程/进程切换到另一个线程/进程需要执行一些内核代码，TLB刷新被限制在离开（有时是进入）内核地址空间时。在虚拟化系统上，当内核必须调用VMM时以及返回时也会发生刷新。如果内核和/或VMM不必使用虚拟地址，或者可以重用发起系统调用/VMM调用的进程或内核的同一组虚拟地址（即地址空间是叠加的），那么只有当离开内核或VMM时处理器要恢复执行一个不同的进程或内核时，才需要刷新TLB。

In the first case the TLB is flushed whenever a context switch is performed. Since, in most OSes, a switch from one thread/process to another requires executing some kernel code, TLB flushes are restricted to leaving (and sometimes entering) the kernel address space. On virtualized systems it also happens when the kernel has to call the VMM and on the way back. If the kernel and/or VMM does not have to use virtual addresses, or can reuse the same virtual addresses as the process or kernel which made the system/VMM call (i.e., the address spaces are overlaid), the TLB only has to be flushed if, upon leaving the kernel or VMM, the processor resumes execution of a different process or kernel.

刷新TLB是有效的，但代价很高。例如，在执行一次系统调用时，内核代码可能只有几千条指令，接触的可能只是少数几个新页（或者一个大页，就像Linux在某些架构上那样）。这项工作替换的TLB条目数只与接触的页数一样多。对于Intel的Core2架构，它有128个ITLB条目和256个DTLB条目，一次完全刷新将意味着分别有100多个和200多个条目被不必要地刷新。当系统调用返回到同一进程时，所有这些被刷新的TLB条目本可以再次使用，但它们已经没了。内核或VMM中经常使用的代码也是如此。每次进入内核时，TLB都必须从头开始填充，尽管内核和VMM的页表通常不会改变，因而TLB条目理论上可以保留很长时间。这也解释了为什么如今处理器中的TLB缓存没有更大：程序很可能运行不了足够长的时间来填满所有这些条目。

Flushing the TLB is effective but expensive. When executing a system call, for instance, the kernel code might be restricted to a few thousand instructions which touch, perhaps, a handful of new pages (or one huge page, as is the case for Linux on some architectures). This work would replace only as many TLB entries as pages are touched. For Intel’s Core2 architecture with its 128 ITLB and 256 DTLB entries, a full flush would mean that more than 100 and 200 entries (respectively) would be flushed unnecessarily. When the system call returns to the same process, all those flushed TLB entries can be used again, but they will be gone. The same is true for often-used code in the kernel or VMM. On each entry into the kernel the TLB has to be filled from scratch even though the page tables for the kernel and VMM usually do not change and, therefore, TLB entries could, in theory, be preserved for a very long time. This also explains why the TLB caches in today’s processors are not bigger: programs most likely will not run long enough to fill all these entries.

这一事实当然没有逃过CPU架构师的眼睛。优化缓存刷新的一种可能是单独使TLB条目失效。例如，如果内核代码和数据落在某个特定的地址范围内，就只需要把落在这个地址范围内的页从TLB中逐出。这只需要比较标记，因此代价不高。这种方法在地址空间的一部分发生变化时也很有用，例如通过调用munmap。

This fact, of course, did not escape the CPU architects. One possibility to optimize the cache flushes is to individually invalidate TLB entries. For instance, if the kernel code and data falls into a specific address range, only the pages falling into this address range have to evicted from the TLB. This only requires comparing tags and, therefore, is not very expensive. This method is also useful in case a part of the address space is changed, for instance, through a call to munmap.

一个好得多的解决方案是扩展用于TLB访问的标记。如果除了虚拟地址的部分之外，再为每棵页表树（即一个进程的地址空间）加上一个唯一的标识符，TLB就根本不必完全刷新。内核、VMM以及各个进程都可以拥有唯一的标识符。这一方案唯一的问题是，可用于TLB标记的位数非常有限，而地址空间的数量却没有限制。这意味着一些标识符需要被重用。发生这种情况时，必须部分地刷新TLB（如果可能的话）。所有带有被重用标识符的条目都必须被刷新，但希望这是一个小得多的集合。

A much better solution is to extend the tag used for the TLB access. If, in addition to the part of the virtual address, a unique identifier for each page table tree (i.e., a process’s address space) is added, the TLB does not have to be completely flushed at all. The kernel, VMM, and the individual processes all can have unique identifiers. The only issue with this scheme is that the number of bits available for the TLB tag is severely limited, while the number of address spaces is not. This means some identifier reuse is necessary. When this happens the TLB has to be partially flushed (if this is possible). All entries with the reused identifier must be flushed but this is, hopefully, a much smaller set.

当系统上运行多个进程时，这种扩展的TLB标记在虚拟化领域之外也是有好处的。如果每个可运行进程的内存使用（因而TLB条目使用）是有限的，那么当一个进程再次被调度时，它最近使用的TLB条目很有可能仍在TLB中。但还有两个额外的优点：

This extended TLB tagging is of advantage outside the realm of virtualization when multiple processes are running on the system. If the memory use (and hence TLB entry use) of each of the runnable processes is limited, there is a good chance the most recently used TLB entries for a process are still in the TLB when it gets scheduled again. But there are two additional advantages:

  1. 特殊的地址空间，例如内核和VMM所使用的地址空间，通常只被进入很短的时间；之后控制权通常返回到发起进入的那个地址空间。没有标记时，要执行一到两次TLB刷新。有了标记，调用方地址空间的缓存转换结果得以保留，而且由于内核和VMM地址空间根本不常改变TLB条目，之前系统调用等的转换结果仍然可以使用。

    Special address spaces, such as those used by the kernel and VMM, are often only entered for a short time; afterward control is often returned to the address space which initiated the entry. Without tags, one or two TLB flushes are performed. With tags the calling address space’s cached translations are preserved and, since the kernel and VMM address space do not often change TLB entries at all, the translations from previous system calls, etc. can still be used.

  2. 在同一进程的两个线程之间切换时，根本不需要刷新TLB。不过，如果没有扩展的TLB标记，进入内核就会破坏第一个线程的TLB条目。

    When switching between two threads of the same process no TLB flush is necessary at all. Without extended TLB tags the entry into the kernel destroys the first thread’s TLB entries, though.

有些处理器已经实现这些扩展标记一段时间了。AMD在Pacifica虚拟化扩展中引入了1位的标记扩展。这个1位的地址空间ID（ASID）在虚拟化的语境下用于区分VMM的地址空间与客户域的地址空间。这使得操作系统可以避免在每次进入VMM时（例如为了处理缺页）刷新客户的TLB条目，或在控制权返回客户时刷新VMM的TLB条目。该架构将来会允许使用更多的位。其他主流处理器很可能会效仿并支持这一特性。

Some processors have, for some time, implemented these extended tags. AMD introduced a 1-bit tag extension with the Pacifica virtualization extensions. This 1-bit Address Space ID (ASID) is, in the context of virtualization, used to distinguish the VMM’s address space from that of the guest domains. This allows the OS to avoid flushing the guest’s TLB entries every time the VMM is entered (for instance, to handle a page fault) or the VMM’s TLB entries when control returns to the guest. The architecture will allow the use of more bits in the future. Other mainstream processors will likely follow suit and support this feature.

4.3.2 影响TLB性能

4.3.2 Influencing TLB Performance

有几个因素会影响TLB的性能。第一个是页的大小。显然，页越大，能放进去的指令或数据对象就越多。因此，更大的页大小减少了所需地址转换的总数，这意味着需要的TLB缓存条目更少。如今大多数架构都允许使用多种不同的页大小；有些大小可以同时使用。例如，x86/x86-64处理器的常规页大小为4kB，但它们也可以分别使用4MB和2MB的页。IA-64和PowerPC允许使用64kB之类的大小作为基本页大小。

There are a couple of factors which influence TLB performance. The first is the size of the pages. Obviously, the larger a page is, the more instructions or data objects will fit into it. So a larger page size reduces the overall number of address translations which are needed, meaning that fewer entries in the TLB cache are needed. Most architectures nowadays allow the use of multiple different page sizes; some sizes can be used concurrently. For instance, the x86/x86-64 processors have a normal page size of 4kB but they can also use 4MB and 2MB pages respectively. IA-64 and PowerPC allow sizes like 64kB as the base page size.

不过，使用大页也带来了一些问题。用于大页的内存区域在物理内存中必须是连续的。如果把物理内存管理的单位大小提高到虚拟内存页的大小，浪费的内存量就会增加。各种内存操作（例如加载可执行文件）都要求与页边界对齐。这意味着平均而言，每次映射都会在物理内存中浪费半个页大小。这种浪费很容易累积起来；因此它为物理内存分配的合理单位大小设定了上限。

The use of large page sizes brings some problems with it, though. The memory regions used for the large pages must be contiguous in physical memory. If the unit size for the administration of physical memory is raised to the size of the virtual memory pages, the amount of wasted memory will grow. All kinds of memory operations (like loading executables) require alignment to page boundaries. This means, on average, that each mapping wastes half the page size in physical memory for each mapping. This waste can easily add up; it thus puts an upper limit on the reasonable unit size for physical memory allocation.

为了在x86-64上容纳大页而把单位大小提高到2MB，肯定是不切实际的。这个尺寸实在太大了。但这又意味着每个大页必须由许多较小的页组成。而这些小页在物理内存中必须是连续的。在单位页大小为4kB的情况下分配2MB的连续物理内存可能很有挑战性。它需要找到一个有512个连续页的空闲区域。在系统运行一段时间、物理内存变得碎片化之后，这可能极其困难（甚至不可能）。

It is certainly not practical to increase the unit size to 2MB to accommodate large pages on x86-64. This is just too large a size. But this in turn means that each large page has to be comprised of many smaller pages. And these small pages have to be contiguous in physical memory. Allocating 2MB of contiguous physical memory with a unit page size of 4kB can be challenging. It requires finding a free area with 512 contiguous pages. This can be extremely difficult (or impossible) after the system runs for a while and physical memory becomes fragmented.

因此在Linux上，需要在系统启动时使用特殊的hugetlbfs文件系统来分配这些大页。固定数量的物理页被保留下来，专门用作大虚拟页。这会占用可能并不总是被使用的资源。它也是一个有限的池；增大它通常意味着要重启系统。尽管如此，在性能至上、资源充裕、繁琐的设置也不构成大障碍的情况下，大页仍是可取之道。数据库服务器就是一个例子。

On Linux it is therefore necessary to allocate these big pages at system start time using the special hugetlbfs filesystem. A fixed number of physical pages are reserved for exclusive use as big virtual pages. This ties down resources which might not always be used. It also is a limited pool; increasing it normally means restarting the system. Still, huge pages are the way to go in situations where performance is a premium, resources are plenty, and cumbersome setup is not a big deterrent. Database servers are an example.

提高最小虚拟页大小（与可选的大页相对）也有其问题。内存映射操作（例如加载应用程序）必须符合这些页大小。不可能有更小的映射。对于大多数架构，可执行文件各部分的位置有着固定的关系。如果页大小超出了构建可执行文件或DSO时所考虑的范围，加载操作就无法执行。记住这一限制很重要。图4.3展示了如何确定一个ELF二进制文件的对齐要求。它编码在ELF程序头中。在这个例子中，即一个x86-64二进制文件，该值为20000016 = 2,097,152 = 2MB，对应于处理器支持的最大页大小。

Increasing the minimum virtual page size (as opposed to optional big pages) has its problems, too. Memory mapping operations (loading applications, for example) must conform to these page sizes. No smaller mappings are possible. The location of the various parts of an executable have, for most architectures, a fixed relationship. If the page size is increased beyond what has been taken into account when the executable or DSO was built, the load operation cannot be performed. It is important to keep this limitation in mind. Figure 4.3 shows how the alignment requirements of an ELF binary can be determined. It is encoded in the ELF program header. In this example, an x86-64 binary, the value is 20000016 = 2,097,152 = 2MB which corresponds to the maximum page size supported by the processor.

使用更大的页还有第二个效果：页表树的级数减少了。由于虚拟地址中对应于页偏移的部分增加了，需要通过页目录来处理的位就没有那么多了。这意味着在TLB未命中的情况下，需要做的工作量减少了。

There is a second effect of using larger page sizes: the number of levels of the page table tree is reduced. Since the part of the virtual address corresponding to the page offset increases, there are not that many bits left which need to be handled through page directories. This means that, in case of a TLB miss, the amount of work which has to be done is reduced.

除了使用大页之外，还可以通过把同时使用的数据移到更少的页中来减少所需的TLB条目数。这类似于我们前面讨论过的一些针对缓存使用的优化。只是现在所需的对齐粒度要大得多。鉴于TLB条目的数量相当少，这可能是一项重要的优化。

Beyond using large page sizes, it is possible to reduce the number of TLB entries needed by moving data which is used at the same time to fewer pages. This is similar to some optimizations for cache use we talked about above. Only now the alignment required is large. Given that the number of TLB entries is quite small this can be an important optimization.

4.4 虚拟化的影响

4.4 Impact Of Virtualization

操作系统映像的虚拟化将变得越来越普遍；这意味着在图景中又加入了一层内存处理。进程的虚拟化（基本上就是jail）或操作系统容器不属于这一类，因为只涉及一个操作系统。像Xen或KVM这样的技术——无论是否借助处理器的帮助——能够执行独立的操作系统映像。在这些情况下，只有一个软件直接控制对物理内存的访问。

Virtualization of OS images will become more and more prevalent; this means another layer of memory handling is added to the picture. Virtualization of processes (basically jails) or OS containers do not fall into this category since only one OS is involved. Technologies like Xen or KVM enable–with or without help from the processor–the execution of independent OS images. In these situations there is one piece of software alone which directly controls access to the physical memory.

在Xen的情况下（见图4.4），Xen VMM就是这个软件。不过，VMM本身并不实现许多其他的硬件控制。与其他更早系统上的VMM（以及Xen VMM的第一个版本）不同，内存和处理器之外的硬件由特权的Dom0域控制。目前，它基本上与非特权的DomU内核是同一个内核，就内存处理而言，二者没有区别。这里重要的是，VMM把物理内存分发给Dom0和DomU内核，然后这些内核自己实现通常的内存处理，就好像它们直接运行在处理器上一样。

In the case of Xen (see Figure 4.4) the Xen VMM is that piece of software. The VMM does not implement many of the other hardware controls itself, though. Unlike VMMs on other, earlier systems (and the first release of the Xen VMM) the hardware outside of memory and processors is controlled by the privileged Dom0 domain. Currently, this is basically the same kernel as the unprivileged DomU kernels and, as far as memory handling is concerned, they do not differ. Important here is that the VMM hands out physical memory to the Dom0 and DomU kernels which, themselves, then implement the usual memory handling as if they were running directly on a processor.

为了实现完整的虚拟化所需的域间隔离，Dom0和DomU内核中的内存处理并不能不受限制地访问物理内存。VMM不是通过分发单个物理页、让客户操作系统处理寻址来分发内存的；那样无法针对有缺陷的或恶意的客户域提供任何保护。相反，VMM为每个客户域创建自己的页表树，并使用这些数据结构来分发内存。好处是可以控制对页表树管理信息的访问。如果代码没有相应的权限，它就什么也做不了。

To implement the separation of the domains which is required for the virtualization to be complete, the memory handling in the Dom0 and DomU kernels does not have unrestricted access to physical memory. The VMM does not hand out memory by giving out individual physical pages and letting the guest OSes handle the addressing; this would not provide any protection against faulty or rogue guest domains. Instead, the VMM creates its own page table tree for each guest domain and hands out memory using these data structures. The good thing is that access to the administrative information of the page table tree can be controlled. If the code does not have appropriate privileges it cannot do anything.

Xen提供的虚拟化利用了这种访问控制，无论使用的是半虚拟化还是硬件（又称完全）虚拟化。客户域为每个进程构建页表树的方式，对于半虚拟化和硬件虚拟化而言是有意设计得相当相似的。每当客户操作系统修改其页表时，就会调用VMM。然后VMM利用客户域中更新后的信息来更新它自己的影子页表。这些才是硬件实际使用的页表。显然，这个过程代价相当高：页表树的每次修改都需要调用一次VMM。虽然在没有虚拟化的情况下内存映射的改变也不便宜，但现在它们变得更加昂贵了。

This access control is exploited in the virtualization Xen provides, regardless of whether para- or hardware (aka full) virtualization is used. The guest domains construct their page table trees for each process in a way which is intentionally quite similar for para- and hardware virtualization. Whenever the guest OS modifies its page tables the VMM is invoked. The VMM then uses the updated information in the guest domain to update its own shadow page tables. These are the page tables which are actually used by the hardware. Obviously, this process is quite expensive: each modification of the page table tree requires an invocation of the VMM. While changes to the memory mapping are not cheap without virtualization they become even more expensive now.

考虑到从客户操作系统切换到VMM再切换回来本身就已经代价很高，额外的代价可能真的很大。这就是为什么处理器开始具备额外的功能来避免创建影子页表。这不仅出于速度方面的考虑，还因为它减少了VMM的内存消耗。Intel有扩展页表（EPT），AMD称之为嵌套页表（NPT）。基本上，这两种技术都让客户操作系统的页表从“客户虚拟地址”产生“主机虚拟地址”。然后，主机虚拟地址必须使用每个域的EPT/NPT树进一步转换为实际的物理地址。这将使内存处理的速度几乎达到无虚拟化时的水平，因为大多数为处理内存而进入VMM的情形都被消除了。它还减少了VMM的内存使用，因为现在每个域（而不是每个进程）只需维护一棵页表树。

The additional costs can be really large, considering that the changes from the guest OS to the VMM and back themselves are already quite expensive. This is why the processors are starting to have additional functionality to avoid the creation of shadow page tables. This is good not only because of speed concerns but it also reduces memory consumption by the VMM. Intel has Extended Page Tables (EPTs) and AMD calls it Nested Page Tables (NPTs). Basically both technologies have the page tables of the guest OSes produce “host virtual addresses” from the “guest virtual address”. The host virtual addresses must then be further translated, using the per-domain EPT/NPT trees, into actual physical addresses. This will allow memory handling at almost the speed of the no-virtualization case since most VMM entries for memory handling are removed. It also reduces the memory use of the VMM since now only one page table tree for each domain (as opposed to process) has to be maintained.

额外地址转换步骤的结果也存储在TLB中。这意味着TLB存储的不是虚拟物理地址，而是查找的完整结果。前面已经解释过，AMD的Pacifica扩展引入了ASID，以避免每次进入时都刷新TLB。在该处理器扩展的初始版本中，ASID的位数为一位；这刚好足以区分VMM和客户操作系统。Intel有虚拟处理器ID（VPID），用途相同，只是数量更多。但VPID对每个客户域是固定的，因此它也不能用来标记不同的进程、在那个层面上避免TLB刷新。

The results of the additional address translation steps are also stored in the TLB. That means the TLB does not store the virtual physical address but, instead, the complete result of the lookup. It was already explained that AMD’s Pacifica extension introduced the ASID to avoid TLB flushes on each entry. The number of bits for the ASID is one in the initial release of the processor extensions; this is just enough to differentiate VMM and guest OS. Intel has virtual processor IDs (VPIDs) which serve the same purpose, only there are more of them. But the VPID is fixed for each guest domain and therefore it cannot be used to mark separate processes and avoid TLB flushes at that level, too.

每次修改地址空间所需的工作量是虚拟化操作系统的一个问题。不过，基于VMM的虚拟化还有另一个固有的问题：两层内存处理是无法避免的。但内存处理很难（尤其是考虑到NUMA之类的复杂情况时，见第5节）。Xen使用独立VMM的方法使得最优（甚至良好）的处理变得困难，因为内存管理实现的所有复杂之处，包括像发现内存区域这样的“琐碎”事情，都必须在VMM中重复一遍。操作系统已经拥有成熟且经过优化的实现；人们确实希望避免重复它们。

The amount of work needed for each address space modification is one problem with virtualized OSes. There is another problem inherent in VMM-based virtualization, though: there is no way around having two layers of memory handling. But memory handling is hard (especially when taking complications like NUMA into account, see section 5). The Xen approach of using a separate VMM makes optimal (or even good) handling hard since all the complications of a memory management implementation, including “trivial” things like discovery of memory regions, must be duplicated in the VMM. The OSes have fully-fledged and optimized implementations; one really wants to avoid duplicating them.

这就是为什么把VMM/Dom0模型贯彻到底是一种如此有吸引力的替代方案。图4.5展示了KVM Linux内核扩展是如何尝试解决这个问题的。没有直接运行在硬件上、控制所有客户的独立VMM；取而代之的是，一个普通的Linux内核接管了这一功能。这意味着Linux内核中完整而成熟的内存处理功能被用来管理系统的内存。客户域与普通的用户级进程一起运行在其创建者所称的“客户模式”中。虚拟化功能——半虚拟化或完全虚拟化——由KVM VMM控制。它只是另一个用户级进程，碰巧使用内核实现的特殊KVM设备来控制一个客户域。

This is why carrying the VMM/Dom0 model to its conclusion is such an attractive alternative. Figure 4.5 shows how the KVM Linux kernel extensions try to solve the problem. There is no separate VMM running directly on the hardware and controlling all the guests; instead, a normal Linux kernel takes over this functionality. This means the complete and sophisticated memory handling functionality in the Linux kernel is used to manage the memory of the system. Guest domains run alongside the normal user-level processes in what the creators call “guest mode”. The virtualization functionality, para- or full virtualization, is controlled by the KVM VMM. This is just another userlevel process which happens to control a guest domain using the special KVM device the kernel implements.

与Xen模型的独立VMM相比，这种模型的好处是，即使使用客户操作系统时仍有两个内存处理程序在工作，也只需要一个实现，即Linux内核中的那个。没有必要在像Xen VMM这样的另一段代码中重复相同的功能。这意味着更少的工作、更少的缺陷，而且也许在两个内存处理程序相接触的地方摩擦也更少，因为Linux客户中的内存处理程序与运行在裸硬件上的外层Linux内核中的内存处理程序作出相同的假设。

The benefit of this model over the separate VMM of the Xen model is that, even though there are still two memory handlers at work when guest OSes are used, there only needs to be one implementation, that in the Linux kernel. It is not necessary to duplicate the same functionality in another piece of code like the Xen VMM.
