This leads to less work, fewer bugs, and, perhaps, less friction where the two memory handlers touch since the memory handler in a Linux guest makes the same assumptions as the memory handler in the outer Linux kernel which runs on the bare hardware.

总的来说，程序员必须意识到，在使用虚拟化的情况下，缓存未命中（指令、数据或TLB）的代价甚至比没有虚拟化时更高。任何减少这项工作的优化在虚拟化环境中都会带来更大的回报。随着时间的推移，处理器设计者将通过EPT和NPT等技术越来越多地缩小这一差距，但它永远不会完全消失。

Overall, programmers must be aware that, with virtualization used, the cost of cache misses (instruction, data, or TLB) is even higher than without virtualization. Any optimization which reduces this work will pay off even more in virtualized environments. Processor designers will, over time, reduce the difference more and more through technologies like EPT and NPT but it will never completely go away.

  1. ↑ x86上的段界限与性能相关，但那是另一回事了。

    ↑ Segment limits on x86 are performance-relevant but that is another story.

5 NUMA支持

5 NUMA Support

在第2节中我们看到，在某些机器上，访问物理内存特定区域的代价因访问的发起位置而异。这类硬件需要操作系统和应用程序的特别关照。我们将从NUMA硬件的一些细节开始，然后介绍Linux内核为NUMA提供的一些支持。

In section 2 we saw that, on some machines, the cost of access to specific regions of physical memory differs depending on where the access originated. This type of hardware requires special care from the OS and the applications. We will start with a few details of NUMA hardware, then we will cover some of the support the Linux kernel provides for NUMA.

5.1 NUMA硬件

5.1 NUMA Hardware

非一致内存架构正变得越来越普遍。在最简单的NUMA形式中，处理器可以拥有本地内存（见图2.3），访问它比访问其他处理器的本地内存代价更低。这类NUMA系统的代价差异不大，即NUMA因子较低。

Non-uniform memory architectures are becoming more and more common. In the simplest form of NUMA, a processor can have local memory (see Figure 2.3) which is cheaper to access than memory local to other processors. The difference in cost for this type of NUMA system is not high, i.e., the NUMA factor is low.

NUMA也——而且尤其——用于大型机器。我们已经描述过许多处理器访问同一内存所带来的问题。对于通用硬件，所有处理器都会共享同一个北桥（暂且忽略AMD Opteron的NUMA节点，它们有自己的问题）。这使北桥成为一个严重的瓶颈，因为所有的内存流量都要经过它。大型机器当然可以用定制硬件代替北桥，但除非所用的内存芯片具有多个端口——即它们可以从多条总线上使用——否则仍然存在瓶颈。多端口RAM的制造和支持复杂而昂贵，因此几乎从不使用。

NUMA is also–and especially–used in big machines. We have described the problems of having many processors access the same memory. For commodity hardware all processors would share the same Northbridge (ignoring the AMD Opteron NUMA nodes for now, they have their own problems). This makes the Northbridge a severe bottleneck since all memory traffic is routed through it. Big machines can, of course, use custom hardware in place of the Northbridge but, unless the memory chips used have multiple ports–i.e. they can be used from multiple busses–there still is a bottleneck. Multiport RAM is complicated and expensive to build and support and, therefore, it is hardly ever used.

复杂度更上一层的是AMD所使用的模型，其中一种互连机制（在AMD的情况下是HyperTransport，这是他们从Digital获得许可的技术）为没有直接连接到RAM的处理器提供访问。以这种方式所能构成的结构规模是有限的，除非人们愿意任意增大直径（即任意两个节点之间的最大距离）。

The next step up in complexity is the model AMD uses where an interconnect mechanism (Hyper Transport in AMD’s case, technology they licensed from Digital) provides access for processors which are not directly connected to the RAM. The size of the structures which can be formed this way is limited unless one wants to increase the diameter (i.e., the maximum distance between any two nodes) arbitrarily.

连接节点的一种高效拓扑是超立方体，它把节点数限制为2C，其中C是每个节点拥有的互连接口数。对于所有拥有2n个CPU和n个互连的系统，超立方体的直径最小。图5.1展示了前三个超立方体。每个超立方体的直径为C，这是绝对的最小值。AMD的第一代Opteron处理器每个处理器有三条HyperTransport链路。至少有一个处理器必须在一条链路上连接南桥，这意味着目前可以直接而高效地实现C = 2的超立方体。下一代在某个时候将有四条链路，届时C = 3的超立方体将成为可能。

An efficient topology for connecting the nodes is the hypercube, which limits the number of nodes to 2C where C is the number of interconnect interfaces each node has. Hypercubes have the smallest diameter for all systems with 2n CPUs and n interconnects. Figure 5.1 shows the first three hypercubes. Each hypercube has a diameter of C which is the absolute minimum. AMD’s first-generation Opteron processors have three hypertransport links per processor. At least one of the processors has to have a Southbridge attached to one link, meaning, currently, that a hypercube with C = 2 can be implemented directly and efficiently. The next generation will at some point have four links, at which point C = 3 hypercubes will be possible.

不过，这并不意味着不能支持更大规模的处理器集合。有些公司已经开发出交叉开关，允许使用更大的处理器集合（例如Newisys的Horus）。但这些交叉开关会增大NUMA因子，并且在处理器数量达到一定程度时就不再有效。

This does not mean, though, that larger accumulations of processors cannot be supported. There are companies which have developed crossbars allowing larger sets of processors to be used (e.g., Newisys’s Horus). But these crossbars increase the NUMA factor and they stop being effective at a certain number of processors.

再上一层意味着把多组CPU连接起来，并为它们全体实现共享内存。所有这类系统都需要专门的硬件，绝不是通用系统。这样的设计存在于若干复杂程度不同的层次上。一个仍然相当接近通用机器的系统是IBM x445及类似机器。它们可以作为普通的4U、8路、使用x86和x86-64处理器的机器购买。然后可以把两台（在某个时候多达四台）这样的机器连接起来，作为一台共享内存的机器工作。所使用的互连引入了显著的NUMA因子，操作系统和应用程序都必须将其考虑在内。

The next step up means connecting groups of CPUs and implementing a shared memory for all of them. All such systems need specialized hardware and are by no means commodity systems. Such designs exist at several levels of complexity. A system which is still quite close to a commodity machine is IBM x445 and similar machines. They can be bought as ordinary 4U, 8-way machines with x86 and x86-64 processors. Two (at some point up to four) of these machines can then be connected to work as a single machine with shared memory. The interconnect used introduces a significant NUMA factor which the OS, as well as applications, must take into account.

在光谱的另一端，像SGI的Altix这样的机器是专门为互连而设计的。SGI的NUMAlink互连结构非常快，同时延迟很低；这两个特性都是高性能计算（HPC）的要求，特别是在使用消息传递接口（MPI）时。缺点当然是，如此精密和专门化的设计非常昂贵。它们使相当低的NUMA因子成为可能，但考虑到这些机器可以拥有的CPU数量（几千个）以及互连的有限容量，NUMA因子实际上是动态的，并且根据工作负载可能达到不可接受的水平。

At the other end of the spectrum, machines like SGI’s Altix are designed specifically to be interconnected. SGI’s NUMAlink interconnect fabric is very fast and has low latency at the same time; both properties are requirements for high-performance computing (HPC), specifically when Message Passing Interfaces (MPI) are used. The drawback is, of course, that such sophistication and specialization is very expensive. They make a reasonably low NUMA factor possible but with the number of CPUs these machines can have (several thousands) and the limited capacity of the interconnects, the NUMA factor is actually dynamic and can reach unacceptable levels depending on the workload.

更常用的是这样的解决方案：用高速网络把许多通用机器连接起来组成集群。不过，它们不是NUMA机器；它们不实现共享地址空间，因此不属于这里讨论的任何类别。

More commonly used are solutions where many commodity machines are connected using high-speed networking to form a cluster. These are no NUMA machines, though; they do not implement a shared address space and therefore do not fall into any category which is discussed here.

5.2 操作系统对NUMA的支持

5.2 OS Support for NUMA

为了支持NUMA机器，操作系统必须考虑内存的分布式特性。例如，如果一个进程在某个处理器上运行，那么分配给该进程地址空间的物理RAM理想情况下应来自本地内存。否则每条指令都必须为代码和数据访问远程内存。

To support NUMA machines, the OS has to take the distributed nature of the memory into account. For instance, if a process is run on a given processor, the physical RAM assigned to the process’s address space should ideally come from local memory. Otherwise each instruction has to access remote memory for code and data.

有一些只在NUMA机器中才存在的特殊情况需要考虑。DSO的代码段通常在一台机器的物理RAM中只存在一份。但如果该DSO被所有CPU上的进程和线程使用（例如libc这样的基础运行时库），这意味着除少数处理器之外，所有处理器都必须进行远程访问。理想情况下，操作系统会把这样的DSO“镜像”到每个处理器的物理RAM中，并使用本地副本。这是一种优化，而不是必需的，并且一般很难实现。它可能不被支持，或者只以有限的方式支持。

There are special cases to be taken into account which are only present in NUMA machines. The text segment of DSOs is normally present exactly once in a machine’s physical RAM. But if the DSO is used by processes and threads on all CPUs (for instance, the basic runtime libraries like libc) this means that all but a few processors have to have remote accesses. The OS ideally would “mirror” such DSOs into each processor’s physical RAM and use local copies. This is an optimization, not a requirement, and generally hard to implement. It might not be supported or only in a limited fashion.

为了避免情况变得更糟，操作系统不应把进程或线程从一个节点迁移到另一个节点。在普通的多处理器机器上，操作系统就已经应当尽量避免迁移进程，因为从一个处理器迁移到另一个处理器意味着缓存内容丢失。如果负载分配要求把一个进程或线程从某个处理器上迁走，操作系统通常可以任意挑选一个还有足够余力的新处理器。在NUMA环境中，新处理器的选择就受到更多限制。新选择的处理器访问该进程所用内存的代价不应高于旧处理器；这就限制了目标列表。如果没有符合该标准的空闲处理器可用，操作系统别无选择，只能迁移到内存访问代价更高的处理器上。

To avoid making the situation worse, the OS should not migrate a process or thread from one node to another. The OS should already try to avoid migrating processes on normal multi-processor machines because migrating from one processor to another means the cache content is lost. If load distribution requires migrating a process or thread off of a processor, the OS can usually pick an arbitrary new processor which has sufficient capacity left. In NUMA environments the selection of the new processor is a bit more limited. The newly selected processor should not have higher access costs to the memory the process is using than the old processor; this restricts the list of targets. If there is no free processor matching that criteria available, the OS has no choice but to migrate to a processor where memory access is more expensive.

在这种情况下有两条可能的出路。第一，可以寄希望于这种情况是暂时的，进程可以被迁回一个更合适的处理器。或者，操作系统也可以把进程的内存迁移到离新使用的处理器更近的物理页上。这是一个代价相当高的操作。可能有大量内存需要复制，尽管不一定是一步完成。在此期间，进程至少必须短暂停止，以便对旧页的修改能被正确迁移。要使页迁移高效而快速，还有一长串其他要求。简而言之，除非确实必要，操作系统应当避免这样做。

In this situation there are two possible ways forward. First, one can hope the situation is temporary and the process can be migrated back to a better-suited processor. Alternatively, the OS can also migrate the process’s memory to physical pages which are closer to the newly-used processor. This is quite an expensive operation. Possibly huge amounts of memory have to be copied, albeit not necessarily in one step. While this is happening the process, at least briefly, has to be stopped so that modifications to the old pages are correctly migrated. There are a whole list of other requirements for page migration to be efficient and fast. In short, the OS should avoid it unless it is really necessary.

一般来说，不能假设NUMA机器上的所有进程都使用相同数量的内存，从而随着进程在处理器间的分布，内存使用也均匀分布。事实上，除非机器上运行的应用程序非常特定（这在HPC领域很常见，但在其外并非如此），内存使用将非常不均衡。有些应用程序会使用海量内存，另一些则几乎不用。如果内存总是在发起请求的处理器本地分配，这迟早会导致问题。系统最终会耗尽运行大型进程的节点的本地内存。

Generally, it cannot be assumed that all processes on a NUMA machine use the same amount of memory such that, with the distribution of processes across the processors, memory usage is also equally distributed. In fact, unless the applications running on the machines are very specific (common in the HPC world, but not outside) the memory use will be very unequal. Some applications will use vast amounts of memory, others hardly any. This will, sooner or later, lead to problems if memory is always allocated local to the processor where the request is originated. The system will eventually run out of memory local to nodes running large processes.

为了应对这些严重的问题，内存默认不是只在本地节点上分配。为了利用系统的全部内存，默认策略是对内存进行条带化。这保证了系统所有内存的均衡使用。作为一个副作用，在处理器之间自由迁移进程成为可能，因为平均而言，访问所用全部内存的代价不会改变。对于较小的NUMA因子，条带化是可以接受的，但仍不是最优的（见5.4节中的数据）。

In response to these severe problems, memory is, by default, not allocated exclusively on the local node. To utilize all the system’s memory the default strategy is to stripe the memory. This guarantees equal use of all the memory of the system. As a side effect, it becomes possible to freely migrate processes between processors since, on average, the access cost to all the memory used does not change. For small NUMA factors, striping is acceptable but still not optimal (see data in section 5.4).

这是一种悲观化处理，它帮助系统避免严重问题，并使其在正常运行时更可预测。但它确实降低了整体系统性能，在某些情况下降低得很显著。这就是为什么Linux允许每个进程选择内存分配规则。一个进程可以为自己及其子进程选择不同的策略。我们将在第6节介绍可用于此目的的接口。

This is a pessimization which helps the system avoid severe problems and makes it more predictable under normal operation. But it does decrease overall system performance, in some situations significantly. This is why Linux allows the memory allocation rules to be selected by each process. A process can select a different strategy for itself and its children. We will introduce the interfaces which can be used for this in section 6.

5.3 公开的信息

5.3 Published Information

内核通过sys伪文件系统（sysfs）在以下位置公开有关处理器缓存的信息：

The kernel publishes, through the sys pseudo file system (sysfs), information about the processor caches below

/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cache

在6.2.1节中我们将看到可用于查询各级缓存大小的接口。这里重要的是缓存的拓扑。上述目录包含若干子目录（名为index*），列出了CPU所拥有的各个缓存的信息。就拓扑而言，这些目录中重要的文件是type、level和shared_cpu_map。对于Intel Core 2 QX6700，信息如表5.1所示。

In section 6.2.1 we will see interfaces which can be used to query the size of the various caches. What is important here is the topology of the caches. The directories above contain subdirectories (named index*) which list information about the various caches the CPU possesses. The files type, level, and shared_cpu_map are the important files in these directories as far as the topology is concerned. For an Intel Core 2 QX6700 the information looks as in Table 5.1.

这些数据的含义如下：

What this data means is as follows:

  • 每个内核25有三个缓存：L1i、L1d、L2。

    Each core25 has three caches: L1i, L1d, L2.

  • L1d和L1i缓存不与任何其他内核共享——每个内核都有自己的一组缓存。这由shared_cpu_map中只有一位被置位的位图表示。

    The L1d and L1i caches are not shared with any other core–each core has its own set of caches. This is indicated by the bitmap in shared_cpu_map having only one set bit.

  • cpu0和cpu1上的L2缓存是共享的，cpu2和cpu3上的L2也是如此。

    The L2 cache on cpu0 and cpu1 is shared, as is the L2 on cpu2 and cpu3.

如果CPU有更多的缓存级别，就会有更多的index*目录。

If the CPU had more cache levels, there would be more index* directories.

对于一台四插槽、双核的Opteron机器，缓存信息如表5.2所示。可以看出，这些处理器也有三个缓存：L1i、L1d、L2。没有任何内核共享任何级别的缓存。这个系统有趣的部分是处理器拓扑。没有这些额外的信息，就无法理解缓存数据。sys文件系统在以下位置的文件中公开这些信息：

For a four-socket, dual-core Opteron machine the cache information looks like Table 5.2. As can be seen these processors also have three caches: L1i, L1d, L2. None of the cores shares any level of cache. The interesting part for this system is the processor topology. Without this additional information one cannot make sense of the cache data. The sys file system exposes this information in the files below

/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/topology

表5.3展示了这台SMP Opteron机器在此层次结构中值得关注的文件。

Table 5.3 shows the interesting files in this hierarchy for the SMP Opteron machine.

把表5.2和表5.3放在一起，我们可以看出

Taking Table 5.2 and Table 5.3 together we can see that

  1. 没有任何CPU有超线程（thread_siblings位图只有一位被置位），

    none of the CPU has hyper-threads (the thread_siblings bitmaps have one bit set),

  2. 该系统实际上共有四个处理器（physical_package_id为0到3），

    the system in fact has a total of four processors (physical_package_id 0 to 3),

  3. 每个处理器有两个内核，以及

    each processor has two cores, and

  4. 没有任何内核共享任何缓存。

    none of the cores share any cache.

这正好对应于较早的Opteron。

This is exactly what corresponds to earlier Opterons.

到目前为止所提供的数据中完全缺失的，是有关这台机器NUMA性质的信息。任何SMP Opteron机器都是NUMA机器。对于这些数据，我们必须查看sys文件系统中存在于NUMA机器上的另一部分，即以下位置的层次结构：

What is completely missing in the data provided so far is information about the nature of NUMA on this machine. Any SMP Opteron machine is a NUMA machine. For this data we have to look at yet another part of the sys file system which exists on NUMA machines, namely in the hierarchy below

/sys/devices/system/node

这个目录为系统上的每个NUMA节点包含一个子目录。在各节点专属的目录中有若干文件。对于前两个表所描述的Opteron机器，重要的文件及其内容如表5.4所示。

This directory contains a subdirectory for every NUMA node on the system. In the node-specific directories there are a number of files. The important files and their content for the Opteron machine described in the previous two tables are shown in Table 5.4.

这些信息把其余的一切联系在了一起；现在我们对这台机器的架构有了完整的了解。我们已经知道这台机器有四个处理器。从node*目录中cpumap文件的值中被置位的位可以看出，每个处理器构成自己的节点。这些目录中的distance文件包含一组值，每个节点一个，表示在相应节点上进行内存访问的代价。在这个例子中，所有本地内存访问的代价为10，所有对任何其他节点的远程访问代价为20。26这意味着，即使处理器被组织成一个二维超立方体（见图5.1），没有直接连接的处理器之间的访问也并不更贵。代价的相对值应该可以用作对访问时间实际差异的估计。所有这些信息的准确性是另一个问题。

This information ties all the rest together; now we have a complete picture of the architecture of the machine. We already know that the machine has four processors. Each processor constitutes its own node as can be seen by the bits set in the value in cpumap file in the node* directories. The distance files in those directories contains a set of values, one for each node, which represent a cost of memory accesses at the respective nodes. In this example all local memory accesses have the cost 10, all remote access to any other node has the cost 20.26 This means that, even though the processors are organized as a two-dimensional hypercube (see Figure 5.1), accesses between processors which are not directly connected is not more expensive. The relative values of the costs should be usable as an estimate of the actual difference of the access times. The accuracy of all this information is another question.

5.4 远程访问的代价

5.4 Remote Access Costs

不过，距离是有意义的。在[1]中，AMD记录了一台四插槽机器的NUMA代价。写操作的数字如图5.3所示。写比读慢，这并不奇怪。有趣的部分是1跳和2跳情况的代价。两种1跳情况的代价实际上略有不同。详见[1]。我们需要从这张图中记住的事实是：2跳的读和写分别比0跳读慢30%和49%。2跳写比0跳写慢32%，比1跳写慢17%。处理器与内存节点的相对位置可能造成很大的差异。AMD的下一代处理器将为每个处理器配备四条一致性HyperTransport链路。在那种情况下，四插槽机器的直径将为一。如果有八个插槽，同样的问题将变本加厉地卷土重来，因为八节点超立方体的直径为三。

The distance is relevant, though. In [1] AMD documents the NUMA cost of a four socket machine. For write operations the numbers are shown in Figure 5.3. Writes are slower than reads, this is no surprise. The interesting parts are the costs of the 1- and 2-hop cases. The two 1-hop cases actually have slightly different costs. See [1] for the details. The fact we need to remember from this chart is that 2-hop reads and writes are 30% and 49% (respectively) slower than 0-hop reads. 2-hop writes are 32% slower than 0-hop writes, and 17% slower than 1-hop writes. The relative position of processor and memory nodes can make a big difference. The next generation of processors from AMD will feature four coherent HyperTransport links per processor. In that case a four socket machine would have diameter of one. With eight sockets the same problem returns, with a vengeance, since the diameter of a hypercube with eight nodes is three.

所有这些信息都是可以获得的，但使用起来很麻烦。在6.5节中我们将看到一个有助于更容易地访问和使用这些信息的接口。

All this information is available but it is cumbersome to use. In section 6.5 we will see an interface which helps accessing and using this information easier.

系统提供的最后一项信息在于进程本身的状态。可以确定内存映射文件、写时复制（COW）27页以及匿名内存是如何分布在系统中各节点上的。对于每个进程，内核提供一个伪文件/proc/PID/numa_maps，其中PID是进程的ID，如图5.2所示。文件中重要的信息是N0到N3的值，它们表示该内存区域在节点0到3上分配的页数。可以很有把握地猜测，该程序是在节点3上的一个内核上执行的。程序本身和被弄脏的页都分配在该节点上。只读映射，例如ld-2.4.so和libc-2.4.so的第一个映射，以及共享文件locale-archive，则分配在其他节点上。

The last piece of information the system provides is in the status of a process itself. It is possible to determine how the memory-mapped files, the Copy-On-Write (COW)27 pages and anonymous memory are distributed over the nodes in the system. For each process the kernel provides a pseudo-file /proc/PID/numa_maps, where PID is the ID of the process, as shown in Figure 5.2. The important information in the file is the values for N0 to N3, which indicate the number of pages allocated for the memory area on nodes 0 to 3. It is a good guess that the program was executed on a core on node 3. The program itself and the dirtied pages are allocated on that node. Read-only mappings, such as the first mapping for ld-2.4.so and libc-2.4.so as well as the shared file locale-archive are allocated on other nodes.

正如我们在图5.3中看到的，跨节点进行时，1跳和2跳读的读性能分别下降9%和30%。对于执行而言，这样的读是必需的，如果L2缓存未命中，每个缓存行都会产生这些额外的代价。如果内存对处理器而言是远程的，那么对于超出缓存大小的大型工作负载所测得的所有代价都必须增加9%/30%。

As we have seen in Figure 5.3, when performed across nodes the read performance falls by 9% and 30% respectively for 1- and 2-hop reads. For execution, such reads are needed and, if the L2 cache is missed, each cache line incurs these additional costs. All the costs measured for large workloads beyond the size of the cache would have to be increased by 9%/30% if the memory is remote to the processor.

为了观察现实世界中的效果，我们可以像3.5.1节那样测量带宽，但这一次内存位于一跳之外的远程节点上。与使用本地内存的数据相比，这项测试的结果可以在图5.4中看到。这些数字在两个方向上都有几个大的尖峰，这是测量多线程代码的问题造成的，可以忽略。这张图中的重要信息是，读操作总是慢20%。这比图5.3中的9%要慢得多，后者很可能不是针对不间断读/写操作的数字，并且可能适用于较旧的处理器版本。只有AMD知道。

To see the effects in the real world we can measure the bandwidth as in section 3.5.1 but this time with the memory being on a remote node, one hop away. The result of this test when compared with the data for using local memory can be seen in Figure 5.4. The numbers have a few big spikes in both directions which are the result of a problem of measuring multi-threaded code and can be ignored. The important information in this graph is that read operations are always 20% slower. This is significantly slower than the 9% in Figure 5.3, which is, most likely, not a number for uninterrupted read/write operations and might refer to older processor revisions. Only AMD knows.

对于能放进缓存的工作集大小，写和复制操作的性能也慢20%。对于超出缓存大小的工作集，写性能与在本地节点上的操作相比并没有可测量的变慢。互连的速度足以跟上内存。主导因素是等待主存所花费的时间。

For working set sizes which fit into the caches, the performance of write and copy operations is also 20% slower. For working sets exceeding the size of the caches, the write performance is not measurably slower than the operation on the local node. The speed of the interconnect is fast enough to keep up with the memory. The dominating factor is the time spent waiting on the main memory.

  1. ↑ cpu0到cpu3是内核这一认识来自另一个地方，稍后会加以解释。

    ↑ The knowledge that cpu0 to cpu3 are cores comes from another place that will be explained shortly.

  2. ↑ 顺便说一句，这是不正确的。ACPI信息显然是错误的，因为尽管所用的处理器有三条一致性HyperTransport链路，但至少有一个处理器必须连接到南桥。因此至少有一对节点的距离必然更大。

    ↑ This is, by the way, incorrect. The ACPI information is apparently wrong since, although the processors used have three coherent HyperTransport links, at least one processor must be connected to a Southbridge. At least one pair of nodes must therefore have a larger distance.

  3. ↑ 写时复制是操作系统实现中经常使用的一种方法：一个内存页起初只有一个使用者，之后为了允许独立的使用者而必须复制它。在许多情况下，复制是不必要的——完全不必要或起初不必要——这时只在任一使用者修改内存时才复制是合理的。操作系统拦截写操作，复制内存页，然后允许写指令继续执行。

    ↑ Copy-On-Write is a method often used in OS implementations when a memory page has one user at first and then has to be copied to allow independent users. In many situations the copying is unnecessary, at all or at first, in which case it makes sense to only copy when either user modifies the memory. The operating system intercepts the write operation, duplicates the memory page, and then allows the write instruction to proceed.

6 程序员能做些什么

6 What Programmers Can Do

经过前面各节的描述，很明显，程序员有许许多多的机会去影响程序的性能，无论是正面的还是负面的。而这还仅仅是与内存相关的操作。我们将从最底层开始逐一介绍这些机会，从物理RAM访问和L1缓存这些最低层次开始，一直到并包括影响内存处理的操作系统功能。

After the descriptions in the previous sections it is clear that there are many, many opportunities for programmers to influence a program’s performance, positively or negatively. And this is for memory-related operations only. We will proceed in covering the opportunities from the ground up, starting with the lowest levels of physical RAM access and L1 caches, up to and including OS functionality which influences memory handling.

6.1 绕过缓存

6.1 Bypassing the Cache

当数据被产生出来而不会（立即）再被消费时，内存存储操作先读取完整的缓存行再修改缓存数据这一事实对性能是有害的。这一操作会把可能还会再次需要的数据挤出缓存，换进不会很快被使用的数据。对于矩阵这样的大型数据结构尤其如此，它们先被填充，稍后才被使用。在矩阵的最后一个元素被填充之前，其庞大的规模就已经把最前面的元素逐出了，使得对写操作的缓存毫无效果。

When data is produced and not (immediately) consumed again, the fact that memory store operations read a full cache line first and then modify the cached data is detrimental to performance. This operation pushes data out of the caches which might be needed again in favor of data which will not be used soon. This is especially true for large data structures, like matrices, which are filled and then used later. Before the last element of the matrix is filled the sheer size evicts the first elements, making caching of the writes ineffective.

针对这种以及类似的情况，处理器提供了对非临时（non-temporal）写操作的支持。这里的“非临时”是指数据不会很快被重用，因此没有理由缓存它。这些非临时写操作不会先读取缓存行再修改它；相反，新内容被直接写入内存。

For this and similar situations, processors provide support for non-temporal write operations. Non-temporal in this context means the data will not be reused soon, so there is no reason to cache it. These non-temporal write operations do not read a cache line and then modify it; instead, the new content is directly written to memory.

这听起来可能代价很高，但其实不一定。处理器会尝试使用写合并（见3.3.3节）来填满整个缓存行。如果成功，就完全不需要内存读操作。对于x86和x86-64架构，gcc提供了若干内建函数（intrinsic）：

This might sound expensive but it does not have to be. The processor will try to use write-combining (see section 3.3.3) to fill entire cache lines. If this succeeds no memory read operation is needed at all. For the x86 and x86-64 architectures a number of intrinsics are provided by gcc:

#include <emmintrin.h>
void _mm_stream_si32(int *p, int a);
void _mm_stream_si128(int *p, __m128i a);
void _mm_stream_pd(double *p, __m128d a);

#include <xmmintrin.h>
void _mm_stream_pi(__m64 *p, __m64 a);
void _mm_stream_ps(float *p, __m128 a);

#include <ammintrin.h>
void _mm_stream_sd(double *p, __m128d a);
void _mm_stream_ss(float *p, __m128 a);

如果这些指令一次性处理大量数据，使用效率最高。数据从内存加载，经过一个或多个步骤的处理，然后写回内存。数据“流”过处理器，这些内建函数的名称由此而来。

These instructions are used most efficiently if they process large amounts of data in one go. Data is loaded from memory, processed in one or more steps, and then written back to memory. The data “streams” through the processor, hence the names of the intrinsics.

内存地址必须分别按8字节或16字节对齐。在使用多媒体扩展的代码中，可以用这些非临时版本替换普通的_mm_store_*内建函数。在A.1节的矩阵乘法代码中我们没有这样做，因为写入的值会在很短的时间内被重用。这是一个使用流式指令并无益处的例子。关于这段代码的更多内容见6.2.1节。

The memory address must be aligned to 8 or 16 bytes respectively. In code using the multimedia extensions it is possible to replace the normal _mm_store_* intrinsics with these non-temporal versions. In the matrix multiplication code in section A.1 we do not do this since the written values are reused in a short order of time. This is an example where using the stream instructions is not useful. More on this code in section 6.2.1.

处理器的写合并缓冲区只能在有限的时间内保存对缓存行部分写入的请求。通常有必要把修改同一缓存行的所有指令一条接一条地发出，以便写合并能够真正发生。下面是一个如何做到这一点的例子：

The processor’s write-combining buffer can hold requests for partial writing to a cache line for only so long. It is generally necessary to issue all the instructions which modify a single cache line one after another so that the write-combining can actually take place. An example for how to do this is as follows:

#include <emmintrin.h>
void setbytes(char *p, int c)
{
  __m128i i = _mm_set_epi8(c, c, c, c,
                           c, c, c, c,
                           c, c, c, c,
                           c, c, c, c);
  _mm_stream_si128((__m128i *)&p[0], i);
  _mm_stream_si128((__m128i *)&p[16], i);
  _mm_stream_si128((__m128i *)&p[32], i);
  _mm_stream_si128((__m128i *)&p[48], i);
}

假设指针p已正确对齐，调用这个函数将把所寻址缓存行的所有字节都设置为c。写合并逻辑会看到生成的四条movntdq指令，并且只在最后一条指令执行完之后才向内存发出写命令。总而言之，这段代码序列不仅避免了在写入之前读取缓存行，还避免了用可能不会很快需要的数据污染缓存。在某些情况下这能带来巨大的好处。使用这种技术的日常代码的一个例子是C运行时中的memset函数，对于大块内存它应当使用类似上面的代码序列。

Assuming the pointer p is appropriately aligned, a call to this function will set all bytes of the addressed cache line to c. The write-combining logic will see the four generated movntdq instructions and only issue the write command for the memory once the last instruction has been executed. To summarize, this code sequence not only avoids reading the cache line before it is written, it also avoids polluting the cache with data which might not be needed soon. This can have huge benefits in certain situations. An example of everyday code using this technique is the memset function in the C runtime, which should use a code sequence like the above for large blocks.

有些架构提供了专门的解决方案。PowerPC架构定义了dcbz指令，可以用来清零整个缓存行。该指令并没有真正绕过缓存，因为会为结果分配一个缓存行，但不会从内存读取任何数据。它比非临时存储指令更受限制，因为缓存行只能被全部置零，并且它会污染缓存（在数据是非临时的情况下），但实现这一结果不需要任何写合并逻辑。

Some architectures provide specialized solutions. The PowerPC architecture defines the dcbz instruction which can be used to clear an entire cache line. The instruction does not really bypass the cache since a cache line is allocated for the result, but no data is read from memory. It is more limited than the non-temporal store instructions since a cache line can only be set to all-zeros and it pollutes the cache (in case the data is non-temporal), but no write-combining logic is needed to achieve the results.

为了观察非临时指令的实际效果，我们来看一个新的测试，用于测量对按二维数组组织的矩阵的写入。编译器在内存中这样排列矩阵：最左边的（第一个）索引寻址行，行内所有元素在内存中顺序排列。右边的（第二个）索引寻址行内的元素。测试程序以两种方式遍历矩阵：第一种是在内层循环中递增列号，第二种是在内层循环中递增行索引。这意味着我们得到图6.1所示的行为。

To see the non-temporal instructions in action we will look at a new test which is used to measure writing to a matrix, organized as a two-dimensional array. The compiler lays out the matrix in memory so that the leftmost (first) index addresses the row which has all elements laid out sequentially in memory. The right (second) index addresses the elements in a row. The test program iterates over the matrix in two ways: first by increasing the column number in the inner loop and then by increasing the row index in the inner loop. This means we get the behavior shown in Figure 6.1.

我们测量初始化一个3000 × 3000矩阵所需的时间。为了观察内存的行为，我们使用不经过缓存的存储指令。在IA-32处理器上，为此使用“非临时提示”。作为对比，我们也测量普通的存储操作。结果见表6.1。

We measure the time it takes to initialize a 3000 × 3000 matrix. To see how memory behaves, we use store instructions which do not use the cache. On IA-32 processors the “non-temporal hint” is used for this. For comparison we also measure ordinary store operations. The results can be seen in Table 6.1.

对于使用缓存的普通写入，我们看到了预期的结果：如果顺序地使用内存，我们会得到好得多的结果，整个操作耗时0.048s，相当于约750MB/s；相比之下，或多或少随机的访问耗时0.127s（约280MB/s）。矩阵足够大，以至于缓存基本上失效了。

For the normal writes which do use the cache we see the expected result: if memory is used sequentially we get a much better result, 0.048s for the whole operation translating to about 750MB/s, compared to the more-or-less random access which takes 0.127s (about 280MB/s). The matrix is large enough that the caches are essentially ineffective.

我们这里主要感兴趣的是绕过缓存的写入。可能令人惊讶的是，这里的顺序访问与使用缓存的情况一样快。得到这一结果的原因是处理器如上所述执行了写合并。此外，非临时写入的内存排序规则是放宽的：程序需要显式地插入内存屏障（对于x86和x86-64处理器是sfence指令）。这意味着处理器在写回数据时有更大的自由，从而可以尽可能充分地利用可用带宽。

The part we are mainly interested in here are the writes bypassing the cache. It might be surprising that the sequential access is just as fast here as in the case where the cache is used. The reason for this result is that the processor is performing write-combining as explained above. In addition, the memory ordering rules for non-temporal writes are relaxed: the program needs to explicitly insert memory barriers (sfence instructions for the x86 and x86-64 processors). This means the processor has more freedom to write back the data and thereby using the available bandwidth as well as possible.

在内层循环中按列访问的情况就不同了。不经缓存的访问结果明显慢于经缓存访问的情况（0.16s，约225MB/s）。这里我们可以看到，写合并是不可能的，每个存储单元都必须单独寻址。这需要不断地在RAM芯片中选择新的行，并伴随所有相关的延迟。结果比经缓存的运行差25%。

In the case of column-wise access in the inner loop the situation is different. The results for uncached accesses are significantly slower than in the case of cached accesses (0.16s, about 225MB/s). Here we can see that no write combining is possible and each memory cell must be addressed individually. This requires constantly selecting new rows in the RAM chips with all the associated delays. The result is a 25% worse result than the cached run.

在读的一侧，直到最近，处理器除了使用非临时访问（NTA）预取指令给出的弱提示之外，一直缺乏支持。对于读，没有与写合并等价的机制，这对于内存映射I/O之类的不可缓存内存尤其糟糕。Intel在SSE4.1扩展中引入了NTA加载。它们是用少量的流式加载缓冲区实现的；每个缓冲区容纳一个缓存行。针对给定缓存行的第一条movntdqa指令会把一个缓存行加载到缓冲区中，可能替换掉另一个缓存行。随后对同一缓存行的16字节对齐访问将以很小的代价由加载缓冲区提供服务。除非有其他理由，该缓存行不会被加载到缓存中，从而可以加载大量内存而不污染缓存。编译器为这条指令提供了一个内建函数：

On the read side, processors, until recently, lacked support aside from weak hints using non-temporal access (NTA) prefetch instructions. There is no equivalent to write-combining for reads, which is especially bad for uncacheable memory such as memory-mapped I/O. Intel, with the SSE4.1 extensions, introduced NTA loads. They are implemented using a small number of streaming load buffers; each buffer contains a cache line. The first movntdqa instruction for a given cache line will load a cache line into a buffer, possibly replacing another cache line. Subsequent 16-byte aligned accesses to the same cache line will be serviced from the load buffer at little cost. Unless there are other reasons to do so, the cache line will not be loaded into a cache, thus enabling the loading of large amounts of memory without polluting the caches. The compiler provides an intrinsic for this instruction:

#include <smmintrin.h>
__m128i _mm_stream_load_si128 (__m128i *p);

这个内建函数应当被多次使用，以16字节块的地址作为参数传入，直到读完每个缓存行。只有在那之后才应开始下一个缓存行。由于有几个流式读缓冲区，可能可以同时从两个内存位置读取。

This intrinsic should be used multiple times, with addresses of 16-byte blocks passed as the parameter, until each cache line is read. Only then should the next cache line be started. Since there are a few streaming read buffers it might be possible to read from two memory locations at once.

我们应当从这个实验中得出的是：现代CPU能够非常好地优化不经缓存的写访问，以及最近甚至读访问，只要它们是顺序的。在处理只使用一次的大型数据结构时，这一认识会非常有用。其次，缓存可以帮助掩盖随机内存访问的部分——但不是全部——代价。在这个例子中，由于RAM访问的实现方式，随机访问要慢70%。在实现改变之前，应当尽可能避免随机访问。

What we should take away from this experiment is that modern CPUs very nicely optimize uncached write and more recently even read accesses as long as they are sequential. This knowledge can come in very handy when handling large data structures which are used only once. Second, caches can help to cover up some–but not all–of the costs of random memory access. Random access in this example is 70% slower due to the implementation of RAM access. Until the implementation changes, random accesses should be avoided whenever possible.

在关于预取的那一节中，我们将再次讨论非临时标志。

In the section about prefetching we will again take a look at the non-temporal flag.

6.2 缓存访问

6.2 Cache Access

希望提高程序性能的程序员会发现，最好把精力集中在影响一级缓存的改动上，因为这些改动很可能带来最好的结果。我们将首先讨论它，然后再把讨论扩展到其他级别。显然，所有针对一级缓存的优化也会影响其他缓存。所有内存访问的主题都是一样的：提高局部性（空间局部性和时间局部性），并对齐代码和数据。

Programmers wishing to improve their programs’ performance will find it best to focus on changes affected the level 1 cache since those will likely yield the best results. We will discuss it first before extending the discussion to the other levels. Obviously, all the optimizations for the level 1 cache also affect the other caches. The theme for all memory access is the same: improve locality (spatial and temporal) and align the code and data.

6.2.1 优化一级数据缓存访问

6.2.1 Optimizing Level 1 Data Cache Access

在3.3节中我们已经看到，有效地使用L1d缓存能在多大程度上提高性能。在本节中，我们将展示哪些类型的代码改动有助于提高这一性能。接续上一节，我们首先集中讨论顺序访问内存的优化。正如3.3节中的数字所示，当顺序访问内存时，处理器会自动预取数据。

In section section 3.3 we have already seen how much the effective use of the L1d cache can improve performance. In this section we will show what kinds of code changes can help to improve that performance. Continuing from the previous section, we first concentrate on optimizations to access memory sequentially. As seen in the numbers of section 3.3, the processor automatically prefetches data when memory is accessed sequentially.

所用的示例代码是矩阵乘法。我们使用两个1000 × 1000的double元素方阵。对于那些已经忘了数学的人：给定两个矩阵A和B，其元素为aij和bij，0 ≤ i, j < N，其乘积为

The example code used is a matrix multiplication. We use two square matrices of 1000 × 1000 double elements. For those who have forgotten the math, given two matrices A and B with elements aij and bij with 0 ≤ i, j < N the product is

(AB)ij=∑k=0N−1aikbkj=ai1b1j+ai2b2j+⋯+ai(N−1)b(N−1)j

一个直截了当的C实现可能看起来像这样：

A straight-forward C implementation of this can look like this:

for (i = 0; i < N; ++i)
  for (j = 0; j < N; ++j)
    for (k = 0; k < N; ++k)
      res[i][j] += mul1[i][k] * mul2[k][j];

两个输入矩阵是mul1和mul2。结果矩阵res假定已被初始化为全零。这是一个优美而简单的实现。但很明显，我们恰好遇到了图6.1所解释的问题。mul1是顺序访问的，而内层循环推进的是mul2的行号。这意味着mul1像图6.1中左边的矩阵那样被处理，而mul2像右边的矩阵那样被处理。这不可能好。

The two input matrices are mul1 and mul2. The result matrix res is assumed to be initialized to all zeroes. It is a nice and simple implementation. But it should be obvious that we have exactly the problem explained in Figure 6.1. While mul1 is accessed sequentially, the inner loop advances the row number of mul2. That means that mul1 is handled like the left matrix in Figure 6.1 while mul2 is handled like the right matrix. This cannot be good.

有一个很容易尝试的补救办法。由于矩阵中的每个元素都被访问多次，在使用第二个矩阵mul2之前对其进行重新排列（用数学术语说就是“转置”）可能是值得的。

There is one possible remedy one can easily try. Since each element in the matrices is accessed multiple times it might be worthwhile to rearrange (“transpose,” in mathematical terms) the second matrix mul2 before using it.

(AB)ij=∑k=0N−1aikbjkT=ai1bj1T+ai2bj2T+⋯+ai(N−1)bj(N−1)T

转置之后（传统上用上标“T”表示），我们现在顺序地遍历两个矩阵。就C代码而言，现在它看起来像这样：

After the transposition (traditionally indicated by a superscript ‘T’) we now iterate over both matrices sequentially. As far as the C code is concerned, it now looks like this:

double tmp[N][N];
for (i = 0; i < N; ++i)
  for (j = 0; j < N; ++j)
    tmp[i][j] = mul2[j][i];
for (i = 0; i < N; ++i)
  for (j = 0; j < N; ++j)
    for (k = 0; k < N; ++k)
      res[i][j] += mul1[i][k] * tmp[j][k];

我们创建一个临时变量来存放转置后的矩阵。这需要接触额外的内存，但这一代价有望得到补偿，因为每列1000次非顺序访问的代价更高（至少在现代硬件上如此）。是时候做些性能测试了。在时钟频率为2666MHz的Intel Core 2上，结果如下（以时钟周期计）：

We create a temporary variable to contain the transposed matrix. This requires touching additional memory, but this cost is, hopefully, recovered since the 1000 non-sequential accesses per column are more expensive (at least on modern hardware). Time for some performance tests. The results on a Intel Core 2 with 2666MHz clock speed are (in clock cycles):

原始
Original		转置
Transposed
周期数
Cycles		16,765,297,8703,922,373,010
相对值
Relative		100%23.4%

通过对矩阵的简单变换，我们获得了76.6%的加速！复制操作的代价被绰绰有余地弥补了。那1000次非顺序访问真的很伤性能。

Through the simple transformation of the matrix we can achieve a 76.6% speed-up! The copy operation is more than made up. The 1000 non-sequential accesses really hurt.

下一个问题是这是否是我们能做到的最好结果。无论如何，我们当然需要一种不要求额外复制的替代方法。我们不会总是有条件进行复制：矩阵可能太大，或者可用内存太小。

The next question is whether this is the best we can do. We certainly need an alternative method anyway which does not require the additional copy. We will not always have the luxury to be able to perform the copy: the matrix can be too large or the available memory too small.

寻找替代实现应当从仔细审视所涉及的数学以及原始实现所执行的操作开始。基本的数学知识就能让我们看出，只要每个加数恰好出现一次，结果矩阵每个元素的加法执行顺序就无关紧要。28这一认识使我们可以寻找对原始代码内层循环中所执行的加法重新排序的解决方案。

The search for an alternative implementation should start with a close examination of the math involved and the operations performed by the original implementation. Trivial math knowledge allows us to see that the order in which the additions for each element of the result matrix are performed is irrelevant as long as each addend appears exactly once.28 This understanding allows us to look for solutions which reorder the additions performed in the inner loop of the original code.

现在我们来考察原始代码执行中的实际问题。mul2元素被访问的顺序是：(0,0)、(1,0)、……、(N-1,0)、(0,1)、(1,1)、……。元素(0,0)和(0,1)位于同一缓存行中，但到内层循环完成一轮时，这个缓存行早已被逐出了。在这个例子中，内层循环的每一轮对三个矩阵中的每一个都需要1000个缓存行（对于Core 2处理器，每个64字节）。加起来远远超过可用的32k L1d。

Now let us examine the actual problem in the execution of the original code. The order in which the elements of mul2 are accessed is: (0,0), (1,0), ..., (N-1,0), (0,1), (1,1), . . . . The elements (0,0) and (0,1) are in the same cache line but, by the time the inner loop completes one round, this cache line has long been evicted. For this example, each round of the inner loop requires, for each of the three matrices, 1000 cache lines (with 64 bytes for the Core 2 processor). This adds up to much more than the 32k of L1d available.

但如果我们在执行内层循环的同时一起处理中层循环的两次迭代呢？在这种情况下，我们使用来自那个保证位于L1d中的缓存行的两个double值。我们把L1d未命中率减半了。这当然是一个改进，但根据缓存行的大小，这可能仍不是我们能做到的最好。Core 2处理器的L1d缓存行大小为64字节。实际值可以在运行时用

But what if we handle two iterations of the middle loop together while executing the inner loop? In this case we use two double values from the cache line which is guaranteed to be in L1d. We cut the L1d miss rate in half. That is certainly an improvement, but, depending on the cache line size, it still might not be as good as we can get it. The Core 2 processor has a L1d cache line size of 64 bytes. The actual value can be queried using

sysconf (_SC_LEVEL1_DCACHE_LINESIZE)

查询，或者在命令行上使用getconf工具查询，以便为特定的缓存行大小编译程序。由于sizeof(double)为8，这意味着为了充分利用缓存行，我们应当把中层循环展开8次。顺着这个思路，为了也有效地使用res矩阵，即同时写入8个结果，我们也应当把外层循环展开8次。这里我们假设缓存行大小为64，但这段代码在缓存行为32字节的系统上也能很好地工作，因为两个缓存行也都被100%地利用了。一般来说，最好在编译时使用getconf工具把缓存行大小硬编码进去，例如：

at runtime or using the getconf utility from the command line so that the program can be compiled for a specific cache line size. With sizeof(double) being 8 this means that, to fully utilize the cache line, we should unroll the middle loop 8 times. Continuing this thought, to effectively use the res matrix as well, i.e., to write 8 results at the same time, we should unroll the outer loop 8 times as well. We assume here cache lines of size 64 but the code works also well on systems with 32 byte cache lines since both cache lines are also 100% utilized. In general it is best to hardcode cache line sizes at compile time by using the getconf utility as in:

gcc -DCLS=$(getconf LEVEL1_DCACHE_LINESIZE) ...

如果二进制文件应当是通用的，就应当使用最大的缓存行大小。对于非常小的L1d，这可能意味着并非所有数据都能放进缓存，但这样的处理器本来就不适合高性能程序。我们得到的代码大致如下：

If the binaries are supposed to be generic, the largest cache line size should be used. With very small L1ds this might mean that not all the data fits into the cache but such processors are not suitable for high-performance programs anyway. The code we arrive at looks something like this:

#define SM (CLS / sizeof (double))

for (i = 0; i < N; i += SM)
  for (j = 0; j < N; j += SM)
    for (k = 0; k < N; k += SM)
      for (i2 = 0, rres = &res[i][j],
           rmul1 = &mul1[i][k]; i2 < SM;
           ++i2, rres += N, rmul1 += N)
        for (k2 = 0, rmul2 = &mul2[k][j];
             k2 < SM; ++k2, rmul2 += N)
          for (j2 = 0; j2 < SM; ++j2)
            rres[j2] += rmul1[k2] * rmul2[j2];

这看起来相当吓人。在某种程度上确实如此，但只是因为它包含了一些技巧。最明显的变化是我们现在有六重嵌套循环。外层循环以SM（缓存行大小除以sizeof(double)）为间隔进行迭代。这把乘法划分为若干个较小的问题，可以以更好的缓存局部性来处理。内层循环遍历外层循环缺失的那些索引。同样，这里有三个循环。这里唯一棘手的部分是k2和j2循环的顺序不同。这样做是因为在实际计算中，只有一个表达式依赖于k2，而有两个依赖于j2。

This looks quite scary. To some extent it is but only because it incorporates some tricks. The most visible change is that we now have six nested loops. The outer loops iterate with intervals of SM (the cache line size divided by sizeof(double)). This divides the multiplication in several smaller problems which can be handled with more cache locality. The inner loops iterate over the missing indexes of the outer loops. There are, once again, three loops. The only tricky part here is that the k2 and j2 loops are in a different order. This is done since, in the actual computation, only one expression depends on k2 but two depend on j2.

其余的复杂之处源于这样一个事实：在优化数组索引方面，gcc并不十分聪明。引入额外的变量rres、rmul1和rmul2，通过把公共表达式尽可能地提到内层循环之外来优化代码。C和C++语言默认的别名规则并不能帮助编译器作出这些决定（除非使用restrict，否则所有指针访问都是潜在的别名来源）。这就是为什么Fortran仍是数值编程的首选语言：用它更容易写出快速的代码。29

The rest of the complication here results from the fact that gcc is not very smart when it comes to optimizing array indexing. The introduction of the additional variables rres, rmul1, and rmul2 optimizes the code by pulling common expressions out of the inner loops, as far down as possible. The default aliasing rules of the C and C++ languages do not help the compiler making these decisions (unless restrict is used, all pointer accesses are potential sources of aliasing). This is why Fortran is still a preferred language for numeric programming: it makes writing fast code easier.29

所有这些工作带来了怎样的回报，可以从表6.2中看到。通过避免复制，我们又获得了6.1%的性能。而且，我们不需要任何额外的内存。只要结果矩阵也能放进内存，输入矩阵就可以任意大。这是对通用解决方案的要求，我们现在已经做到了。

How all this work pays off can be seen in Table 6.2. By avoiding the copying we gain another 6.1% of performance. Plus, we do not need any additional memory. The input matrices can be arbitrarily large as long as the result matrix fits into memory as well. This is a requirement for a general solution which we have now achieved.

表6.2中还有一列没有解释。如今大多数现代处理器都包含对向量化的专门支持。这些特殊指令通常冠以多媒体扩展之名，允许同时处理2个、4个、8个或更多的值。它们通常是SIMD（单指令多数据）操作，并辅以其他指令把数据整理成合适的形式。Intel处理器提供的SSE2指令可以在一次操作中处理两个double值。指令参考手册列出了提供对这些SSE2指令访问的内建函数。如果使用这些内建函数，程序又快了7.3%（相对于原始版本）。结果是一个运行时间只有原始代码10%的程序。换算成人们熟悉的数字，我们从318 MFLOPS提升到了3.35 GFLOPS。由于我们这里只关心内存效应，程序代码被放到了A.1节。

There is one more column in Table 6.2 which has not been explained. Most modern processors nowadays include special support for vectorization. Often branded as multi-media extensions, these special instructions allow processing of 2, 4, 8, or more values at the same time. These are often SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) operations, augmented by others to get the data in the right form. The SSE2 instructions provided by Intel processors can handle two double values in one operation. The instruction reference manual lists the intrinsic functions which provide access to these SSE2 instructions. If these intrinsics are used the program runs another 7.3% (relative to the original) faster. The result is a program which runs in 10% of the time of the original code. Translated into numbers which people recognize, we went from 318 MFLOPS to 3.35 GFLOPS. Since we are only interested in memory effects here, the program code is pushed out into section A.1.

应当指出，在代码的最后一个版本中，我们对mul2仍然存在一些缓存问题；预取仍然不起作用。但如果不转置矩阵，这个问题就无法解决。也许缓存预取单元会变得更聪明，能够识别这些模式，那时就不需要额外的改动了。不过，在2.66 GHz处理器上用单线程代码达到3.19 GFLOPS已经不错了。

It should be noted that, in the last version of the code, we still have some cache problems with mul2; prefetching still will not work. But this cannot be solved without transposing the matrix. Maybe the cache prefetching units will get smarter to recognize the patterns, then no additional change would be needed. 3.19 GFLOPS on a 2.66 GHz processor with single-threaded code is not bad, though.

我们在矩阵乘法的例子中所优化的，是对已加载缓存行的使用。缓存行的所有字节总是被使用的。我们只是确保在缓存行被腾出之前使用它们。这当然是一种特殊情况。

What we optimized in the example of the matrix multiplication is the use of the loaded cache lines. All bytes of a cache line are always used. We just made sure they are used before the cache line is evacuated. This is certainly a special case.

更常见的情况是，数据结构填满一个或多个缓存行，而程序在任一时刻只使用其中少数几个成员。在图3.11中我们已经看到，如果只使用少数成员，大的结构尺寸会带来怎样的影响。

It is much more common to have data structures which fill one or more cache lines where the program uses only a few members at any one time. In Figure 3.11 we have already seen the effects of large structure sizes if only few members are used.

图6.2显示了使用那个如今已广为人知的程序进行的又一组基准测试的结果。这一次，把同一链表元素的两个值相加。在一种情况下，两个元素位于同一缓存行中；在另一种情况下，一个元素位于链表元素的第一个缓存行中，另一个位于最后一个缓存行中。该图显示了我们所经历的变慢。

Figure 6.2 shows the results of yet another set of benchmarks performed using the by now well-known program. This time two values of the same list element are added. In one case, both elements are in the same cache line; in another case, one element is in the first cache line of the list element and the second is in the last cache line. The graph shows the slowdown we are experiencing.

不出所料，在所有情况下，如果工作集能放进L1d，就没有负面影响。一旦L1d不再足够，在过程中使用两个缓存行而不是一个就要付出代价。红线显示的是链表在内存中顺序排列时的数据。我们看到了通常的两级台阶模式：当L2缓存足够时约17%的代价，当必须使用主存时约27%的代价。

Unsurprisingly, in all cases there are no negative effects if the working set fits into L1d. Once L1d is no longer sufficient, penalties are paid by using two cache lines in the process instead of one. The red line shows the data when the list is laid out sequentially in memory. We see the usual two step patterns: about 17% penalty when the L2 cache is sufficient and about 27% penalty when the main memory has to be used.

在随机内存访问的情况下，相对数据看起来有些不同。对于能放进L2的工作集，变慢在25%到35%之间。超出之后，它下降到大约10%。这并不是因为代价变小了，而是因为实际的内存访问代价不成比例地变得更高。数据还表明，在某些情况下，元素之间的距离确实很重要。Random 4 CLs曲线显示出更高的代价，因为使用的是第一个和第四个缓存行。

In the case of random memory accesses the relative data looks a bit different. The slowdown for working sets which fit into L2 is between 25% and 35%. Beyond that it goes down to about 10%. This is not because the penalties get smaller but, instead, because the actual memory accesses get disproportionally more costly. The data also shows that, in some cases, the distance between the elements does matter. The Random 4 CLs curve shows higher penalties because the first and fourth cache lines are used.

查看数据结构相对于缓存行布局的一个简便方法是使用pahole程序（见[4]）。这个程序检查二进制文件中定义的数据结构。以一个包含如下定义的程序为例：

An easy way to see the layout of a data structure compared to cache lines is to use the pahole program (see [4]). This program examines the data structures defined in a binary. Take a program containing this definition:

struct foo {
  int a;
  long fill[7];
  int b;
};

在64位机器上编译时，pahole的输出包含（除其他内容外）图6.3所示的输出。这一输出告诉了我们很多信息。首先，它表明该数据结构用掉了不止一个缓存行。该工具假定使用当前处理器的缓存行大小，但这个值可以用命令行参数覆盖。尤其是在结构的大小刚刚超过缓存行界限、并且分配了大量这种类型对象的情况下，设法压缩该结构是有意义的。也许有几个元素可以使用更小的类型，或者有些字段实际上是标志，可以用单独的位来表示。

When compiled on a 64-bit machine, the output of pahole contains (among other things) the output shown in Figure 6.3. This output tells us a lot. First, it shows that the data structure uses up more than one cache line. The tool assumes the currently used processor’s cache line size, but this value can be overridden using a command line parameter. Especially in cases where the size of the structure is barely over the limit of a cache line, and many objects of this type are allocated, it makes sense to seek a way to compress that structure. Maybe a few elements can have a smaller type, or maybe some fields are actually flags which can be represented using individual bits.

在这个例子中，压缩很容易，而且程序也给出了提示。输出显示，在第一个元素之后有一个四字节的空洞。这个空洞是由结构和fill元素的对齐要求造成的。很容易看出，大小为四字节的元素b（由该行末尾的4表示）正好能放进这个空隙。这样做的结果是空隙不复存在，数据结构可以放进一个缓存行。pahole工具自己就能执行这项优化。如果使用--reorganize参数，并在命令行末尾加上结构名，工具的输出就是优化后的结构及其缓存行使用情况。除了移动元素来填补空隙之外，该工具还可以优化位字段，并合并填充和空洞。更多细节见[4]。

In the case of the example the compression is easy and it is hinted at by the program. The output shows that there is a hole of four bytes after the first element. This hole is caused by the alignment requirement of the structure and the fill element. It is easy to see that the element b, which has a size of four bytes (indicated by the 4 at the end of the line), fits perfectly into the gap. The result in this case is that the gap no longer exists and that the data structure fits onto one cache line. The pahole tool can perform this optimization itself. If the --reorganize parameter is used and the structure name is added at the end of the command line the output of the tool is the optimized structure and the cache line use. Besides moving elements to fill gaps, the tool can also optimize bit fields and combine padding and holes. For more details see [4].

有一个刚好足够容纳末尾元素的空洞当然是理想情况。要使这一优化有用，要求对象本身按缓存行对齐。我们稍后会谈到这一点。

Having a hole which is just large enough for the trailing element is, of course, the ideal situation. For this optimization to be useful it is required that the object itself is aligned to a cache line. We get to that in a bit.

pahole的输出还可以让人很容易地看出是否需要对元素重新排序，以便一起使用的元素也被存放在一起。使用pahole工具，可以很容易地确定哪些元素位于同一缓存行上，以及何时需要重新调整元素来做到这一点。这不是一个自动化的过程，但该工具可以提供相当大的帮助。

The pahole output also allows to see easily whether elements have to be reordered so that those elements which are used together are also stored together. Using the pahole tool, it is easily possible to determine which elements are on the same cache line and when, instead, the elements have to be reshuffled to achieve that. This is not an automatic process but the tool can help quite a bit.

各个结构元素的位置及其使用方式也很重要。正如我们在3.5.2节中看到的，关键字位于缓存行靠后位置的代码性能更差。这意味着程序员应当始终遵循以下两条规则：

The position of the individual structure elements and the way they are used is important, too. As we have seen in section 3.5.2 the performance of code with the critical word late in the cache line is worse. This means a programmer should always follow the following two rules:

  1. 总是把最可能成为关键字的结构元素移到结构的开头。

    Always move the structure element which is most likely to be the critical word to the beginning of the structure.

  2. 访问数据结构时，如果访问顺序不受情况所限，就按照元素在结构中定义的顺序访问它们。

    When accessing the data structures, and the order of access is not dictated by the situation, access the elements in the order in which they are defined in the structure.

对于小结构，这意味着元素应当按照它们可能被访问的顺序排列。这必须灵活处理，以便也能应用其他优化，例如填补空洞。对于较大的数据结构，每个缓存行大小的块都应当按照这些规则来安排。

For small structures, this means that the elements should be arranged in the order in which they are likely accessed. This must be handled in a flexible way to allow the other optimizations, such as filling holes, to be applied as well. For bigger data structures each cache line-sized block should be arranged to follow the rules.

不过，如果对象本身没有按预期对齐，重新排序元素就不值得花这个时间。对象的对齐由数据类型的对齐要求决定。每种基本类型都有自己的对齐要求。对于结构化类型，其任一元素中最大的对齐要求决定了该结构的对齐。这几乎总是小于缓存行大小。这意味着，即使结构的成员被排列得能放进同一个缓存行，分配出来的对象也可能不具有与缓存行大小相匹配的对齐。有两种方法可以确保对象具有设计结构布局时所采用的对齐：

If the object itself is not aligned as expected, reordering elements is not worth the time it takes, though. The alignment of an object is determined by the alignment requirement of the data type. Each fundamental type has its own alignment requirement. For structured types the largest alignment requirement of any of its elements determines the alignment of the structure. This is almost always smaller than the cache line size. This means even if the members of a structure are lined up to fit into the same cache line an allocated object might not have an alignment matching the cache line size. There are two ways to ensure that the object has the alignment which was used when designing the layout of the structure:

  • 可以用显式的对齐要求来分配对象。对于动态分配，调用malloc只会以与要求最高的标准类型（通常是long double）相匹配的对齐来分配对象。不过，可以使用posix_memalign来请求更高的对齐。

    the object can be allocated with an explicit alignment requirement. For dynamic allocation a call to malloc would only allocate the object with an alignment matching that of the most demanding standard type (usually long double). It is possible to use posix_memalign, though, to request higher alignments.

    #include <stdlib.h>
int posix_memalign(void **memptr,
                   size_t align,
                   size_t size);

    该函数把指向新分配内存的指针存入memptr所指向的指针变量中。内存块的大小为size字节，并按align字节边界对齐。

    The function stores a pointer pointing to the newly-allocated memory in the pointer variable pointed to by memptr. The memory block is size bytes in size and is aligned on a align-byte boundary.

    对于由编译器分配的对象（在.data、.bss等中以及栈上），可以使用变量属性：

    For objects allocated by the compiler (in .data, .bss, etc, and on the stack) a variable attribute can be used:

    struct strtype variable
   __attribute((aligned(64)));

    在这种情况下，无论strtype结构的对齐要求如何，该变量都按64字节边界对齐。这对全局变量和自动变量都适用。

    In this case the variable is aligned at a 64 byte boundary regardless of the alignment requirement of the strtype structure. This works for global variables as well as automatic variables.

    对于数组，这种方法并不像人们可能预期的那样起作用。除非每个数组元素的大小是对齐值的倍数，否则只有数组的第一个元素会被对齐。这也意味着每一个变量都必须被适当地标注。使用posix_memalign也并非完全没有代价，因为对齐要求通常会导致碎片和/或更高的内存消耗。

    For arrays this method does not work as one might expect. Only the first element of the array would be aligned unless the size of each array element is a multiple of the alignment value. It also means that every single variable must be annotated appropriately. The use of posix_memalign is also not entirely free since the alignment requirements usually lead to fragmentation and/or higher memory consumption.

  • 可以使用类型属性来改变用户定义类型的对齐要求：

    the alignment requirement of a user-defined type can be changed by using a type attribute:

    struct strtype {
  ...members...
} __attribute((aligned(64)));

    这将使编译器以适当的对齐来分配所有对象，包括数组。不过，对于动态分配的对象，程序员必须负责请求适当的对齐。这里同样必须使用posix_memalign。使用gcc提供的alignof运算符并把其值作为第二个参数传给posix_memalign是很容易的。

    This will cause the compiler to allocate all objects with the appropriate alignment, including arrays. The programmer has to take care of requesting the appropriate alignment for dynamically allocated objects, though. Here once again posix_memalign must be used. It is easy enough to use the alignof operator gcc provides and pass the value as the second parameter to posix_memalign.

本节前面提到的多媒体扩展几乎总是要求内存访问是对齐的。也就是说，对于16字节的内存访问，地址应当是16字节对齐的。x86和x86-64处理器有能够处理非对齐访问的特殊内存操作变体，但它们更慢。这种硬性的对齐要求对于大多数RISC架构来说并不新鲜，它们要求所有内存访问都完全对齐。即使一种架构支持非对齐访问，这有时也比使用适当的对齐更慢，尤其是当未对齐导致一次加载或存储要使用两个缓存行而不是一个时。

The multimedia extensions previously mentioned in this section almost always require that the memory accesses are aligned. I.e., for 16 byte memory accesses the address is supposed to be 16 byte aligned. The x86 and x86-64 processors have special variants of the memory operations which can handle unaligned accesses but these are slower. This hard alignment requirement is nothing new for most RISC architectures which require full alignment for all memory accesses. Even if an architecture supports unaligned accesses this is sometimes slower than using appropriate alignment, especially if the misalignment causes a load or store to use two cache lines instead of one.

图6.4显示了非对齐内存访问的影响。测量的是那些如今已广为人知的、在访问内存（顺序或随机地）时对数据元素加一的测试，一次使用对齐的链表元素，一次使用故意未对齐的元素。该图显示了程序因非对齐访问而产生的变慢。顺序访问情况下的影响比随机情况更显著，因为在后一种情况下，非对齐访问的代价部分地被通常更高的内存访问代价所掩盖。在顺序的情况下，对于能放进L2缓存的工作集大小，变慢约为300%。这可以用L1缓存有效性的降低来解释。现在一些加一操作会触及两个缓存行，开始处理一个链表元素现在常常需要读取两个缓存行。L1与L2之间的连接实在太拥挤了。

Figure 6.4 shows the effects of unaligned memory accesses. The now well-known tests which increment a data element while visiting memory (sequentially or randomly) are measured, once with aligned list elements and once with deliberately misaligned elements. The graph shows the slowdown the program incurs because of the unaligned accesses. The effects are more dramatic for the sequential access case than for the random case because, in the latter case, the costs of unaligned accesses are partially hidden by the generally higher costs of the memory access. In the sequential case, for working set sizes which do fit into the L2 cache, the slowdown is about 300%. This can be explained by the reduced effectiveness of the L1 cache. Some increment operations now touch two cache lines, and beginning work on a list element now often requires reading of two cache lines. The connection between L1 and L2 is simply too congested.

对于非常大的工作集，非对齐访问的影响仍有20%到30%——考虑到这些大小下对齐访问的时间本来就很长，这是很多的。这张图应当表明，对齐必须被认真对待。即使架构支持非对齐访问，也绝不能把它当作“与对齐访问一样好”。

For very large working set sizes, the effects of the unaligned access are still 20% to 30%–which is a lot given that the aligned access time for those sizes is long. This graph should show that alignment must be taken seriously. Even if the architecture supports unaligned accesses, this must not be taken as “they are as good as aligned accesses”.

不过，这些对齐要求也有一些副作用。如果一个自动变量有对齐要求，编译器就必须确保在所有情况下都满足它。这并不简单，因为编译器无法控制调用点以及它们处理栈的方式。这个问题可以用两种方法处理：

There is some fallout from these alignment requirements, though. If an automatic variable has an alignment requirement, the compiler has to ensure that it is met in all situations. This is not trivial since the compiler has no control over the call sites and the way they handle the stack. This problem can be handled in two ways:

  1. 生成的代码主动对齐栈，必要时插入间隙。这需要代码来检查对齐、建立对齐，并在之后撤销对齐。

    The generated code actively aligns the stack, inserting gaps if necessary. This requires code to check for alignment, create alignment, and later undo the alignment.

  2. 要求所有调用者都对齐栈。

    Require that all callers have the stack aligned.

所有常用的应用程序二进制接口（ABI）都遵循第二条路线。如果调用者违反了这条规则而被调用者又需要对齐，程序很可能会失败。不过，保持对齐并不是没有代价的。

All of the commonly used application binary interfaces (ABIs) follow the second route. Programs will likely fail if a caller violates the rule and alignment is needed in the callee. Keeping alignment intact does not come for free, though.

函数所用栈帧的大小不一定是对齐值的倍数。这意味着如果从这个栈帧调用其他函数，就需要填充。最大的区别在于，在大多数情况下编译器知道栈帧的大小，因此它知道如何调整栈指针，以确保从该栈帧调用的任何函数都能满足对齐。事实上，大多数编译器会简单地把栈帧大小向上取整，然后就完事了。

The size of a stack frame used in a function is not necessarily a multiple of the alignment. This means padding is needed if other functions are called from this stack frame. The big difference is that the stack frame size is, in most cases, known to the compiler and, therefore, it knows how to adjust the stack pointer to ensure alignment for any function which is called from that stack frame. In fact, most compilers will simply round the stack frame size up and be done with it.

如果使用了变长数组（VLA）或alloca，这种处理对齐的简单方法就行不通了。在这种情况下，栈帧的总大小只有在运行时才知道。这时可能需要主动的对齐控制，使生成的代码（稍微）变慢。

This simple way to handle alignment is not possible if variable length arrays (VLAs) or alloca are used. In that case, the total size of the stack frame is only known at runtime. Active alignment control might be needed in this case, making the generated code (slightly) slower.

在某些架构上，只有多媒体扩展需要严格对齐；这些架构上的栈对于普通数据类型总是最低限度地对齐的，对于32位和64位架构通常分别是4字节或8字节对齐。在这些系统上，强制对齐会带来不必要的代价。这意味着，在这种情况下，如果我们知道从未依赖于严格的对齐要求，我们可能希望去掉它。不做多媒体操作的尾函数（即不调用其他函数的函数）不需要对齐。只调用不需要对齐的函数的函数也不需要。如果能找出足够大的一组函数，程序可能会希望放宽对齐要求。对于x86二进制文件，gcc支持放宽的栈对齐要求：

On some architectures, only the multimedia extensions require strict alignment; stacks on those architectures are always minimally aligned for the normal data types, usually 4 or 8 byte alignment for 32- and 64-bit architectures respectively. On these systems, enforcing the alignment incurs unnecessary costs. That means that, in this case, we might want to get rid of the strict alignment requirement if we know that it is never depended upon. Tail functions (those which call no other functions) which do no multimedia operations do not need alignment. Neither do functions which only call functions which need no alignment. If a large enough set of functions can be identified, a program might want to relax the alignment requirement. For x86 binaries gcc has support for relaxed stack alignment requirements:

-mpreferred-stack-boundary=2

如果给这个选项一个值N，栈对齐要求将被设置为2N字节。因此，如果使用值2，栈对齐要求就从默认值（16字节）降低到仅4字节。在大多数情况下，这意味着不需要额外的对齐操作，因为普通的栈压入和弹出操作本来就以四字节为边界工作。这个机器特定的选项有助于减小代码尺寸，也能提高执行速度。但它不能应用于许多其他架构。即使对于x86-64，它一般也不适用，因为x86-64 ABI要求浮点参数通过SSE寄存器传递，而SSE指令要求完整的16字节对齐。尽管如此，只要该选项可用，它就可能带来明显的差异。

If this option is given a value of N, the stack alignment requirement will be set to 2N bytes. So, if a value of 2 is used, the stack alignment requirement is reduced from the default (which is 16 bytes) to just 4 bytes. In most cases this means no additional alignment operation is needed since normal stack push and pop operations work on four-byte boundaries anyway. This machine-specific option can help to reduce code size and also improve execution speed. But it cannot be applied for many other architectures. Even for x86-64 it is generally not applicable since the x86-64 ABI requires that floating-point parameters are passed in an SSE register and the SSE instructions require full 16 byte alignment. Nevertheless, whenever the option is usable it can make a noticeable difference.

结构元素的高效布局和对齐并不是影响缓存效率的数据结构的唯一方面。如果使用结构数组，整个结构定义都会影响性能。还记得图3.11中的结果：在那种情况下，数组元素中未使用的数据越来越多。结果是预取越来越无效，对于大数据集，程序变得越来越低效。

Efficient placement of structure elements and alignment are not the only aspects of data structures which influence cache efficiency. If an array of structures is used, the entire structure definition affects performance. Remember the results in Figure 3.11: in this case we had increasing amounts of unused data in the elements of the array. The result was that prefetching was increasingly less effective and the program, for large data sets, became less efficient.

对于大型工作集，尽可能好地使用可用的缓存是很重要的。为此，可能有必要重新安排数据结构。虽然对程序员来说，把概念上属于一体的所有数据放在同一个数据结构中更容易，但这可能不是获得最高性能的最佳方法。假设我们有如下数据结构：

For large working sets it is important to use the available cache as well as possible. To achieve this, it might be necessary to rearrange data structures. While it is easier for the programmer to put all the data which conceptually belongs together in the same data structure, this might not be the best approach for maximum performance. Assume we have a data structure as follows:

struct order {
  double price;
  bool paid;
  const char *buyer[5];
  long buyer_id;
};

再假设这些记录存储在一个大数组中，并且有一个经常运行的作业要把所有未付账单的预期付款加起来。在这种场景下，用于buyer和buyer_id字段的内存被不必要地加载到了缓存中。根据图3.11中的数据判断，程序的性能可能比它本可以达到的差多达5倍。

Further assume that these records are stored in a big array and that a frequently-run job adds up the expected payments of all the outstanding bills. In this scenario, the memory used for the buyer and buyer_id fields is unnecessarily loaded into the caches. Judging from the data in Figure 3.11 the program will perform up to 5 times worse than it could.

把order数据结构拆成两部分要好得多：把前两个字段存放在一个结构中，把其他字段存放在别处。这一改动无疑增加了程序的复杂性，但性能上的收益可能证明这一代价是值得的。

It is much better to split the order data structure in two pieces, storing the first two fields in one structure and the other fields elsewhere. This change certainly increases the complexity of the program, but the performance gains might justify this cost.

最后，让我们考虑另一种缓存使用优化，它虽然也适用于其他缓存，但主要体现在L1d访问上。正如图3.8所示，提高缓存的相联度有利于正常运行。缓存越大，相联度通常就越高。L1d缓存太大，不可能是全相联的，但又不够大，无法拥有与L2缓存相同的相联度。如果工作集中的许多对象落入同一个缓存组，这就可能成为问题。如果这导致因某个组被过度使用而发生逐出，即使大部分缓存都未被使用，程序也可能遭遇延迟。这些缓存未命中有时称为冲突未命中。由于L1d的寻址使用虚拟地址，这实际上是程序员可以控制的事情。如果一起使用的变量也被存放在一起，它们落入同一组的可能性就会降到最低。图6.5显示了这个问题来得有多快。

Finally, let us consider another cache use optimization which, while also applying to the other caches, is primarily felt in the L1d access. As seen in Figure 3.8 an increased associativity of the cache benefits normal operation. The larger the cache, the higher the associativity usually is. The L1d cache is too large to be fully associative but not large enough to have the same associativity as L2 caches. This can be a problem if many of the objects in the working set fall into the same cache set. If this leads to evictions due to overuse of a set, the program can experience delays even though much of the cache is unused. These cache misses are sometimes called conflict misses. Since the L1d addressing uses virtual addresses, this is actually something the programmer can have control over. If variables which are used together are also stored together the likelihood of them falling into the same set is minimized. Figure 6.5 shows how quickly the problem can hit.

在该图中，如今已熟悉的NPAD=15的Follow30测试在一种特殊设置下被测量。X轴是两个链表元素之间的距离，以空链表元素为单位度量。换句话说，距离为2意味着下一个元素的地址在前一个元素之后128字节处。所有元素在虚拟地址空间中都以相同的距离排列。Y轴显示链表的总长度。只使用1到16个元素，这意味着总工作集大小为64到1024字节。z轴显示遍历每个链表元素所需的平均周期数。

In the figure, the now familiar Follow30 with NPAD=15 test is measured with a special setup. The X–axis is the distance between two list elements, measured in empty list elements. In other words, a distance of 2 means that the next element’s address is 128 bytes after the previous one. All elements are laid out in the virtual address space with the same distance. The Y–axis shows the total length of the list. Only one to 16 elements are used, meaning that the total working set size is 64 to 1024 bytes. The z–axis shows the average number of cycles needed to traverse each list element.

图中所示的结果应该不会令人惊讶。如果使用的元素很少，所有数据都能放进L1d，访问时间每个链表元素只有3个周期。对于链表元素几乎所有的排列方式都是如此：虚拟地址被很好地映射到L1d槽位上，几乎没有冲突。有两个（在这张图中）特殊的距离值，情况有所不同。如果距离是4096字节的倍数（即距离为64个元素），并且链表长度大于八，每个链表元素的平均周期数就会急剧增加。在这些情况下，所有条目都位于同一组中，一旦链表长度大于相联度，条目就会被从L1d中刷出，下一轮必须从L2重新读取。这导致每个链表元素约10个周期的代价。

The result shown in the figure should not be surprising. If few elements are used, all the data fits into L1d and the access time is only 3 cycles per list element. The same is true for almost all arrangements of the list elements: the virtual addresses are nicely mapped to L1d slots with almost no conflicts. There are two (in this graph) special distance values for which the situation is different. If the distance is a multiple of 4096 bytes (i.e., distance of 64 elements) and the length of the list is greater than eight, the average number of cycles per list element increases dramatically. In these situations all entries are in the same set and, once the list length is greater than the associativity, entries are flushed from L1d and have to be re-read from L2 the next round. This results in the cost of about 10 cycles per list element.

通过这张图，我们可以确定所用处理器的L1d缓存相联度为8，总大小为32kB。这意味着，如果有必要，这个测试可以用来确定这些值。同样的效应也可以在L2缓存上测量到，但在那里更为复杂，因为L2缓存使用物理地址索引，而且大得多。

With this graph we can determine that the processor used has an L1d cache with associativity 8 and a total size of 32kB. That means that the test could, if necessary, be used to determine these values. The same effects can be measured for the L2 cache but, here, it is more complex since the L2 cache is indexed using physical addresses and it is much larger.

希望程序员能把这些数据看作一个信号：组相联度是值得关注的。在现实世界中，把数据布置在2的幂次边界上的情况经常发生，但这恰恰是很容易导致上述效应和性能下降的情形。非对齐访问可能会增加冲突未命中的概率，因为每次访问可能需要额外的一个缓存行。

Programmers will hopefully see this data as an indication that set associativity is something worth paying attention to. Laying out data at boundaries that are powers of two happens often enough in the real world, but this is exactly the situation which can easily lead to the above effects and degraded performance. Unaligned accesses can increase the probability of conflict misses since each access might require an additional cache line.

如果执行了这项优化，另一项相关的优化也成为可能。至少AMD的处理器把L1d实现为若干个独立的存储体（bank）。L1d每个周期可以接收两个数据字，但前提是这两个字存储在不同的存储体中，或者存储在同一存储体中且索引相同。存储体地址编码在虚拟地址的低位中，如图6.6所示。如果一起使用的变量也被存放在一起，它们位于不同存储体中或位于同一存储体且索引相同的可能性就很高。

If this optimization is performed, another related optimization is possible, too. AMD’s processors, at least, implement the L1d as several individual banks. The L1d can receive two data words per cycle but only if both words are stored in different banks or in a bank with the same index. The bank address is encoded in the low bits of the virtual address as shown in Figure 6.6. If variables which are used together are also stored together the likelihood that they are in different banks or the same bank with the same index is high.

6.2.2 优化一级指令缓存访问

6.2.2 Optimizing Level 1 Instruction Cache Access

为良好地使用L1i而准备代码，需要与良好使用L1d类似的技术。不过，问题在于，除非用汇编语言编写代码，程序员通常无法直接影响L1i的使用方式。如果使用编译器，程序员可以通过引导编译器生成更好的代码布局来间接地决定L1i的使用。

Preparing code for good L1i use needs similar techniques as good L1d use. The problem is, though, that the programmer usually does not directly influence the way L1i is used unless s/he writes code in assembler. If compilers are used, programmers can indirectly determine the L1i use by guiding the compiler to create a better code layout.

代码的优点在于，在跳转之间它是线性的。在这些区间内，处理器可以高效地预取内存。跳转打乱了这幅美好的图景，因为

Code has the advantage that it is linear between jumps. In these periods the processor can prefetch memory efficiently. Jumps disturb this nice picture because

  • 跳转目标可能无法静态确定；

    the jump target might not be statically determined;

  • 而且即使它是静态的，如果所有缓存都未命中，取内存也可能需要很长时间。

    and even if it is static the memory fetch might take a long time if it misses all caches.

这些问题会造成执行停顿，可能对性能产生严重影响。这就是为什么如今的处理器在分支预测（BP）上投入巨大。高度专门化的BP单元试图在跳转之前尽可能早地确定跳转的目标，以便处理器可以开始把新位置的指令加载到缓存中。它们使用静态和动态规则，并且越来越擅长确定执行中的模式。

These problems create stalls in execution with a possibly severe impact on performance. This is why today’s processors invest heavily in branch prediction (BP). Highly specialized BP units try to determine the target of a jump as far ahead of the jump as possible so that the processor can initiate loading the instructions at the new location into the cache. They use static and dynamic rules and are increasingly good at determining patterns in execution.

对于指令缓存而言，尽早把数据放入缓存甚至更加重要。正如3.1节所述，指令在执行之前必须先被解码，为了加快这一过程（这在x86和x86-64上很重要），指令实际上是以解码后的形式被缓存的，而不是以从内存读取的字节/字形式。

Getting data into the cache as soon as possible is even more important for the instruction cache. As mentioned in section 3.1, instructions have to be decoded before they can be executed and, to speed this up (important on x86 and x86-64), instructions are actually cached in the decoded form, not in the byte/word form read from memory.

为了实现最佳的L1i使用，程序员至少应当注意代码生成的以下几个方面：

To achieve the best L1i use programmers should look out for at least the following aspects of code generation:

  1. 尽可能减少代码占用。这必须与循环展开和内联等优化相平衡。

    reduce the code footprint as much as possible. This has to be balanced with optimizations like loop unrolling and inlining.

  2. 代码执行应当是线性的，没有气泡。31

    code execution should be linear without bubbles.31

  3. 在有意义的地方对齐代码。

    aligning code when it makes sense.

我们现在来看一些可用于帮助按照这些方面优化程序的编译器技术。

We will now look at some compiler techniques available to help with optimizing programs according to these aspects.

编译器有启用各级优化的选项；具体的优化也可以单独启用。在高优化级别（gcc的-O2和-O3）下启用的许多优化涉及循环优化和函数内联。一般来说，这些都是好的优化。如果以这些方式优化的代码占程序总执行时间的很大一部分，整体性能就能得到提高。特别是函数内联，它使编译器能够一次优化更大的代码块，这反过来又使得生成能更好地利用处理器流水线架构的机器码成为可能。当程序更大的部分可以被视为一个单元时，对代码和数据的处理（通过死代码消除或值范围传播等）效果更好。

Compilers have options to enable levels of optimization; specific optimizations can also be individually enabled. Many of the optimizations enabled at high optimization levels (-O2 and -O3 for gcc) deal with loop optimizations and function inlining. In general, these are good optimizations. If the code which is optimized in these ways accounts for a significant part of the total execution time of the program, overall performance can be improved. Inlining of functions, in particular, allows the compiler to optimize larger chunks of code at a time which, in turn, enables the generation of machine code which better exploits the processor’s pipeline architecture. The handling of both code and data (through dead code elimination or value range propagation, and others) works better when larger parts of the program can be considered as a single unit.

更大的代码尺寸意味着对L1i（以及L2和更高级别）缓存的更大压力。这可能导致性能下降。更小的代码可能更快。幸运的是，gcc有一个优化选项来指定这一点。如果使用-Os，编译器将针对代码尺寸进行优化。已知会增大代码尺寸的优化会被禁用。使用这个选项常常会产生令人惊讶的结果。特别是如果编译器无法真正利用循环展开和内联，这个选项会是一大胜利。

A larger code size means higher pressure on the L1i (and also L2 and higher level) caches. This can lead to less performance. Smaller code can be faster. Fortunately gcc has an optimization option to specify this. If -Os is used the compiler will optimize for code size. Optimizations which are known to increase the code size are disabled. Using this option often produces surprising results. Especially if the compiler cannot really take advantage of loop unrolling and inlining, this option is a big win.

内联也可以单独控制。编译器有指导内联的启发式规则和限制；这些限制可以由程序员控制。-finline-limit选项指定一个函数必须有多大才会被认为太大而不能内联。如果一个函数在多个地方被调用，在所有这些地方都内联它会导致代码尺寸暴增。但还不止于此。假设函数inlcand在两个函数f1和f2中被调用。函数f1和f2本身又是依次被调用的。

Inlining can be controlled individually as well. The compiler has heuristics and limits which guide inlining; these limits can be controlled by the programmer. The -finline-limit option specifies how large a function must be to be considered too large for inlining. If a function is called in multiple places, inlining it in all of them would cause an explosion in the code size. But there is more. Assume a function inlcand is called in two functions f1 and f2. The functions f1 and f2 are themselves called in sequence.

表6.3显示了在不内联以及在两个函数中都内联的情况下生成的代码可能的样子。如果函数inlcand在f1和f2中都被内联，生成代码的总大小为size f1 + size f2 + 2× size inlcand。如果没有发生内联，总大小要小size inlcand。如果f1和f2在短时间内先后被调用，这就是所需额外L1i和L2缓存的大小。再者：如果inlcand没有被内联，代码可能仍在L1i中，就不必再次解码。再者：分支预测单元可能会更好地预测跳转，因为它已经见过这段代码了。如果编译器对内联函数大小上限的默认值对程序来说不是最佳的，就应当降低它。

Table 6.3 shows how the generated code could look like in the cases of no inline and inlining in both functions. If the function inlcand is inlined in both f1 and f2 the total size of the generated code is size f1 + size f2 + 2× size inlcand. If no inlining happens, the total size is smaller by size inlcand. This is how much more L1i and L2 cache is needed if f1 and f2 are called shortly after one another. Plus: if inlcand is not inlined, the code might still be in L1i and it will not have to be decoded again. Plus: the branch prediction unit might do a better job of predicting jumps since it has already seen the code. If the compiler default for the upper limit on the size of inlined functions is not the best for the program, it should be lowered.

不过，也有一些情况下内联总是有意义的。如果一个函数只被调用一次，那就不妨把它内联。这给了编译器执行更多优化的机会（例如值范围传播，它可能会显著改进代码）。这种内联可能会被选择限制所阻碍。对于这类情况，gcc有一个选项来指定某个函数总是被内联。添加always_inline函数属性会指示编译器严格按照其名称所示去做。

There are cases, though, when inlining always makes sense. If a function is only called once it might as well be inlined. This gives the compiler the opportunity to perform more optimizations (like value range propagation, which might significantly improve the code). That inlining might be thwarted by the selection limits. gcc has, for cases like this, an option to specify that a function is always inlined. Adding the always_inline function attribute instructs the compiler to do exactly what the name suggests.

在同样的语境下，如果一个函数尽管足够小却永远不应被内联，可以使用noinline函数属性。即使对于小函数，如果它们经常从不同的地方被调用，使用这个属性也是有意义的。如果L1i的内容可以被重用并且整体占用减少了，这通常能弥补额外函数调用的代价。如今的分支预测单元相当出色。如果内联可以带来更激进的优化，情况就不同了。这是必须根据具体情况决定的事情。

In the same context, if a function should never be inlined despite being small enough, the noinline function attribute can be used. Using this attribute makes sense even for small functions if they are called often from different places. If the L1i content can be reused and the overall footprint is reduced this often makes up for the additional cost of the extra function call. Branch prediction units are pretty good these days. If inlining can lead to more aggressive optimizations things look different. This is something which must be decided on a case-by-case basis.

如果内联的代码总是被使用，always_inline属性效果很好。但如果情况并非如此呢？如果内联的函数只是偶尔被调用呢：

The always_inline attribute works well if the inline code is always used. But what if this is not the case? What if the inlined function is called only occasionally:

void fct(void) {
  ... code block A ...
  if (condition)
    inlfct()
  ... code block C ...
}

为这样的代码序列生成的代码一般与源代码的结构相匹配。这意味着首先是代码块A，然后是一个条件跳转，如果条件求值为假，就向前跳转。接下来是为内联的inlfct生成的代码，最后是代码块C。这一切看起来都很合理，但它有一个问题。

The code generated for such a code sequence in general matches the structure of the sources. That means first comes the code block A, then a conditional jump which, if the condition evaluates to false, jumps forward. The code generated for the inlined inlfct comes next, and finally the code block C. This looks all reasonable but it has a problem.

如果condition经常为假，执行就不是线性的。中间有一大块未被使用的代码，它不仅因预取而污染L1i，还可能给分支预测带来问题。如果分支预测错误，条件表达式可能会非常低效。

If the condition is frequently false, the execution is not linear. There is a big chunk of unused code in the middle which not only pollutes the L1i due to prefetching, it also can cause problems with branch prediction. If the branch prediction is wrong the conditional expression can be very inefficient.

这是一个普遍的问题，并不特定于函数内联。每当使用条件执行并且它是不平衡的（即表达式导致某一结果的次数远多于另一结果）时，就有可能出现错误的静态分支预测，从而在流水线中产生气泡。这可以通过告诉编译器把较少执行的代码移出主代码路径来避免。在那种情况下，为if语句生成的条件分支将跳转到一个不按顺序的位置，如下图所示。

This is a general problem and not specific to inlining functions. Whenever conditional execution is used and it is lopsided (i.e., the expression far more often leads to one result than the other) there is the potential for false static branch prediction and thus bubbles in the pipeline. This can be prevented by telling the compiler to move the less often executed code out of the main code path. In that case the conditional branch generated for an if statement would jump to a place out of the order as can be seen in the following figure.

上半部分表示简单的代码布局。如果区域B（例如由上面内联的函数inlfct生成）因为条件I跳过它而经常不被执行，处理器的预取会拉入包含块B的缓存行，而这些缓存行很少被使用。使用块重排可以改变这一点，其结果可以在图的下半部分看到。经常执行的代码在内存中是线性的，而很少执行的代码被移到了某个不会损害预取和L1i效率的地方。

The upper parts represents the simple code layout. If the area B, e.g. generated from the inlined function inlfct above, is often not executed because the conditional I jumps over it, the prefetching of the processor will pull in cache lines containing block B which are rarely used. Using block reordering this can be changed, with a result that can be seen in the lower part of the figure. The often-executed code is linear in memory while the rarely-executed code is moved somewhere where it does not hurt prefetching and L1i efficiency.

gcc提供了两种方法来做到这一点。首先，编译器可以在重新编译代码时考虑剖析（profiling）输出，并根据剖析结果安排代码块。我们将在第7节中看到这是如何工作的。第二种方法是通过显式的分支预测。gcc识别__builtin_expect：

gcc provides two methods to achieve this. First, the compiler can take profiling output into account while recompiling code and lay out the code blocks according to the profile.
