We will see how this works in section 7. The second method is through explicit branch prediction. gcc recognizes __builtin_expect:

long __builtin_expect(long EXP, long C);

这个构造告诉编译器，表达式EXP最有可能取值C。返回值是EXP。__builtin_expect旨在用于条件表达式中。在几乎所有情况下，它都将在布尔表达式的语境中使用，这时定义两个辅助宏要方便得多：

This construct tells the compiler that the expression EXP most likely will have the value C. The return value is EXP. __builtin_expect is meant to be used in an conditional expression. In almost all cases will it be used in the context of boolean expressions in which case it is much more convenient to define two helper macros:

#define unlikely(expr) __builtin_expect(!!(expr), 0)
#define likely(expr) __builtin_expect(!!(expr), 1)

然后可以这样使用这些宏：

These macros can then be used as in

if (likely(a > 1))

如果程序员使用了这些宏，然后使用-freorder-blocks优化选项，gcc就会像上图那样重排代码块。这个选项在-O2下启用，但在-Os下禁用。还有另一个重排代码块的gcc选项（-freorder-blocks-and-partition），但它的用处有限，因为它不能与异常处理一起工作。

If the programmer makes use of these macros and then uses the -freorder-blocks optimization option gcc will reorder blocks as in the figure above. This option is enabled with -O2 but disabled for -Os. There is another gcc option to reorder block (-freorder-blocks-and-partition) but it has limited usefulness because it does not work with exception handling.

小循环还有另一个很大的优点，至少在某些处理器上是这样。Intel Core 2前端有一个称为循环流检测器（LSD）的特殊功能。如果一个循环不超过18条指令（其中没有一条是对子程序的调用），只需要最多4次16字节的解码器取指，最多有4条分支指令，并且执行超过64次，那么该循环有时会被锁定在指令队列中，因而在再次使用该循环时能更快地获得。例如，这适用于通过外层循环多次进入的小型内层循环。即使没有这种专门的硬件，紧凑的循环也有其优点。

There is another big advantage of small loops, at least on certain processors. The Intel Core 2 front end has a special feature called Loop Stream Detector (LSD). If a loop has no more than 18 instructions (none of which is a call to a subroutine), requires only up to 4 decoder fetches of 16 bytes, has at most 4 branch instructions, and is executed more than 64 times, than the loop is sometimes locked in the instruction queue and therefore more quickly available when the loop is used again. This applies, for instance, to small inner loops which are entered many times through an outer loop. Even without such specialized hardware compact loops have advantages.

内联并不是关于L1i优化的唯一方面。另一个方面是对齐，就像对于数据一样。有一些明显的区别：代码是一个大体上线性的整块，不能在地址空间中任意放置，而且由于代码由编译器生成，程序员无法直接影响它。不过，还是有一些方面是程序员可以控制的。

Inlining is not the only aspect of optimization with respect to L1i. Another aspect is alignment, just as for data. There are obvious differences: code is a mostly linear blob which cannot be placed arbitrarily in the address space and it cannot be influenced directly by the programmer as the compiler generates the code. There are some aspects which the programmer can control, though.

对齐每一条指令是没有意义的。目标是让指令流是顺序的。所以对齐只在策略性的位置才有意义。为了决定在哪里添加对齐，有必要理解它可能带来的好处。让一条指令位于缓存行的开头32意味着对该缓存行的预取最大化了。对于指令，这也意味着解码器更有效。很容易看出，如果执行的是位于缓存行末尾的一条指令，处理器就必须准备读取一个新的缓存行并对指令解码。有些事情可能会出错（例如缓存行未命中），这意味着位于缓存行末尾的指令平均而言不如位于开头的指令执行得那么有效。

Aligning each single instruction does not make any sense. The goal is to have the instruction stream be sequential. So alignment only makes sense in strategic places. To decide where to add alignments it is necessary to understand what the advantages can be. Having an instruction at the beginning of a cache line32 means that the prefetch of the cache line is maximized. For instructions this also means the decoder is more effective. It is easy to see that, if an instruction at the end of a cache line is executed, the processor has to get ready to read a new cache line and decode the instructions. There are things which can go wrong (such as cache line misses), meaning that an instruction at the end of the cache line is, on average, not as effectively executed as one at the beginning.

再结合后续的推论——如果控制刚刚转移到所讨论的指令（因而预取无效），问题最为严重——我们就得出了关于代码对齐在何处最有用的最终结论：

Combine this with the follow-up deduction that the problem is most severe if control was just transferred to the instruction in question (and hence prefetching is not effective) and we arrive at our final conclusion where alignment of code is most useful:

  • 在函数的开头；

    at the beginning of functions;

  • 在只能通过跳转到达的基本块的开头；

    at the beginning of basic blocks which are reached only through jumps;

  • 在某种程度上，在循环的开头。

    to some extent, at the beginning of loops.

在前两种情况下，对齐的代价很小。执行在一个新的位置继续，如果我们选择让它位于缓存行的开头，就优化了预取和解码。33编译器通过插入一系列空操作指令来填补对齐代码所产生的空隙，从而实现这种对齐。这种“死代码”占用一点空间，但通常不会损害性能。

In the first two cases the alignment comes at little cost. Execution proceeds at a new location and, if we choose it to be at the beginning of a cache line, we optimize prefetching and decoding.33 The compiler accomplishes this alignment through the insertion of a series of no-op instructions to fill the gap created by aligning the code. This “dead code” takes a little space but does not normally hurt performance.

第三种情况略有不同：对齐每个循环的开头可能会造成性能问题。问题在于循环的开头往往是顺序地跟在其他代码之后的。如果情况不太走运，前一条指令与对齐后的循环开头之间就会有一个空隙。与前两种情况不同，这个空隙不可能完全是死的。在执行完前一条指令之后，必须执行循环中的第一条指令。这意味着，在前一条指令之后，要么必须有若干条空操作指令来填补空隙，要么必须有一条无条件跳转到循环开头。两种可能都不是免费的。尤其是如果循环本身执行得不频繁，空操作或跳转的代价可能超过对齐循环所节省的。

The third case is slightly different: aligning the beginning of each loop might create performance problems. The problem is that beginning of a loop often follows other code sequentially. If the circumstances are not very lucky there will be a gap between the previous instruction and the aligned beginning of the loop. Unlike in the previous two cases, this gap cannot be completely dead. After execution of the previous instruction the first instruction in the loop must be executed. This means that, following the previous instruction, there either must be a number of no-op instructions to fill the gap or there must be an unconditional jump to the beginning of the loop. Neither possibility is free. Especially if the loop itself is not executed often, the no-ops or the jump might cost more than one saves by aligning the loop.

程序员可以通过三种方式影响代码的对齐。显然，如果代码是用汇编编写的，函数及其中所有指令都可以被显式地对齐。汇编器为所有架构都提供了.align伪操作来做到这一点。对于高级语言，必须把对齐要求告诉编译器。与数据类型和变量不同，这在源代码中是不可能的。取而代之的是使用一个编译器选项：

There are three ways the programmer can influence the alignment of code. Obviously, if the code is written in assembler the function and all instructions in it can be explicitly aligned. The assembler provides for all architectures the .align pseudo-op to do that. For high-level languages the compiler must be told about alignment requirements. Unlike for data types and variables this is not possible in the source code. Instead a compiler option is used:

-falign-functions=N

这个选项指示编译器把所有函数对齐到大于N的下一个2的幂次边界。这意味着会产生最多N字节的空隙。对于小函数，使用较大的N值是一种浪费。对于很少执行的代码也是如此。后者在库中可能经常出现，库中可能同时包含常用的和不那么常用的接口。明智地选择选项值可以加快速度，或者通过避免对齐来节省内存。使用1作为N的值或使用-fno-align-functions选项可以关闭所有对齐。

This option instructs the compiler to align all functions to the next power-of-two boundary greater than N. That means a gap of up to N bytes is created. For small functions using a large value for N is a waste. Equally for code which is executed only rarely. The latter can happen a lot in libraries which can contain both popular and not-so-popular interfaces. A wise choice of the option value can speed things up or save memory by avoiding alignment. All alignment is turned off by using one as the value of N or by using the -fno-align-functions option.

上述第二种情况——不按顺序到达的基本块的开头——的对齐可以用另一个选项来控制：

The alignment for the second case above–beginning of basic blocks which are not reached sequentially–can be controlled with a different option:

-falign-jumps=N

所有其他细节都是相同的，关于浪费内存的同样警告也适用。

All the other details are equivalent, the same warning about waste of memory applies.

第三种情况也有它自己的选项：

The third case also has its own option:

-falign-loops=N

同样的细节和警告再次适用。只是在这里，正如前面所解释的，对齐会带来运行时代价，因为如果顺序到达对齐后的地址，就必须执行空操作或跳转指令。

Yet again, the same details and warnings apply. Except that here, as explained before, alignment comes at a runtime cost since either no-ops or a jump instruction has to be executed if the aligned address is reached sequentially.

gcc还知道另一个控制对齐的选项，这里提到它只是为了完整起见。-falign-labels对齐代码中的每一个标签（基本上就是每个基本块的开头）。除了少数例外情况外，这在所有情况下都会使代码变慢，因此不应使用。

gcc knows about one more option for controlling alignment which is mentioned here only for completeness. -falign-labels aligns every single label in the code (basically the beginning of each basic block). This, in all but a few exceptional cases, slows down the code and therefore should not be used.

6.2.3 优化二级及更高级缓存访问

6.2.3 Optimizing Level 2 and Higher Cache Access

关于一级缓存优化所说的一切也适用于二级及更高级缓存的访问。对于最后一级缓存，还有两个额外的方面：

Everything said about optimizations for level 1 caches also applies to level 2 and higher cache accesses. There are two additional aspects of last level caches:

  • 缓存未命中总是代价非常高。L1未命中（希望）经常能命中L2及更高级缓存，从而限制了代价，而最后一级缓存显然没有退路。

    cache misses are always very expensive. While L1 misses (hopefully) frequently hit L2 and higher cache, thus limiting the penalties, there is obviously no fallback for the last level cache.

  • L2及更高级的缓存常常由多个内核和/或超线程共享。因此，每个执行单元可用的有效缓存大小通常小于缓存总大小。

    L2 caches and higher are often shared by multiple cores and/or hyper-threads. The effective cache size available to each execution unit is therefore usually less than the total cache size.

为了避免缓存未命中的高昂代价，工作集大小应当与缓存大小相匹配。如果数据只需要一次，这显然是不必要的，因为缓存本来就会无效。我们讨论的是数据集需要使用不止一次的工作负载。在这种情况下，使用一个太大而无法放进缓存的工作集，将产生大量的缓存未命中，即使预取成功执行，也会使程序变慢。

To avoid the high costs of cache misses, the working set size should be matched to the cache size. If data is only needed once this obviously is not necessary since the cache would be ineffective anyway. We are talking about workloads where the data set is needed more than once. In such a case the use of a working set which is too large to fit into the cache will create large amounts of cache misses which, even with prefetching being performed successfully, will slow down the program.

即使数据集太大，程序也必须完成它的工作。以最小化缓存未命中的方式完成工作是程序员的职责。对于最后一级缓存，这是可能的——就像对于L1缓存一样——方法是把工作分成较小的块来处理。这与第50页上优化后的矩阵乘法非常相似。不过，一个区别是，对于最后一级缓存，所处理的数据块可以更大。如果还需要L1优化，代码就会变得更加复杂。设想一个矩阵乘法，其中的数据集——两个输入矩阵和输出矩阵——加在一起放不进最后一级缓存。在这种情况下，同时优化L1和最后一级缓存的访问可能是合适的。

A program has to perform its job even if the data set is too large. It is the programmer’s job to do the work in a way which minimizes cache misses. For last-level caches this is possible–just as for L1 caches–by working on the job in smaller pieces. This is very similar to the optimized matrix multiplication on page 50. One difference, though, is that, for last level caches, the data blocks which are be worked on can be bigger. The code becomes yet more complicated if L1 optimizations are needed, too. Imagine a matrix multiplication where the data sets–the two input matrices and the output matrix–do not fit into the last level cache together. In this case it might be appropriate to optimize the L1 and last level cache accesses at the same time.

L1缓存行大小在许多代处理器中通常是不变的；即使有变化，差异也很小。直接假设较大的尺寸并不是什么大问题。在缓存尺寸较小的处理器上，会使用两个或更多缓存行来代替一个。无论如何，把缓存行大小硬编码并为它优化代码是合理的。

The L1 cache line size is usually constant over many processor generations; even if it is not, the differences will be small. It is no big problem to just assume the larger size. On processors with smaller cache sizes two or more cache lines will then be used instead of one. In any case, it is reasonable to hardcode the cache line size and optimize the code for it.

对于更高级的缓存，如果程序应当是通用的，情况就不是这样了。这些缓存的大小可能差异很大。八倍或更大的差距并不罕见。不可能默认假设较大的缓存尺寸，因为这意味着代码在除了拥有最大缓存的机器以外的所有机器上都表现很差。相反的选择也不好：假设最小的缓存意味着丢弃87%或更多的缓存。这很糟糕；正如我们从图3.14中看到的，使用大缓存可以对程序的速度产生巨大影响。

For higher level caches this is not the case if the program is supposed to be generic. The sizes of those caches can vary widely. Factors of eight or more are not uncommon. It is not possible to assume the larger cache size as a default since this would mean the code performs poorly on all machines except those with the biggest cache. The opposite choice is bad too: assuming the smallest cache means throwing away 87% of the cache or more. This is bad; as we can see from Figure 3.14 using large caches can have a huge impact on the program’s speed.

这意味着代码必须根据缓存行大小动态地调整自身。这是一种特定于程序的优化。我们在这里所能说的只是，程序员应当正确地计算程序的需求。需要的不仅仅是数据集本身，更高级的缓存还被用于其他目的；例如，所有被执行的指令都是从缓存中加载的。如果使用库函数，这种缓存使用可能会累积到相当大的量。这些库函数可能还需要自己的数据，这进一步减少了可用的内存。

What this means is that the code must dynamically adjust itself to the cache line size. This is an optimization specific to the program. All we can say here is that the programmer should compute the program’s requirements correctly. Not only are the data sets themselves needed, the higher level caches are also used for other purposes; for example, all the executed instructions are loaded from cache. If library functions are used this cache usage might add up to a significant amount. Those library functions might also need data of their own which further reduces the available memory.

一旦我们有了内存需求的公式，就可以把它与缓存大小进行比较。如前所述，缓存可能与多个其他内核共享。目前34，不硬编码知识而获得正确信息的唯一方法是通过/sys文件系统。在表5.2中，我们已经看到了内核所公开的关于硬件的信息。程序必须找到目录：

Once we have a formula for the memory requirement we can compare it with the cache size. As mentioned before, the cache might be shared with multiple other cores. Currently34 the only way to get correct information without hardcoding knowledge is through the /sys filesystem. In Table 5.2 we have seen the what the kernel publishes about the hardware. A program has to find the directory:

/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cache

中对应最后一级缓存的那个。这可以通过该目录中level文件里最大的数值来识别。确定目录后，程序应当读取该目录中size文件的内容，并把该数值除以shared_cpu_map文件中位掩码被置位的位数。

for the last level cache. This can be recognized by the highest numeric value in the level file in that directory. When the directory is identified the program should read the content of the size file in that directory and divide the numeric value by the number of bits set in the bitmask in the file shared_cpu_map.

以这种方式计算出的值是一个安全的下限。有时程序对其他线程或进程的行为了解得更多一些。如果这些线程被调度到共享该缓存的内核或超线程上，并且已知它们的缓存使用不会耗尽其在缓存总大小中所占的份额，那么计算出的限制可能太低而不是最优的。是否应当使用超过公平份额的缓存，实际上取决于具体情况。程序员必须作出选择，或者让用户来作决定。

The value which is computed this way is a safe lower limit. Sometimes a program knows a bit more about the behavior of other threads or processes. If those threads are scheduled on a core or hyper-thread sharing the cache, and the cache usage is known to not exhaust its fraction of the total cache size, then the computed limit might be too low to be optimal. Whether more than the fair share should be used really depends on the situation. The programmer has to make a choice or has to allow the user to make a decision.

6.2.4 优化TLB使用

6.2.4 Optimizing TLB Usage

TLB使用的优化有两种。第一种优化是减少程序必须使用的页数。这会自动导致更少的TLB未命中。第二种优化是通过减少必须分配的更高级目录表的数量，使TLB查找更便宜。更少的表意味着使用更少的内存，这可能使目录查找获得更高的缓存命中率。

There are two kinds of optimization of TLB usage. The first optimization is to reduce the number of pages a program has to use. This automatically results in fewer TLB misses. The second optimization is to make the TLB lookup cheaper by reducing the number higher level directory tables which must be allocated. Fewer tables means less memory is used which can result in higher cache hit rates for the directory lookup.

第一种优化与缺页最小化密切相关。我们将在7.5节中详细讨论这个话题。缺页通常是一次性的代价，而考虑到TLB缓存通常很小并且经常被刷新，TLB未命中则是一种持续的代价。缺页的代价比TLB未命中高几个数量级，但如果程序运行得足够长，并且程序的某些部分执行得足够频繁，TLB未命中的代价甚至可能超过缺页的代价。因此，重要的是不仅从缺页的角度，而且从TLB未命中的角度来看待页优化。区别在于，缺页优化只需要以页为粒度对代码和数据进行分组，而TLB优化要求在任一时刻使用的TLB条目尽可能少。

The first optimization is closely related to the minimization of page faults. We will cover that topic in detail in section 7.5. While page faults usually are a one-time cost, TLB misses are a perpetual penalty given that the TLB cache is usually small and it is flushed frequently. Page faults are orders of magnitude more expensive than TLB misses but, if a program is running long enough and certain parts of the program are executed frequently enough, TLB misses can outweigh even page fault costs. It is therefore important to regard page optimization not only from the perspective of page faults but also from the TLB miss perspective. The difference is that, while page fault optimizations only require page-wide grouping of the code and data, TLB optimization requires that, at any point in time, as few TLB entries are in use as possible.

第二种TLB优化更难控制。必须使用的页目录数量取决于进程虚拟地址空间中所使用地址范围的分布。地址空间中差异很大的位置意味着更多的目录。一个复杂之处在于，地址空间布局随机化（ASLR）恰恰会导致这种情况。栈、DSO、堆以及可能还有可执行文件的加载地址在运行时被随机化，以防止机器的攻击者猜出函数或变量的地址。

The second TLB optimization is even harder to control. The number of page directories which have to be used depends on the distribution of the address ranges used in the virtual address space of the process. Widely varying locations in the address space mean more directories. A complication is that Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) leads to exactly these situations. The load addresses of stack, DSOs, heap, and possibly executable are randomized at runtime to prevent attackers of the machine from guessing the addresses of functions or variables.

只有在最高性能至关重要时才应关闭ASLR。额外目录的代价足够低，除了少数极端情况外，都没有必要采取这一步骤。内核随时可以执行的一种可能的优化是，确保单个映射不会跨越两个目录之间的地址空间边界。这会以最小的方式限制ASLR，但不足以实质性地削弱它。

Only if maximum performance is critical ASLR should be turned off. The costs of the extra directories is low enough to make this step unnecessary in all but a few extreme cases. One possible optimization the kernel could at any time perform is to ensure that a single mapping does not cross the address space boundary between two directories. This would limit ASLR in a minimal fashion but not enough to substantially weaken it.

程序员直接受此影响的唯一情况是显式请求某个地址空间区域时。这发生在使用带MAP_FIXED的mmap时。以这种方式分配新的地址空间区域是非常危险的，几乎从不这样做。不过这是可能的，如果使用了它并且地址可以自由选择，程序员应当了解最后一级页目录的边界，并适当地选择所请求的地址。

The only way a programmer is directly affected by this is when an address space region is explicitly requested. This happens when using mmap with MAP_FIXED. Allocating new a address space region this way is very dangerous and hardly ever done. It is possible, though, and, if it is used and the addresses can be freely chosen, the programmer should know about the boundaries of the last level page directory and select the requested address appropriately.
